sentences.pinyin: wo3 chang2 chang2 xiang3 ta1 ming2 ming2 shen2 me5 dou1 zhi1 dao4 wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 gao4 su5 wo3 bie2 rang4 ba4 ba5 kai1 che1
sentences.english: I often thought: she knew everything, so why didn't she tell me not to let Dad drive?

sentences.hanzi: 今天，我穿过长长的走廊，走进了发信的房间。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 chuan1 guo4 chang2 chang2 de5 zou3 lang2 zou3 jin4 le5 fa1 xin4 de5 fang2 jian1
sentences.english: Today I walked down the long corridor and into the sending room.

sentences.hanzi: 工作人员让我一个人待着，屋里很安静。
sentences.pinyin: gong1 zuo4 ren2 yuan2 rang4 wo3 yi1 ge5 ren2 dai1 zhe5 wu1 li3 hen3 an1 jing4
sentences.english: The staff left me alone, and the room was quiet.

sentences.hanzi: 我写的是：别让爸爸开车。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xie3 de5 shi4 bie2 rang4 ba4 ba5 kai1 che1
sentences.english: What I wrote was: Don't let Dad drive.

sentences.hanzi: 机器启动了。我的手指按了下去。
sentences.pinyin: ji1 qi4 qi3 dong4 le5 wo3 de5 shou3 zhi3 an4 le5 xia4 qu4
sentences.english: The machine started up. My finger pressed the button.

sentences.hanzi: 机器说：不能发送，您没有收到过这句话。
sentences.pinyin: ji1 qi4 shuo1 bu4 neng2 fa1 song4 nin2 mei2 you3 shou1 dao4 guo5 zhe4 ju4 hua4
sentences.english: The machine said: Cannot send. You never received this sentence.

sentences.hanzi: 我绝望了，写了一句又一句。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 jue2 wang4 le5 xie3 le5 yi1 ju4 you4 yi1 ju4
sentences.english: In despair I wrote one sentence after another.

sentences.hanzi: 不能发送。不能发送。不能发送。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 neng2 fa1 song4 bu4 neng2 fa1 song4 bu4 neng2 fa1 song4
sentences.english: Cannot send. Cannot send. Cannot send.

sentences.hanzi: 我在那里坐了很久，依然想着那个下午。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 na4 li5 zuo4 le5 hen3 jiu3 yi1 ran2 xiang3 zhe5 na4 ge5 xia4 wu3
sentences.english: I sat there for a long time, still thinking of that afternoon.

sentences.hanzi: 阳光，黑油，他的笑话。
sentences.pinyin: yang2 guang1 hei1 you2 ta1 de5 xiao4 hua5
sentences.english: The sun, the black oil, his jokes.

sentences.hanzi: 我这才懂得，那个人不是不想救他。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 cai2 dong3 de5 na4 ge5 ren2 bu4 shi4 bu4 xiang3 jiu4 ta1
sentences.english: Only then did I understand: it wasn't that she hadn't wanted to save him.

sentences.hanzi: 她什么都试过了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shen2 me5 dou1 shi4 guo5 le5
sentences.english: She had tried everything.

sentences.hanzi: 救不了他，她只能给我一个下午。
sentences.pinyin: jiu4 bu4 liao3 ta1 ta1 zhi3 neng2 gei3 wo3 yi1 ge5 xia4 wu3
sentences.english: She couldn't save him. All she could give me was one afternoon.

sentences.hanzi: 我擦了擦脸，一个字一个字地写：今天陪爸爸。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ca1 le5 ca1 lian3 yi1 ge5 zi4 yi1 ge5 zi4 de5 xie3 jin1 tian1 pei2 ba4 ba5
sentences.english: I wiped my face and wrote, one character at a time: Stay with Dad today.

sentences.hanzi: 这一次，机器沉默了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ci4 ji1 qi4 chen2 mo4 le5
sentences.english: This time, the machine was silent.

sentences.hanzi: 信发出去了。
sentences.pinyin: xin4 fa1 chu1 qu4 le5
sentences.english: The message went.

sentences.hanzi: 一九六九年，三十多岁的科学家屠呦呦接到一个项目：找到治疟疾的新药。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 jiu3 liu4 jiu3 nian2 san1 shi2 duo1 sui4 de5 ke1 xue2 jia1 tu2 you1 you1 jie1 dao4 yi1 ge5 xiang4 mu4 zhao3 dao4 zhi4 nu:e4 ji2 de5 xin1 yao4
sentences.english: In 1969, a scientist in her thirties named Tu Youyou was given a project: find a new drug for malaria.

sentences.hanzi: 疟疾是一种很老的疾病，人被感染以后发高烧，每年有很多人因此死去。
sentences.pinyin: nu:e4 ji2 shi4 yi1 zhong3 hen3 lao3 de5 ji2 bing4 ren2 bei4 gan3 ran3 yi3 hou4 fa1 gao1 shao1 mei3 nian2 you3 hen3 duo1 ren2 yin1 ci3 si3 qu4
sentences.english: Malaria is an ancient disease. People who are infected run high fevers, and many die of it each year.

sentences.hanzi: 老药已经不管用了。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 yao4 yi3 jing1 bu4 guan3 yong4 le5
sentences.english: The old drugs no longer worked.

sentences.hanzi: 很多国家的科学家都在找新药，都没有找到。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 guo2 jia1 de5 ke1 xue2 jia1 dou1 zai4 zhao3 xin1 yao4 dou1 mei2 you3 zhao3 dao4
sentences.english: Scientists in many countries were searching for a new one, and none had found it.

sentences.hanzi: 屠呦呦用了一个特别的办法：去看老书。
sentences.pinyin: tu2 you1 you1 yong4 le5 yi1 ge5 te4 bie2 de5 ban4 fa3 qu4 kan4 lao3 shu1
sentences.english: Tu Youyou used an unusual method: she went to old books.

sentences.hanzi: 她和同事们尽可能多地看老药书，收集了两千多个方子。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 he2 tong2 shi4 men5 jin3 ke3 neng2 duo1 de5 kan4 lao3 yao4 shu1 shou1 ji2 le5 liang3 qian1 duo1 ge4 fang1 zi5
sentences.english: She and her colleagues read as many old medical books as they could and collected more than two thousand recipes.

sentences.hanzi: 他们在实验室里很有耐心，一种一种地在老鼠身上做实验，一次又一次地失败了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 zai4 shi2 yan4 shi4 li3 hen3 you3 nai4 xin1 yi1 zhong3 yi1 zhong4 de5 zai4 lao3 shu3 shen1 shang5 zuo4 shi2 yan4 yi1 ci4 you4 yi1 ci4 de5 shi1 bai4 le5
sentences.english: They were patient in the lab, testing them on mice one by one, failing time after time.

sentences.hanzi: 其中有一种草，叫青蒿，有时管用，有时完全没用。
sentences.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 you3 yi1 zhong3 cao3 jiao4 qing1 hao1 you3 shi2 guan3 yong4 you3 shi2 wan2 quan2 mei2 yong4
sentences.english: One of them was a plant called qinghao. Sometimes it worked, sometimes it did nothing.

sentences.hanzi: 为什么？
sentences.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: Why?

sentences.hanzi: 她回去又看了一遍老书。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hui2 qu5 you4 kan4 le5 yi1 bian4 lao3 shu1
sentences.english: She went back and read the old books again.

sentences.hanzi: 一千六百多年前，一位叫葛洪的医生写过一句话，意思是：青蒿用水泡，喝下去。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 qian1 liu4 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 yi1 wei4 jiao4 ge3 hong2 de5 yi1 sheng1 xie3 guo5 yi1 ju4 hua4 yi4 si5 shi4 qing1 hao1 yong4 shui3 pao4 he1 xia4 qu4
sentences.english: More than sixteen hundred years earlier, a doctor named Ge Hong had written a line that meant: soak qinghao in water and drink it.

sentences.hanzi: 她看了很久，停在一个字上：泡。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 ting2 zai4 yi1 ge5 zi4 shang4 pao4
sentences.english: She looked for a long time, and stopped at one word: soak.

sentences.hanzi: 中药一般都是煮的。
sentences.pinyin: zhong1 yao4 yi1 ban1 dou1 shi4 zhu3 de5
sentences.english: Chinese medicine is generally boiled.

sentences.hanzi: 葛洪为什么不煮？
sentences.pinyin: ge3 hong2 wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 zhu3
sentences.english: Why didn't Ge Hong boil it?

sentences.hanzi: 她判断，这种草里有用的东西怕热，一煮就被破坏了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 pan4 duan4 zhe4 zhong3 cao3 li3 you3 yong4 de5 dong1 xi5 pa4 re4 yi1 zhu3 jiu4 bei4 po4 huai4 le5
sentences.english: She reasoned that the useful thing in the plant couldn't stand heat, and boiling destroyed it.

sentences.hanzi: 于是她换了一种不用高热的办法。
sentences.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 huan4 le5 yi1 zhong3 bu4 yong4 gao1 re4 de5 ban4 fa3
sentences.english: So she changed to a method that avoided high heat.

sentences.hanzi: 一九七一年，第一百九十一次实验，老鼠身上的病全好了。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 jiu3 qi1 yi1 nian2 di4 yi1 bai3 jiu3 shi2 yi1 ci4 shi2 yan4 lao3 shu3 shen1 shang5 de5 bing4 quan2 hao3 le5
sentences.english: In 1971, on the hundred and ninety-first test, the mice were completely cured.

sentences.hanzi: 可是这种药能不能给人吃？有没有毒？没有人知道。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 yao4 neng2 bu4 neng2 gei3 ren2 chi1 you3 mei2 you3 du2 mei2 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: But could people take it? Was it poisonous? No one knew.

sentences.hanzi: 第二年，夏天就要到了，病人等不了。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 nian2 xia4 tian1 jiu4 yao4 dao4 le5 bing4 ren2 deng3 bu4 liao3
sentences.english: The next year, summer was coming, and the patients couldn't wait.

sentences.hanzi: 屠呦呦主动要求，自己先吃。
sentences.pinyin: tu2 you1 you1 zhu3 dong4 yao1 qiu2 zi4 ji3 xian1 chi1
sentences.english: Tu Youyou volunteered to take it first herself.

sentences.hanzi: 她和同事们吃了以后，一点事也没有，这证实了药是安全的。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 he2 tong2 shi4 men5 chi1 le5 yi3 hou4 yi1 dian3 shi4 ye3 mei2 you3 zhe4 zheng4 shi2 le5 yao4 shi4 an1 quan2 de5
sentences.english: She and her colleagues took it and came to no harm, which showed the drug was safe.

sentences.hanzi: 那年，这种药第一次治好了病人。
sentences.pinyin: na4 nian2 zhe4 zhong3 yao4 di4 yi1 ci4 zhi4 hao3 le5 bing4 ren2
sentences.english: That year, the drug cured patients for the first time.

sentences.hanzi: 后来，它从中国走向世界，救了几百万人，其中很多是非洲的儿童。
sentences.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ta1 cong2 zhong1 guo2 zou3 xiang4 shi4 jie4 jiu4 le5 ji3 bai3 wan4 ren2 qi2 zhong1 hen3 duo1 shi4 fei1 zhou1 de5 er2 tong2
sentences.english: It went on to spread from China to the world, saving millions of people, many of them African children.

sentences.hanzi: 二零一五年，八十四岁的屠呦呦得到了诺贝尔奖。
sentences.pinyin: er4 ling2 yi1 wu3 nian2 ba1 shi2 si4 sui4 de5 tu2 you1 you1 de2 dao4 le5 nuo4 bei4 er3 jiang3
sentences.english: In 2015, at eighty-four, Tu Youyou received the Nobel Prize.

sentences.hanzi: 她没有博士学位，也没有出国留过学，然而全世界都记住了她。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 mei2 you3 bo2 shi4 xue2 wei4 ye3 mei2 you3 chu1 guo2 liu2 guo5 xue2 ran2 er2 quan2 shi4 jie4 dou1 ji4 zhu5 le5 ta1
sentences.english: She had no doctorate and had never studied abroad, yet the whole world remembered her.

sentences.hanzi: 那句话在书里等了一千六百多年。
sentences.pinyin: na4 ju4 hua4 zai4 shu1 li3 deng3 le5 yi1 qian1 liu4 bai3 duo1 nian2
sentences.english: That sentence had waited in a book for over sixteen hundred years.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人读过它，可是只有一个人，停在了那个“泡”字上。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 du2 guo5 ta1 ke3 shi4 zhi3 you3 yi1 ge5 ren2 ting2 zai4 le5 na4 ge5 pao4 zi4 shang4
sentences.english: Many people had read it, but only one stopped at the word “soak”.

glossed.meaning: Ge Hong, Jin dynasty doctor and writer

sentences.hanzi: 我今年三十岁，过年回家，依然收到了压岁钱。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 jin1 nian2 san1 shi2 sui4 guo4 nian2 hui2 jia1 yi1 ran2 shou1 dao4 le5 ya1 sui4 qian2
sentences.english: I'm thirty this year, and when I went home for New Year I still got yasuiqian.

sentences.hanzi: 这件事说起来有点不好意思。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 shi4 shuo1 qi3 lai5 you3 dian3 bu4 hao3 yi4 si5
sentences.english: It's a little embarrassing to admit.

sentences.hanzi: 压岁钱是过年时大人给孩子的钱，放在红包里。
sentences.pinyin: ya1 sui4 qian2 shi4 guo4 nian2 shi2 da4 ren5 gei3 hai2 zi5 de5 qian2 fang4 zai4 hong2 bao1 li3
sentences.english: Yasuiqian is the money adults give children at New Year, in red envelopes.

sentences.hanzi: 我小时候，爷爷从不当面给我，每年都等我睡着了，偷偷把红包压在我的枕头下面。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiao3 shi2 hou5 ye2 ye5 cong2 bu4 dang1 mian4 gei3 wo3 mei3 nian2 dou1 deng3 wo3 shui4 zhao2 le5 tou1 tou1 ba3 hong2 bao1 ya1 zai4 wo3 de5 zhen3 tou5 xia4 mian4
sentences.english: When I was small, Grandpa never handed it to me. Every year he waited till I was asleep and secretly pressed the envelope under my pillow.

sentences.hanzi: 我问过他为什么。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 guo5 ta1 wei4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: I once asked him why.

sentences.hanzi: 他说，传说很久以前有一个小鬼，叫祟，过年的半夜会来摸孩子的头。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 chuan2 shuo1 hen3 jiu3 yi3 qian2 you3 yi1 ge5 xiao3 gui3 jiao4 sui4 guo4 nian2 de5 ban4 ye4 hui4 lai2 mo1 hai2 zi5 de5 tou2
sentences.english: He said that long ago, according to legend, there was a little demon called Sui that came at midnight at New Year to touch children's heads.

sentences.hanzi: 被它摸过的孩子就会生病。
sentences.pinyin: bei4 ta1 mo1 guo5 de5 hai2 zi5 jiu4 hui4 sheng1 bing4
sentences.english: Children it touched fell ill.

sentences.hanzi: 大人们把钱压在枕头下面，小鬼就不敢来了。
sentences.pinyin: da4 ren2 men5 ba3 qian2 ya1 zai4 zhen3 tou5 xia4 mian4 xiao3 gui3 jiu4 bu4 gan3 lai2 le5
sentences.english: If adults pressed money under the pillow, the demon wouldn't dare come.

sentences.hanzi: “压祟”听起来就是“压岁”。
sentences.pinyin: ya1 sui4 ting1 qi3 lai5 jiu4 shi4 ya1 sui4
sentences.english: “Pressing down Sui” sounds exactly like “pressing down the year”.

sentences.hanzi: 这个老习惯，我们家一直保留着。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 lao3 xi2 guan4 wo3 men5 jia1 yi1 zhi2 bao3 liu2 zhe5
sentences.english: Our family has always kept up this old habit.

sentences.hanzi: 随着手机的到来，一切都变了，现在流行用手机发红包。
sentences.pinyin: sui2 zhe5 shou3 ji1 de5 dao4 lai2 yi1 qie4 dou1 bian4 le5 xian4 zai4 liu2 xing2 yong4 shou3 ji1 fa1 hong2 bao1
sentences.english: With the arrival of smartphones everything has changed. Sending red envelopes by phone is all the rage now.

sentences.hanzi: 今年大年三十，全家人坐在沙发上，一个个低着头看手机。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 nian2 da4 nian2 san1 shi2 quan2 jia1 ren2 zuo4 zai4 sha1 fa1 shang4 yi1 ge5 ge4 di1 zhe5 tou2 kan4 shou3 ji1
sentences.english: This New Year's Eve, the whole family sat on the sofa, every head bent over a phone.

sentences.hanzi: 大家在手机上发红包，抢红包，一块两块，抢得很开心。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 zai4 shou3 ji1 shang4 fa1 hong2 bao1 qiang3 hong2 bao1 yi1 kuai4 liang3 kuai4 qiang3 de5 hen3 kai1 xin1
sentences.english: We sent red envelopes on our phones and grabbed them, a yuan or two at a time, having great fun.

sentences.hanzi: 我给爷爷发了一个最大的，两百块。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 gei3 ye2 ye5 fa1 le5 yi1 ge5 zui4 da4 de5 liang3 bai3 kuai4
sentences.english: I sent Grandpa the biggest one you can send: 200 yuan.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷戴着眼镜看了半天，还是不会用。二十四个小时以后，钱又自动回到了我的手机上。
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 dai4 zhe5 yan3 jing4 kan4 le5 ban4 tian1 hai2 shi5 bu4 hui4 yong4 er4 shi2 si4 ge4 xiao3 shi2 yi3 hou4 qian2 you4 zi4 dong4 hui2 dao4 le5 wo3 de5 shou3 ji1 shang4
sentences.english: Grandpa looked through his glasses for ages but still couldn't work it. Twenty-four hours later the money came back to my phone by itself.

sentences.hanzi: 我笑着劝他：“爷爷，我都三十了，以后别给我压岁钱了。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiao4 zhe5 quan4 ta1 ye2 ye5 wo3 dou1 san1 shi2 le5 yi3 hou4 bie2 gei3 wo3 ya1 sui4 qian2 le5
sentences.english: I laughed and tried to talk him out of it. “Grandpa, I'm thirty now. Don't give me yasuiqian any more.”

sentences.hanzi: “我赚钱了，该我给您了。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhuan4 qian2 le5 gai1 wo3 gei3 nin2 le5
sentences.english: “I earn money now. It's my turn to give to you.”

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷看了看我，沉默了。
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 kan4 le5 kan4 wo3 chen2 mo4 le5
sentences.english: Grandpa looked at me and fell silent.

sentences.hanzi: 那天凌晨，我还没有睡着，门轻轻地开了。
sentences.pinyin: na4 tian1 ling2 chen2 wo3 hai2 mei2 you3 shui4 zhao2 men2 qing1 qing1 de5 kai1 le5
sentences.english: In the small hours I was still awake when the door opened softly.

sentences.hanzi: 是爷爷。他今年八十六岁，腿不好，平时走路很慢。
sentences.pinyin: shi4 ye2 ye5 ta1 jin1 nian2 ba1 shi2 liu4 sui4 tui3 bu4 hao3 ping2 shi2 zou3 lu4 hen3 man4
sentences.english: It was Grandpa. He is eighty-six, with bad legs, and he usually walks slowly.

sentences.hanzi: 我闭上眼睛，假装睡着了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bi4 shang4 yan3 jing5 jia3 zhuang1 shui4 zhao2 le5
sentences.english: I closed my eyes and pretended to be asleep.

sentences.hanzi: 他在床边站了一会儿，一只手慢慢伸到枕头下面。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 chuang2 bian1 zhan4 le5 yi1 hui4 r5 yi1 zhi3 shou3 man4 man4 shen1 dao4 zhen3 tou5 xia4 mian4
sentences.english: He stood by the bed for a while, then slowly slid one hand under my pillow.

sentences.hanzi: 然后，他轻轻摸了摸我的头。
sentences.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 qing1 qing1 mo1 le5 mo1 wo3 de5 tou2
sentences.english: Then, very gently, he touched my head.

sentences.hanzi: 门关上了。
sentences.pinyin: men2 guan1 shang4 le5
sentences.english: The door closed.

sentences.hanzi: 我拿出那个红包，里面是两百块全新的钱。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 na2 chu1 na4 ge5 hong2 bao1 li3 mian4 shi4 liang3 bai3 kuai4 quan2 xin1 de5 qian2
sentences.english: I took out the envelope. Inside were two hundred yuan in brand-new notes.

sentences.hanzi: 我这才懂得：他压的不是鬼。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 cai2 dong3 de5 ta1 ya1 de5 bu4 shi4 gui3
sentences.english: Only then did I understand: it wasn't a demon he was keeping down.

sentences.hanzi: 在他眼里，我还是小孩子，他还是怕有什么东西伤害我。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 ta1 yan3 li3 wo3 hai2 shi5 xiao3 hai2 zi5 ta1 hai2 shi5 pa4 you3 shen2 me5 dong1 xi5 shang1 hai4 wo3
sentences.english: In his eyes I was still a little child, and he still feared something might harm me.

sentences.hanzi: 手机可以代替红包，可是代替不了这只手。
sentences.pinyin: shou3 ji1 ke3 yi3 dai4 ti4 hong2 bao1 ke3 shi4 dai4 ti4 bu4 liao3 zhe4 zhi3 shou3
sentences.english: A phone can replace a red envelope, but it can't replace that hand.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天晚上，我等他睡着，走进他的房间。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 wan3 shang5 wo3 deng3 ta1 shui4 zhao2 zou3 jin4 ta1 de5 fang2 jian1
sentences.english: The next night I waited until he was asleep and went into his room.

sentences.hanzi: 我学着他的样子，偷偷把一个红包压在他的枕头下面。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xue2 zhe5 ta1 de5 yang4 zi5 tou1 tou1 ba3 yi1 ge5 hong2 bao1 ya1 zai4 ta1 de5 zhen3 tou5 xia4 mian4
sentences.english: Just as he had done, I secretly pressed a red envelope under his pillow.

sentences.hanzi: 他闭着眼睛，嘴角轻轻动了一下。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 bi4 zhe5 yan3 jing5 zui3 jiao3 qing1 qing1 dong4 le5 yi1 xia4
sentences.english: His eyes stayed shut, but the corner of his mouth moved a little.

sentences.hanzi: 原来他也在假装。
sentences.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 ta1 ye3 zai4 jia3 zhuang1
sentences.english: He was pretending too.

glossed.meaning: lucky money given to children at New Year

title: 一箱也不能少
titlePinyin: yi1 xiang1 ye3 bu4 neng2 shao3

sentences.hanzi: 一九三九年，我二十二岁，在四川的山路上开卡车。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 jiu3 san1 jiu3 nian2 wo3 er4 shi2 er4 sui4 zai4 si4 chuan1 de5 shan1 lu4 shang4 kai1 ka3 che1
sentences.english: In 1939 I was twenty-two, driving a truck on the mountain roads of Sichuan.

sentences.hanzi: 车上的箱子是从北平的故宫运来的，已经在路上走了好几年。
sentences.pinyin: che1 shang4 de5 xiang1 zi5 shi4 cong2 bei3 ping2 de5 gu4 gong1 yun4 lai2 de5 yi3 jing1 zai4 lu4 shang5 zou3 le5 hao3 ji3 nian2
sentences.english: The boxes on my truck had come from the Palace Museum in Beiping, and had been on the road for years.

sentences.hanzi: 日本的士兵打过来以后，这一万多箱东西就一直在搬。
sentences.pinyin: ri4 ben3 de5 shi4 bing1 da3 guo4 lai2 yi3 hou4 zhe4 yi1 wan4 duo1 xiang1 dong1 xi5 jiu4 yi1 zhi2 zai4 ban1
sentences.english: Ever since Japanese soldiers invaded, these ten thousand and more boxes had been on the move.

sentences.hanzi: 我不知道里面是什么，只知道每一箱都有号码。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 li3 mian4 shi4 shen2 me5 zhi3 zhi1 dao4 mei3 yi1 xiang1 dou1 you3 hao4 ma3
sentences.english: I didn't know what was inside, only that each box had a number.

sentences.hanzi: 管箱子的是老周，六十多岁，又瘦又老，戴着眼镜，坐在我旁边，手里总拿着一张单子。
sentences.pinyin: guan3 xiang1 zi5 de5 shi4 lao3 zhou1 liu4 shi2 duo1 sui4 you4 shou4 you4 lao3 dai4 zhe5 yan3 jing4 zuo4 zai4 wo3 pang2 bian1 shou3 li3 zong3 na2 zhe5 yi1 zhang1 dan1 zi5
sentences.english: The man in charge was Lao Zhou, past sixty, thin and old, wearing glasses, who sat next to me with a list always in his hand.

sentences.hanzi: “这是我的职责，”他说。他只有一个规矩：一箱也不能少。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wo3 de5 zhi2 ze2 ta1 shuo1 ta1 zhi3 you3 yi1 ge5 gui1 ju5 yi1 xiang1 ye3 bu4 neng2 shao3
sentences.english: “This is my duty,” he said. He had just one rule: not one box may go missing.

sentences.hanzi: 那天下大雨，山路又湿又滑。
sentences.pinyin: na4 tian1 xia4 da4 yu3 shan1 lu4 you4 shi1 you4 hua2
sentences.english: That day it poured with rain, and the mountain road was wet and slippery.

sentences.hanzi: 车转过一座山，路上站着几个士兵，他们抬着一个受伤的年轻人。
sentences.pinyin: che1 zhuan3 guo4 yi1 zuo4 shan1 lu4 shang5 zhan4 zhe5 ji3 ge4 shi4 bing1 ta1 men5 tai2 zhe5 yi1 ge5 shou4 shang1 de5 nian2 qing1 ren2
sentences.english: We came round a mountain and found several soldiers on the road, carrying a wounded young man.

sentences.hanzi: “他的腿不行了，山那边才有医院！”一个士兵喊，“请带他走！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 tui3 bu4 xing2 le5 shan1 na4 bian5 cai2 you3 yi1 yuan4 yi1 ge5 shi4 bing1 han3 qing3 dai4 ta1 zou3
sentences.english: “His leg is bad, and the only hospital is over the mountain!” a soldier shouted. “Please take him!”

sentences.hanzi: 我看了看车子。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 le5 kan4 che1 zi5
sentences.english: I looked at the truck.

sentences.hanzi: 车已经太重了，这种山路，不能再多一个人。
sentences.pinyin: che1 yi3 jing1 tai4 zhong4 le5 zhe4 zhong3 shan1 lu4 bu4 neng2 zai4 duo1 yi1 ge5 ren2
sentences.english: It was already too heavy. On a road like this, it couldn't take one more person.

sentences.hanzi: 除非从车上拿下一箱。
sentences.pinyin: chu2 fei1 cong2 che1 shang4 na2 xia4 yi1 xiang1
sentences.english: Unless we took a box off the truck.

sentences.hanzi: 老周马上说：“不行。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 ma3 shang4 shuo1 bu4 xing2
sentences.english: Lao Zhou said at once, “No.”

sentences.hanzi: “老周，这是一条性命！”我大声说，“箱子丢了算什么？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 zhe4 shi4 yi1 tiao2 xing4 ming4 wo3 da4 sheng1 shuo1 xiang1 zi5 diu1 le5 suan4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: “Lao Zhou, this is a life!” I shouted. “What's a lost box compared to that?”

sentences.hanzi: “这里面是中国的文化，丢了就再也没有了。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 mian4 shi4 zhong1 guo2 de5 wen2 hua4 diu1 le5 jiu4 zai4 ye3 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: “In here is China's culture. Once lost, it is gone forever.”

sentences.hanzi: 雨下得更大了。士兵们看着我们，谁也没有说话。
sentences.pinyin: yu3 xia4 de5 geng4 da4 le5 shi4 bing1 men5 kan4 zhe5 wo3 men5 shei2 ye3 mei2 you3 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: The rain grew heavier. The soldiers looked at us, and no one spoke.

sentences.hanzi: 老周看了看那个年轻人，又看了看手里的单子。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 kan4 le5 kan4 na4 ge5 nian2 qing1 ren2 you4 kan4 le5 kan4 shou3 li3 de5 dan1 zi5
sentences.english: Lao Zhou looked at the young man, then at the list in his hand.

sentences.hanzi: 然后他打开车门，下了车。
sentences.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 da3 kai1 che1 men2 xia4 le5 che1
sentences.english: Then he opened the truck door and climbed down.

sentences.hanzi: “箱子一箱也不能少，”他说，“那就少一个人。”
sentences.pinyin: xiang1 zi5 yi1 xiang1 ye3 bu4 neng2 shao3 ta1 shuo1 na4 jiu4 shao3 yi1 ge5 ren2
sentences.english: “Not one box may go,” he said. “So one person will.”

sentences.hanzi: 他把自己的位子让给了受伤的士兵，一个人走进了雨里。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ba3 zi4 ji3 de5 wei4 zi5 rang4 gei3 le5 shou4 shang1 de5 shi4 bing1 yi1 ge5 ren2 zou3 jin4 le5 yu3 li3
sentences.english: He gave up his seat to the wounded soldier and walked off alone into the rain.

sentences.hanzi: 车上，年轻的士兵问我：“那位老人是谁？箱子里是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: che1 shang4 nian2 qing1 de5 shi4 bing1 wen4 wo3 na4 wei4 lao3 ren2 shi4 shei2 xiang1 zi5 li3 shi4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: In the truck, the young soldier asked me, “Who's that old man? What's in the boxes?”

sentences.hanzi: “他说是一千年前的字和画。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 shi4 yi1 qian1 nian2 qian2 de5 zi4 he2 hua4
sentences.english: “He says it's calligraphy and paintings from a thousand years ago.”

sentences.hanzi: 士兵笑了一下：“我们的部队在前面拼命，你们在后面运画？”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 bing1 xiao4 le5 yi1 xia4 wo3 men5 de5 bu4 dui4 zai4 qian2 mian4 pin1 ming4 ni3 men5 zai4 hou4 mian5 yun4 hua4
sentences.english: The soldier gave a short laugh. “Our army is risking its life at the front, and you're hauling paintings at the back?”

sentences.hanzi: 我不知道怎么回答。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zen3 me5 hui2 da2
sentences.english: I didn't know what to say.

sentences.hanzi: 过了一会儿，他轻轻说：“也好。打完了，总要留下点什么给人看。”
sentences.pinyin: guo4 le5 yi1 hui4 r5 ta1 qing1 qing1 shuo1 ye3 hao3 da3 wan2 le5 zong3 yao4 liu2 xia4 dian3 shen2 me5 gei3 ren2 kan4
sentences.english: After a while he said softly, “That's fine. When it's over, there should be something left for people to see.”

sentences.hanzi: 三天以后，老周才赶上我们。
sentences.pinyin: san1 tian1 yi3 hou4 lao3 zhou1 cai2 gan3 shang4 wo3 men5
sentences.english: Three days later, Lao Zhou finally caught up with us.

sentences.hanzi: 他全身都湿了，胡子上都是雨水，鞋子也破了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 quan2 shen1 dou1 shi1 le5 hu2 zi5 shang4 dou1 shi4 yu3 shui3 xie2 zi5 ye3 po4 le5
sentences.english: He was soaked through, rain in his beard, his shoes in tatters.

sentences.hanzi: 他的第一句话是：“箱子呢？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 di4 yi1 ju4 hua4 shi4 xiang1 zi5 ne5
sentences.english: The first thing he said was, “Where are the boxes?”

sentences.hanzi: 他拿着单子，一箱一箱地点了一遍。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 na2 zhe5 dan1 zi5 yi1 xiang1 yi1 xiang1 de5 dian3 le5 yi1 bian4
sentences.english: With his list in hand he checked them, box by box.

sentences.hanzi: 一箱也没有少。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 xiang1 ye3 mei2 you3 shao3
sentences.english: Not one was missing.

sentences.hanzi: 这些箱子在路上走了十几年，里面的东西几乎没有丢。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 xiang1 zi5 zai4 lu4 shang5 zou3 le5 shi2 ji3 nian2 li3 mian4 de5 dong1 xi5 ji1 hu1 mei2 you3 diu1
sentences.english: Those boxes travelled for more than a decade, and almost nothing inside was lost.

sentences.hanzi: 人们说那是奇迹。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 shuo1 na4 shi4 qi2 ji4
sentences.english: People call it a miracle.

sentences.hanzi: 我老了以后，常常想起雨里那个走路的老人。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 lao3 le5 yi3 hou4 chang2 chang2 xiang3 qi3 yu3 li3 na4 ge5 zou3 lu4 de5 lao3 ren2
sentences.english: Now that I'm old, I often think of that man walking in the rain.

sentences.hanzi: 我知道，奇迹是人一步一步走出来的。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 qi2 ji4 shi4 ren2 yi1 bu4 yi1 bu4 zou3 chu1 lai2 de5
sentences.english: I know that miracles are walked out, one step at a time.

glossed.meaning: Sichuan, a province in southwest China
Beiping, as Beijing was then called
the Palace Museum, the Forbidden City

sentences.hanzi: 吐鲁番是中国最热、最干的地方之一，这样说一点也不夸张。
sentences.pinyin: tu3 lu3 fan1 shi4 zhong1 guo2 zui4 re4 zui4 gan1 de5 di4 fang5 zhi1 yi1 zhe4 yang4 shuo1 yi1 dian3 ye3 bu4 kua1 zhang1
sentences.english: Turpan is one of the hottest, driest places in China, and that's no exaggeration.

sentences.hanzi: 夏天的白天常常四十多度，这里一年下的雨，比很多地方一场雨还少。
sentences.pinyin: xia4 tian1 de5 bai2 tian1 chang2 chang2 si4 shi2 duo1 du4 zhe4 li3 yi1 nian2 xia4 de5 yu3 bi3 hen3 duo1 di4 fang5 yi1 chang3 yu3 hai2 shao3
sentences.english: On summer days it is often over forty degrees, and a whole year's rain here is less than one shower elsewhere.

sentences.hanzi: 这片土地最缺乏的就是水，可是我一到这个小镇就吃惊了：到处都是绿色，到处都是葡萄。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 pian4 tu3 di4 zui4 que1 fa2 de5 jiu4 shi4 shui3 ke3 shi4 wo3 yi1 dao4 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 zhen4 jiu4 chi1 jing1 le5 dao4 chu4 dou1 shi4 lu:4 se4 dao4 chu4 dou1 shi4 pu2 tao2
sentences.english: What this land lacks most is water, yet I was amazed when I reached this small town: there was green everywhere, and grapes everywhere.

sentences.hanzi: 葡萄依靠什么活下来？水是从哪里来的？
sentences.pinyin: pu2 tao2 yi1 kao4 shen2 me5 huo2 xia4 lai5 shui3 shi4 cong2 na3 li3 lai2 de5
sentences.english: What did the grapes live on? Where did the water come from?

sentences.hanzi: 当地一位老人带我走到一个地方，指着地下说：“从这里。”
sentences.pinyin: dang1 di4 yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2 dai4 wo3 zou3 dao4 yi1 ge5 di4 fang5 zhi3 zhe5 di4 xia4 shuo1 cong2 zhe4 li3
sentences.english: A local old man took me to a spot and pointed at the ground. “From here.”

sentences.hanzi: 地上有一个洞，下面很黑，能听见水声。
sentences.pinyin: di4 shang5 you3 yi1 ge5 dong4 xia4 mian4 hen3 hei1 neng2 ting1 jian4 shui3 sheng1
sentences.english: There was a hole in the ground, dark below, and I could hear water.

sentences.hanzi: 这就是坎儿井，一条人挖出来的地下河。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 kan3 er2 jing3 yi1 tiao2 ren2 wa1 chu1 lai2 de5 di4 xia4 he2
sentences.english: This was a karez, an underground river dug by hand.

sentences.hanzi: 远处的天山上有很多雪。
sentences.pinyin: yuan3 chu4 de5 tian1 shan1 shang4 you3 hen3 duo1 xue3
sentences.english: On the distant Tianshan mountains there is a lot of snow.

sentences.hanzi: 夏天雪化了，水流下来。
sentences.pinyin: xia4 tian1 xue3 hua4 le5 shui3 liu2 xia4 lai5
sentences.english: In summer the snow melts and the water flows down.

sentences.hanzi: 可是如果水从地上走，太阳太热，走不了多远就没有了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ru2 guo3 shui3 cong2 di4 shang5 zou3 tai4 yang5 tai4 re4 zou3 bu4 liao3 duo1 yuan3 jiu4 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: But if it travels above ground, the sun is so hot that it soon disappears.

sentences.hanzi: 于是很久以前，人们用智慧想出了一个办法：让水从地下走。
sentences.pinyin: yu2 shi4 hen3 jiu3 yi3 qian2 ren2 men5 yong4 zhi4 hui4 xiang3 chu1 le5 yi1 ge5 ban4 fa3 rang4 shui3 cong2 di4 xia4 zou3
sentences.english: So long ago, people had the wisdom to think of a solution: let the water travel underground.

sentences.hanzi: 他们隔一段路挖一个很深的洞，再在地下把这些洞连起来。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 ge2 yi1 duan4 lu4 wa1 yi1 ge5 hen3 shen1 de5 dong4 zai4 zai4 di4 xia4 ba3 zhe4 xie1 dong4 lian2 qi3 lai5
sentences.english: They dug a deep hole every so often, then joined the holes together underground.

sentences.hanzi: 这样的河，有的有几十里长。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 de5 he2 you3 de5 you3 ji3 shi2 li3 chang2
sentences.english: Some of these rivers are dozens of li long.

sentences.hanzi: 吐鲁番曾经有一千多条。
sentences.pinyin: tu3 lu3 fan1 ceng2 jing1 you3 yi1 qian1 duo1 tiao2
sentences.english: Turpan once had more than a thousand.

sentences.hanzi: 在地下挖路的人看不见太阳，工具也很简单。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 di4 xia4 wa1 lu4 de5 ren2 kan4 bu4 jian4 tai4 yang5 gong1 ju4 ye3 hen3 jian3 dan1
sentences.english: The people digging underground never saw the sun, and their tools were simple.

sentences.hanzi: 地下这么黑，怎么知道方向？
sentences.pinyin: di4 xia4 zhe4 me5 hei1 zen3 me5 zhi1 dao4 fang1 xiang4
sentences.english: It's so dark down there. How did they know which way to go?

sentences.hanzi: 老人说，他们在身后挂一个灯，对着自己的影子挖，路就是直的。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 shuo1 ta1 men5 zai4 shen1 hou4 gua4 yi1 ge5 deng1 dui4 zhe5 zi4 ji3 de5 ying3 zi5 wa1 lu4 jiu4 shi4 zhi2 de5
sentences.english: The old man said they hung a lamp behind them and dug towards their own shadow, and so the tunnel ran straight.

sentences.hanzi: 这些人几乎都没有留下名字。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 ren2 ji1 hu1 dou1 mei2 you3 liu2 xia4 ming2 zi5
sentences.english: Almost none of these people left their names.

sentences.hanzi: 现在，机器代替了人，从更深的地下取水，很多地下河已经干了。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ji1 qi4 dai4 ti4 le5 ren2 cong2 geng4 shen1 de5 di4 xia4 qu3 shui3 hen3 duo1 di4 xia4 he2 yi3 jing1 gan1 le5
sentences.english: Now machines have replaced people, drawing water from deeper underground, and many of the underground rivers have dried up.

sentences.hanzi: 老人的儿子去了城里的工厂，他说父亲用不着再下去了。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 de5 er2 zi5 qu4 le5 cheng2 li3 de5 gong1 chang3 ta1 shuo1 fu4 qin1 yong4 bu5 zhao2 zai4 xia4 qu4 le5
sentences.english: The old man's son has gone to work in a factory in town, and says his father needn't go down any more.

sentences.hanzi: 可是每年春天，老人依然要下去一次，把路上的石头清理出来。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 mei3 nian2 chun1 tian1 lao3 ren2 yi1 ran2 yao4 xia4 qu4 yi1 ci4 ba3 lu4 shang5 de5 shi2 tou5 qing1 li3 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: But every spring the old man still goes down to clear the stones from the way.

sentences.hanzi: 我问他：“您这么大年纪，为什么非得下去？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ta1 nin2 zhe4 me5 da4 nian2 ji4 wei4 shen2 me5 fei1 dei3 xia4 qu4
sentences.english: I asked him, “At your age, why must you go down there?”

sentences.hanzi: 他没有回答，只是打上来一碗水，给了我。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 mei2 you3 hui2 da2 zhi3 shi4 da3 shang4 lai2 yi1 wan3 shui3 gei3 le5 wo3
sentences.english: He didn't answer. He just drew up a bowl of water and handed it to me.

sentences.hanzi: 水冷得我牙齿都疼了。
sentences.pinyin: shui3 leng3 de5 wo3 ya2 chi3 dou1 teng2 le5
sentences.english: It was so cold it made my teeth ache.

sentences.hanzi: 外面四十多度，我手里是天山上的雪。
sentences.pinyin: wai4 mian4 si4 shi2 duo1 du4 wo3 shou3 li3 shi4 tian1 shan1 shang4 de5 xue3
sentences.english: Outside it was over forty degrees, and in my hands was the snow of the Tianshan.

sentences.hanzi: 这碗水走过的路，是很久以前一些没有留下名字的人挖的。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 wan3 shui3 zou3 guo5 de5 lu4 shi4 hen3 jiu3 yi3 qian2 yi1 xie1 mei2 you3 liu2 xia4 ming2 zi5 de5 ren2 wa1 de5
sentences.english: The road this water had travelled was dug long ago by people who left no names.

sentences.hanzi: 我喝完了，再也没有问。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 he1 wan2 le5 zai4 ye3 mei2 you3 wen4
sentences.english: I finished it and didn't ask again.

glossed.meaning: Turpan, an oasis city in Xinjiang

sentences.hanzi: “你是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 shi4 shei2
sentences.english: "Who are you?"

sentences.hanzi: “我是你的朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shi4 ni3 de5 peng2 you5
sentences.english: "I'm your friend."

sentences.hanzi: “这是哪？”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 na3
sentences.english: "Where is this?"

sentences.hanzi: “这是你的家。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 ni3 de5 jia1
sentences.english: "This is your home."

sentences.hanzi: “不，这不是我的家。我的家是地球，我是地球人！”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 zhe4 bu4 shi4 wo3 de5 jia1 wo3 de5 jia1 shi4 di4 qiu2 wo3 shi4 di4 qiu2 ren2
sentences.english: "No, this isn't my home. My home is Earth. I'm an Earthling!"

sentences.hanzi: “不，朋友，你不是地球人。你是机器人，今天是你的第一天。”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 peng2 you5 ni3 bu4 shi4 di4 qiu2 ren2 ni3 shi4 ji1 qi4 ren2 jin1 tian1 shi4 ni3 de5 di4 yi1 tian1
sentences.english: "No, my friend, you're not an Earthling. You're a robot, and today is your first day."

sentences.hanzi: “先生，这个不贵！”
sentences.pinyin: xian1 sheng5 zhe4 ge5 bu4 gui4
sentences.english: "Sir, this isn't expensive!"

sentences.hanzi: “谢谢，我不买。”
sentences.pinyin: xie4 xie5 wo3 bu4 mai3
sentences.english: "Thanks, I'm not buying."

sentences.hanzi: “为什么不买？不喜欢吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 mai3 bu4 xi3 huan5 ma5
sentences.english: "Why not? Don't you like it?"

sentences.hanzi: “不是不喜欢，我不需要。”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 shi4 bu4 xi3 huan5 wo3 bu4 xu1 yao4
sentences.english: "It's not that I don't like it. I don't need it."

sentences.hanzi: “你朋友也不需要吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 peng2 you5 ye3 bu4 xu1 yao4 ma5
sentences.english: "Your friend doesn't need one either?"

sentences.hanzi: “他不在这里。我也没有钱。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 bu4 zai4 zhe4 li3 wo3 ye3 mei2 you3 qian2
sentences.english: "He isn't here. And I have no money."

sentences.hanzi: “没有钱？那这个不要钱，送你！”
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 qian2 na4 zhe4 ge5 bu4 yao4 qian2 song4 ni3
sentences.english: "No money? Then this one's free. It's a gift for you!"

sentences.hanzi: “不要钱？那我要！”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 yao4 qian2 na4 wo3 yao4
sentences.english: "Free? Then I want it!"

sentences.hanzi: 很多人看马可波罗的书。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 kan4 ma3 ke3 bo1 luo2 de5 shu1
sentences.english: Many people read Marco Polo's book.

sentences.hanzi: 书里没说长城，也没说茶。
sentences.pinyin: shu1 li3 mei2 shuo1 chang2 cheng2 ye3 mei2 shuo1 cha2
sentences.english: The book doesn't mention the Great Wall, and it doesn't mention tea.

sentences.hanzi: 有人说：“他没到中国！他没看到长城！”
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 shuo1 ta1 mei2 dao4 zhong1 guo2 ta1 mei2 kan4 dao4 chang2 cheng2
sentences.english: Some people say, "He never reached China! He never saw the Great Wall!"

sentences.hanzi: 马可波罗老的时候，朋友问他：“书里的事，你都看到了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke3 bo1 luo2 lao3 de5 shi2 hou5 peng2 you5 wen4 ta1 shu1 li3 de5 shi4 ni3 dou1 kan4 dao4 le5 ma5
sentences.english: When Marco Polo was old, a friend asked him, "Did you really see everything in your book?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“我看到的东西，我还没说一半。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 kan4 dao4 de5 dong1 xi5 wo3 hai2 mei2 shuo1 yi1 ban4
sentences.english: He said, "Of the things I saw, I haven't told half."

sentences.hanzi: “你好！这里是地球吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 hao3 zhe4 li3 shi4 di4 qiu2 ma5
sentences.english: "Hello! Is this Earth?"

sentences.hanzi: “是。你是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 ni3 shi4 shei2
sentences.english: "Yes. Who are you?"

sentences.hanzi: “我是外星人。你是地球人吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shi4 wai4 xing1 ren2 ni3 shi4 di4 qiu2 ren2 ma5
sentences.english: "I'm an alien. Are you an Earthling?"

sentences.hanzi: “是……你想做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 ni3 xiang3 zuo4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: "Yes... What do you want to do?"

sentences.hanzi: “我想问问。地球人喜欢朋友吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 wen4 wen5 di4 qiu2 ren2 xi3 huan5 peng2 you5 ma5
sentences.english: "I'd like to ask something. Do Earthlings like friends?"

sentences.hanzi: “喜欢！你们吃东西吗？”
sentences.pinyin: xi3 huan5 ni3 men5 chi1 dong1 xi5 ma5
sentences.english: "Yes! Do you eat?"

sentences.pinyin: chi1
sentences.english: "We do."

sentences.hanzi: “你们吃人吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 men5 chi1 ren2 ma5
sentences.english: "Do you eat people?"

sentences.hanzi: “不知道……你好吃吗？”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 ni3 hao3 chi1 ma5
sentences.english: "I don't know... Are you tasty?"

sentences.hanzi: 今天我和朋友要去西安。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 he2 peng2 you5 yao4 qu4 xi1 an1
sentences.english: Today my friend and I are going to Xi'an.

sentences.hanzi: “我的票在这里，你的呢？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 de5 piao4 zai4 zhe4 li3 ni3 de5 ne5
sentences.english: "My ticket's here. Where's yours?"

sentences.hanzi: “我的在包里。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 de5 zai4 bao1 li3
sentences.english: "Mine's in my bag."

sentences.hanzi: “包呢？”
sentences.pinyin: bao1 ne5
sentences.english: "And the bag?"

sentences.hanzi: “包在车上。”
sentences.pinyin: bao1 zai4 che1 shang4
sentences.english: "The bag's on the bus."

sentences.hanzi: “车呢？”
sentences.pinyin: che1 ne5
sentences.english: "And the bus?"

sentences.hanzi: 朋友看了看我，说：“车走了。”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 kan4 le5 kan4 wo3 shuo1 che1 zou3 le5
sentences.english: My friend looked at me and said, "The bus has left."

sentences.hanzi: “那我们呢？”
sentences.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 ne5
sentences.english: "And us?"

sentences.hanzi: “我们……还在这里。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 hai2 zai4 zhe4 li3
sentences.english: "Us... We're still here."

sentences.hanzi: “老先生，你看看我的手吧。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 xian1 sheng5 ni3 kan4 kan5 wo3 de5 shou3 ba5
sentences.english: "Sir, have a look at my hand, won't you?"

sentences.hanzi: 老先生看了看，说：“你有很多朋友吧？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 xian1 sheng5 kan4 le5 kan4 shuo1 ni3 you3 hen3 duo1 peng2 you5 ba5
sentences.english: The old man looked and said, "You have a lot of friends, I suppose?"

sentences.hanzi: “没有。”
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3
sentences.english: "No."

sentences.hanzi: “你有两个孩子吧？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 you3 liang3 ge4 hai2 zi5 ba5
sentences.english: "You have two children, I suppose?"

sentences.hanzi: “没有。”
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3
sentences.english: "No."

sentences.hanzi: “你……没有钱吧？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 mei2 you3 qian2 ba5
sentences.english: "You... have no money, I suppose?"

sentences.hanzi: “对！你怎么知道？”
sentences.pinyin: dui4 ni3 zen3 me5 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: "Right! How did you know?"

sentences.hanzi: 老先生说：“那你走吧。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 xian1 sheng5 shuo1 na4 ni3 zou3 ba5
sentences.english: The old man said, "Then off you go."

sentences.hanzi: 这是我的家。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wo3 de5 jia1
sentences.english: This is my home.

sentences.hanzi: 这是我的地方，那也是我的地方。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wo3 de5 di4 fang5 na4 ye3 shi4 wo3 de5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: This is my place, and that's my place too.

sentences.hanzi: 那个人是谁？他是我的人。
sentences.pinyin: na4 ge5 ren2 shi4 shei2 ta1 shi4 wo3 de5 ren2
sentences.english: Who's that person? He's my person.

sentences.hanzi: 他的钱是我的钱，他的东西也是我的东西。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 qian2 shi4 wo3 de5 qian2 ta1 de5 dong1 xi5 ye3 shi4 wo3 de5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: His money is my money, and his things are my things.

sentences.hanzi: 他的朋友来了，也要先看看我。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 peng2 you5 lai2 le5 ye3 yao4 xian1 kan4 kan5 wo3
sentences.english: When his friends come, they have to look at me first.

sentences.hanzi: 但是他不知道这些。
sentences.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 xie1
sentences.english: But he doesn't know any of this.

sentences.hanzi: 他对朋友说：“这是我的猫。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dui4 peng2 you5 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 wo3 de5 mao1
sentences.english: He tells his friends, "This is my cat."

sentences.hanzi: 他回来的时候，地球已经过了一百年。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hui2 lai5 de5 shi2 hou5 di4 qiu2 yi3 jing1 guo4 le5 yi1 bai3 nian2
sentences.english: By the time he came back, a hundred years had passed on Earth.

sentences.hanzi: 他小时候住的地方没有了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiao3 shi2 hou5 zhu4 de5 di4 fang5 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: The place he lived as a child was gone.

sentences.hanzi: 他认识的人都死了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ren4 shi5 de5 ren2 dou1 si3 le5
sentences.english: The people he knew had all died.

sentences.hanzi: 他喜欢的女孩，也不在了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xi3 huan5 de5 nu:3 hai2 ye3 bu4 zai4 le5
sentences.english: The girl he liked was gone too.

sentences.hanzi: 他看了看天上。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 tian1 shang4
sentences.english: He looked up at the sky.

sentences.hanzi: 只有他小时候看的月亮，还在那里。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 you3 ta1 xiao3 shi2 hou5 kan4 de5 yue4 liang5 hai2 zai4 na4 li5
sentences.english: Only the moon he looked at as a child was still there.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈，你好！我到火星了。
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 ni3 hao3 wo3 dao4 huo3 xing1 le5
sentences.english: Hello, Mum! I've reached Mars.

sentences.hanzi: 这里很大，也很新。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 hen3 da4 ye3 hen3 xin1
sentences.english: It's very big here, and very new.

sentences.hanzi: 天很红，也很冷。
sentences.pinyin: tian1 hen3 hong2 ye3 hen3 leng3
sentences.english: The sky is very red, and it's very cold.

sentences.hanzi: 工作很难，但是我很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: gong1 zuo4 hen3 nan2 dan4 shi4 wo3 hen3 gao1 xing4
sentences.english: The work is very hard, but I'm very happy.

sentences.hanzi: 朋友们都很好，我也很好。
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 men5 dou1 hen3 hao3 wo3 ye3 hen3 hao3
sentences.english: My friends are all well, and I'm well too.

sentences.hanzi: 从这里看，地球很小，很小。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 zhe4 li3 kan4 di4 qiu2 hen3 xiao3 hen3 xiao3
sentences.english: From here, Earth looks very small, very small.

sentences.hanzi: 你们都在那里。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 men5 dou1 zai4 na4 li5
sentences.english: All of you are there.

title: 船上的新朋友
titlePinyin: chuan2 shang4 de5 xin1 peng2 you5
titleEnglish: The new friend on the ship

sentences.hanzi: 郑和有两百多条船，两万多人。
sentences.pinyin: zheng4 he2 you3 liang3 bai3 duo1 tiao2 chuan2 liang3 wan4 duo1 ren2
sentences.english: Zheng He had over two hundred ships and over twenty thousand men.

sentences.hanzi: 他们去了三十几个地方，带回来很多东西。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 qu4 le5 san1 shi2 ji3 ge4 di4 fang5 dai4 hui2 lai2 hen3 duo1 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: They went to thirty-odd places and brought back many things.

sentences.hanzi: 有一次，船上来了一位新朋友。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 ci4 chuan2 shang4 lai2 le5 yi1 wei4 xin1 peng2 you5
sentences.english: Once, a new friend came on board.

sentences.hanzi: 它有一个小头，很长很长的腿。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 you3 yi1 ge5 xiao3 tou2 hen3 chang2 hen3 chang2 de5 tui3
sentences.english: It had one small head and very, very long legs.

sentences.hanzi: 大家都来看。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 lai2 kan4
sentences.english: Everyone came to look.

sentences.hanzi: 这位朋友是一只长颈鹿！
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 wei4 peng2 you5 shi4 yi1 zhi1 chang2 jing3 lu4
sentences.english: This friend was a giraffe!

sentences.hanzi: 我们到了一个新地方。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 dao4 le5 yi1 ge5 xin1 di4 fang5
sentences.english: We reached a new place.

sentences.hanzi: “这里有水吗？”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 you3 shui3 ma5
sentences.english: "Is there water here?"

sentences.hanzi: “有，有很多水。”
sentences.pinyin: you3 you3 hen3 duo1 shui3
sentences.english: "Yes, plenty of water."

sentences.hanzi: “有车吗？”
sentences.pinyin: you3 che1 ma5
sentences.english: "Are there cars?"

sentences.hanzi: “有，有很多车。”
sentences.pinyin: you3 you3 hen3 duo1 che1
sentences.english: "Yes, plenty of cars."

sentences.hanzi: “有人吗？”
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 ma5
sentences.english: "Are there people?"

sentences.hanzi: “没有。这里没有人，一个人也没有。”
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 zhe4 li3 mei2 you3 ren2 yi1 ge5 ren2 ye3 mei2 you3
sentences.english: "No. There are no people here, not one."

sentences.hanzi: “你再看看。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 zai4 kan4 kan5
sentences.english: "Look again."

sentences.hanzi: “等等……这里有一杯水。”
sentences.pinyin: deng3 deng3 zhe4 li3 you3 yi1 bei1 shui3
sentences.english: "Wait... There's a glass of water here."

sentences.hanzi: “一杯水怎么了？”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 bei1 shui3 zen3 me5 le5
sentences.english: "What about a glass of water?"

sentences.hanzi: “水是热的。”
sentences.pinyin: shui3 shi4 re4 de5
sentences.english: "The water is hot."

sentences.hanzi: “我在长城上。你在哪？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 chang2 cheng2 shang4 ni3 zai4 na3
sentences.english: "I'm on the Great Wall. Where are you?"

sentences.hanzi: “我也在长城上！但是我看不到你。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ye3 zai4 chang2 cheng2 shang4 dan4 shi4 wo3 kan4 bu4 dao4 ni3
sentences.english: "I'm on the Great Wall too! But I can't see you."

sentences.hanzi: “你在北京吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 zai4 bei3 jing1 ma5
sentences.english: "Are you in Beijing?"

sentences.hanzi: “不，我不在北京。我在嘉峪关。”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 wo3 bu4 zai4 bei3 jing1 wo3 zai4 jia1 yu4 guan1
sentences.english: "No, I'm not in Beijing. I'm at Jiayuguan."

sentences.hanzi: “嘉峪关在哪？”
sentences.pinyin: jia1 yu4 guan1 zai4 na3
sentences.english: "Where's Jiayuguan?"

sentences.hanzi: “在长城的那一头。”
sentences.pinyin: zai4 chang2 cheng2 de5 na4 yi1 tou2
sentences.english: "At the other end of the Great Wall."

sentences.hanzi: “好吧。你在那里等我，我走过去。”
sentences.pinyin: hao3 ba5 ni3 zai4 na4 li5 deng3 wo3 wo3 zou3 guo4 qu4
sentences.english: "All right. Wait for me there, and I'll walk over."

glossed.meaning: Jiayuguan, a fort at the Wall's western end

sentences.hanzi: 溥仪是中国最后一个皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: pu3 yi2 shi4 zhong1 guo2 zui4 hou4 yi1 ge5 huang2 di4
sentences.english: Puyi was China's last emperor.

sentences.hanzi: 他很小的时候，在故宫住，在故宫吃东西，在故宫当皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hen3 xiao3 de5 shi2 hou5 zai4 gu4 gong1 zhu4 zai4 gu4 gong1 chi1 dong1 xi5 zai4 gu4 gong1 dang1 huang2 di4
sentences.english: When he was very small, he lived in the Forbidden City, ate in the Forbidden City and was emperor in the Forbidden City.

sentences.hanzi: 很多年后，他不是皇帝了。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 nian2 hou4 ta1 bu4 shi4 huang2 di4 le5
sentences.english: Many years later, he was no longer emperor.

sentences.hanzi: 他在北京的一个花园工作。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 bei3 jing1 de5 yi1 ge5 hua1 yuan2 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: He worked in a garden in Beijing.

sentences.hanzi: 有人说，有一次他在故宫前买票，进故宫看自己以前的家。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 shuo1 you3 yi1 ci4 ta1 zai4 gu4 gong1 qian2 mai3 piao4 jin4 gu4 gong1 kan4 zi4 ji3 yi3 qian2 de5 jia1
sentences.english: Some say that once he bought a ticket outside the Forbidden City, and went in to see his old home.

sentences.hanzi: 现在，中国的孩子正在吃早饭。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 zhong1 guo2 de5 hai2 zi5 zheng4 zai4 chi1 zao3 fan4
sentences.english: Right now, children in China are eating breakfast.

sentences.hanzi: 美国的朋友在工作。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 guo2 de5 peng2 you5 zai4 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: Friends in America are working.

sentences.hanzi: 英国的人正在睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: ying1 guo2 de5 ren2 zheng4 zai4 shui4 jiao4
sentences.english: People in Britain are sleeping.

sentences.hanzi: 天上，有人正在看地球。
sentences.pinyin: tian1 shang4 you3 ren2 zheng4 zai4 kan4 di4 qiu2
sentences.english: Up in the sky, someone is looking at Earth.

sentences.hanzi: 你呢？你在做什么？
sentences.pinyin: ni3 ne5 ni3 zai4 zuo4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: And you? What are you doing?

sentences.hanzi: 我知道：你正在看中文！
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 ni3 zheng4 zai4 kan4 zhong1 wen2
sentences.english: I know: you're reading Chinese!

sentences.hanzi: “你好，我叫王明。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 hao3 wo3 jiao4 wang2 ming2
sentences.english: "Hello, my name is Wang Ming."

sentences.hanzi: “是吗？我也叫王明。”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 ma5 wo3 ye3 jiao4 wang2 ming2
sentences.english: "Really? My name is Wang Ming too."

sentences.hanzi: “我是西安人。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shi4 xi1 an1 ren2
sentences.english: "I'm from Xi'an."

sentences.hanzi: “我也是西安人。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ye3 shi4 xi1 an1 ren2
sentences.english: "I'm from Xi'an too."

sentences.hanzi: “我有两个孩子。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 you3 liang3 ge4 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: "I have two children."

sentences.hanzi: “我也有两个孩子。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ye3 you3 liang3 ge4 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: "I have two children too."

sentences.hanzi: “我不喜欢我的工作。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bu4 xi3 huan5 wo3 de5 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: "I don't like my job."

sentences.hanzi: “我也不喜欢。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ye3 bu4 xi3 huan5
sentences.english: "I don't like it either."

sentences.hanzi: “你……你是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 ni3 shi4 shei2
sentences.english: "You... Who are you?"

sentences.hanzi: 他看了看我，说：“我是三年后的你。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 wo3 shuo1 wo3 shi4 san1 nian2 hou4 de5 ni3
sentences.english: He looked at me and said, "I'm you, three years from now."

title: 他们都一样吗？
titlePinyin: ta1 men5 dou1 yi1 yang4 ma5

sentences.hanzi: 西安有八千个兵马俑。
sentences.pinyin: xi1 an1 you3 ba1 qian1 ge4 bing1 ma3 yong3
sentences.english: Xi'an has eight thousand Terracotta Warriors.

sentences.hanzi: 他们都是两千多年前的人，都在等皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 dou1 shi4 liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 de5 ren2 dou1 zai4 deng3 huang2 di4
sentences.english: They are all men from over two thousand years ago, all waiting for the emperor.

sentences.hanzi: 刚看到的时候，我们都觉得：他们都一样。
sentences.pinyin: gang1 kan4 dao4 de5 shi2 hou5 wo3 men5 dou1 jue2 de5 ta1 men5 dou1 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: When we first saw them, we all thought they were all the same.

sentences.hanzi: 但是你再看看：他们的脸都不一样！
sentences.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ni3 zai4 kan4 kan5 ta1 men5 de5 lian3 dou1 bu4 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: But look again: their faces are all different!

sentences.hanzi: 这个人很高兴，那个人很担心。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ren2 hen3 gao1 xing4 na4 ge5 ren2 hen3 dan1 xin1
sentences.english: This one is happy, that one is worried.

sentences.hanzi: 他们都叫什么名字？没有人知道。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 dou1 jiao4 shen2 me5 ming2 zi5 mei2 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: What were all their names? Nobody knows.

sentences.hanzi: 秦始皇什么都有，但是他不想死。
sentences.pinyin: qin2 shi3 huang2 shen2 me5 dou1 you3 dan4 shi4 ta1 bu4 xiang3 si3
sentences.english: Qin Shi Huang had everything, but he didn't want to die.

sentences.hanzi: 他想找一种东西，吃了就不死。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 zhao3 yi1 zhong3 dong1 xi5 chi1 le5 jiu4 bu4 si3
sentences.english: He wanted to find something that would stop him dying once he ate it.

sentences.hanzi: 徐福说：“我想去海上找一找。”
sentences.pinyin: xu2 fu2 shuo1 wo3 xiang3 qu4 hai3 shang4 zhao3 yi1 zhao3
sentences.english: Xu Fu said, "I'd like to go and look for it at sea."

sentences.hanzi: 秦始皇给了他很多钱和很多人。
sentences.pinyin: qin2 shi3 huang2 gei3 le5 ta1 hen3 duo1 qian2 he2 hen3 duo1 ren2
sentences.english: Qin Shi Huang gave him a lot of money and a lot of people.

sentences.hanzi: 徐福走了，最后没有回来。
sentences.pinyin: xu2 fu2 zou3 le5 zui4 hou4 mei2 you3 hui2 lai5
sentences.english: Xu Fu left, and in the end he didn't come back.

sentences.hanzi: 也许徐福不想回来：他也不想死。
sentences.pinyin: ye3 xu3 xu2 fu2 bu4 xiang3 hui2 lai5 ta1 ye3 bu4 xiang3 si3
sentences.english: Perhaps Xu Fu didn't want to come back: he didn't want to die either.

glossed.meaning: Qin Shi Huang, China's first emperor

sentences.hanzi: 玄奘说：“我要去印度，我要找一些书。”
sentences.pinyin: xuan2 zang4 shuo1 wo3 yao4 qu4 yin4 du4 wo3 yao4 zhao3 yi1 xie1 shu1
sentences.english: Xuanzang said, "I'm going to India. I'm going to find some books."

sentences.hanzi: 朋友说：“不要去！你会死的。”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 shuo1 bu4 yao4 qu4 ni3 hui4 si3 de5
sentences.english: His friends said, "Don't go! You'll die."

sentences.hanzi: 皇帝也不让他去。
sentences.pinyin: huang2 di4 ye3 bu4 rang4 ta1 qu4
sentences.english: The emperor wouldn't let him go either.

sentences.hanzi: 玄奘还是走了。
sentences.pinyin: xuan2 zang4 hai2 shi5 zou3 le5
sentences.english: Xuanzang went anyway.

sentences.hanzi: 很多年后，他回来了，带回来很多书。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 nian2 hou4 ta1 hui2 lai5 le5 dai4 hui2 lai2 hen3 duo1 shu1
sentences.english: Many years later he came back, bringing many books.

sentences.hanzi: 皇帝问：“你要什么？”
sentences.pinyin: huang2 di4 wen4 ni3 yao4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: The emperor asked, "What do you want?"

sentences.hanzi: 玄奘说：“我什么都不要。我要翻译这些书。”
sentences.pinyin: xuan2 zang4 shuo1 wo3 shen2 me5 dou1 bu4 yao4 wo3 yao4 fan1 yi4 zhe4 xie1 shu1
sentences.english: Xuanzang said, "I want nothing. I'm going to translate these books."

sentences.hanzi: 老板问新来的机器人：“你会说中文吗？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ban3 wen4 xin1 lai2 de5 ji1 qi4 ren2 ni3 hui4 shuo1 zhong1 wen2 ma5
sentences.english: The boss asked the new robot, "Can you speak Chinese?"

sentences.pinyin: hui4
sentences.english: "Yes."

sentences.hanzi: “你会开车吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 hui4 kai1 che1 ma5
sentences.english: "Can you drive?"

sentences.pinyin: hui4
sentences.english: "Yes."

sentences.hanzi: “你还会什么？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 hai2 hui4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: "What else can you do?"

sentences.hanzi: “我还会做你的工作。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 hai2 hui4 zuo4 ni3 de5 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: "I can also do your job."

sentences.hanzi: 老板看了看它。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ban3 kan4 le5 kan4 ta1
sentences.english: The boss looked at it.

sentences.hanzi: 它说：“很快，这里会有一个新老板。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 hen3 kuai4 zhe4 li3 hui4 you3 yi1 ge5 xin1 lao3 ban3
sentences.english: It said, "Soon there will be a new boss here."

sentences.hanzi: 我的手机不能用了，但是我想买东西。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 de5 shou3 ji1 bu4 neng2 yong4 le5 dan4 shi4 wo3 xiang3 mai3 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: My phone had stopped working, but I wanted to buy something.

sentences.hanzi: 这里就一个孩子。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 jiu4 yi1 ge5 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: There was only one child here.

sentences.hanzi: “你好！我能用现金吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 hao3 wo3 neng2 yong4 xian4 jin1 ma5
sentences.english: "Hello! Can I use cash?"

sentences.hanzi: “现金？”孩子看了看我的钱。“这是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: xian4 jin1 hai2 zi5 kan4 le5 kan4 wo3 de5 qian2 zhe4 shi4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: "Cash?" The child looked at my money. "What's this?"

sentences.hanzi: “这是钱啊！你能问问爸爸吗？”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 qian2 a5 ni3 neng2 wen4 wen5 ba4 ba5 ma5
sentences.english: "It's money! Can you ask your dad?"

sentences.hanzi: “他今天不能来。这个真能买东西吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 jin1 tian1 bu4 neng2 lai2 zhe4 ge5 zhen1 neng2 mai3 dong1 xi5 ma5
sentences.english: "He can't come today. Can this really buy things?"

sentences.hanzi: 以前，故宫的中门只有皇帝可以走。
sentences.pinyin: yi3 qian2 gu4 gong1 de5 zhong1 men2 zhi3 you3 huang2 di4 ke3 yi3 zou3
sentences.english: In the past, only the emperor could use the central gate of the Forbidden City.

sentences.hanzi: 皇帝的朋友可以走吗？不可以。
sentences.pinyin: huang2 di4 de5 peng2 you5 ke3 yi3 zou3 ma5 bu4 ke3 yi3
sentences.english: Could the emperor's friends use it? They could not.

sentences.hanzi: 皇帝的孩子可以走吗？也不可以。
sentences.pinyin: huang2 di4 de5 hai2 zi5 ke3 yi3 zou3 ma5 ye3 bu4 ke3 yi3
sentences.english: Could the emperor's children use it? They couldn't either.

sentences.hanzi: 但是，考试的前三个人也可以。
sentences.pinyin: dan4 shi4 kao3 shi4 de5 qian2 san1 ge4 ren2 ye3 ke3 yi3
sentences.english: But the top three in the exam could too.

sentences.hanzi: 他们可以走一次，只有一次。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 ke3 yi3 zou3 yi1 ci4 zhi3 you3 yi1 ci4
sentences.english: They could use it once, and only once.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，很多没有钱的孩子都想：我也可以！
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 hen3 duo1 mei2 you3 qian2 de5 hai2 zi5 dou1 xiang3 wo3 ye3 ke3 yi3
sentences.english: So many children with no money thought: I can too!

title: 吃还是不吃？
titleEnglish: To eat or not to eat?

sentences.hanzi: 我到朋友家，他妈妈给了我很多东西吃。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 dao4 peng2 you5 jia1 ta1 ma1 ma5 gei3 le5 wo3 hen3 duo1 dong1 xi5 chi1
sentences.english: I went to a friend's home, and his mum gave me lots to eat.

sentences.hanzi: 我想，我应该吃完。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 wo3 ying1 gai1 chi1 wan2
sentences.english: I thought I should finish it.

sentences.hanzi: 我吃完了，她又给我很多。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 chi1 wan2 le5 ta1 you4 gei3 wo3 hen3 duo1
sentences.english: I finished it, and she gave me lots more.

sentences.hanzi: 我又吃完了，她又给我。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 you4 chi1 wan2 le5 ta1 you4 gei3 wo3
sentences.english: I finished again, and she gave me more again.

sentences.hanzi: 朋友说：“你不应该都吃完！你应该留一点。”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 shuo1 ni3 bu4 ying1 gai1 dou1 chi1 wan2 ni3 ying1 gai1 liu2 yi1 dian3
sentences.english: My friend said, "You shouldn't finish everything! You should leave a little."

sentences.hanzi: 我留了一点。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 liu2 le5 yi1 dian3
sentences.english: I left a little.

sentences.hanzi: 他妈妈看了看，问：“不好吃吗？你应该多吃一点！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ma1 ma5 kan4 le5 kan4 wen4 bu4 hao3 chi1 ma5 ni3 ying1 gai1 duo1 chi1 yi1 dian3
sentences.english: His mum looked and asked, "Isn't it good? You should eat a bit more!"

sentences.hanzi: 张骞带了一百多个人，去西方找朋友。
sentences.pinyin: zhang1 qian1 dai4 le5 yi1 bai3 duo1 ge4 ren2 qu4 xi1 fang1 zhao3 peng2 you5
sentences.english: Zhang Qian took over a hundred men and went west to find allies.

sentences.hanzi: 他们到了匈奴人那里，不能走了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 dao4 le5 xiong1 nu2 ren2 na4 li5 bu4 neng2 zou3 le5
sentences.english: They reached the Xiongnu and could go no further.

sentences.hanzi: 他在那里住了很多年，有了一个孩子，但是他一直想走。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 na4 li5 zhu4 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2 you3 le5 yi1 ge5 hai2 zi5 dan4 shi4 ta1 yi1 zhi2 xiang3 zou3
sentences.english: He lived there for many years and had a child, but he always wanted to leave.

sentences.hanzi: 最后，他离开了匈奴。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ta1 li2 kai1 le5 xiong1 nu2
sentences.english: In the end, he got away from the Xiongnu.

sentences.hanzi: 他走了十三年。走的时候一百多个人，回来的时候两个人。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 le5 shi2 san1 nian2 zou3 de5 shi2 hou5 yi1 bai3 duo1 ge4 ren2 hui2 lai5 de5 shi2 hou5 liang3 ge4 ren2
sentences.english: He was gone for thirteen years. Over a hundred men when they left, two when they came back.

sentences.hanzi: 但是，他给中国带回来了一个新世界。
sentences.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 gei3 zhong1 guo2 dai4 hui2 lai2 le5 yi1 ge5 xin1 shi4 jie4
sentences.english: But he brought China a new world.

sentences.hanzi: 以前，我们这里没有车，也没有电话。
sentences.pinyin: yi3 qian2 wo3 men5 zhe4 li3 mei2 you3 che1 ye3 mei2 you3 dian4 hua4
sentences.english: In the past, we had no cars here, and no telephones.

sentences.hanzi: 孩子很多，大家都很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 hen3 duo1 da4 jia1 dou1 hen3 gao1 xing4
sentences.english: There were lots of children, and everyone was happy.

sentences.hanzi: 过了很多年，这里有车了，有电话了，也有手机了。
sentences.pinyin: guo4 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2 zhe4 li3 you3 che1 le5 you3 dian4 hua4 le5 ye3 you3 shou3 ji1 le5
sentences.english: Many years on, cars came here, telephones came, and mobile phones too.

sentences.hanzi: 孩子们大了，都去大地方工作了。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 men5 da4 le5 dou1 qu4 da4 di4 fang5 gong1 zuo4 le5
sentences.english: The children grew up, and they've all gone to big places to work.

sentences.hanzi: 现在，这里什么都有了，就是没有人了。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 zhe4 li3 shen2 me5 dou1 you3 le5 jiu4 shi4 mei2 you3 ren2 le5
sentences.english: Now there's everything here, except people.

sentences.hanzi: 车上，一位老先生对我说：“我见过秦始皇。”
sentences.pinyin: che1 shang4 yi1 wei4 lao3 xian1 sheng5 dui4 wo3 shuo1 wo3 jian4 guo5 qin2 shi3 huang2
sentences.english: On the bus, an old man said to me, "I've met Qin Shi Huang."

sentences.hanzi: “是吗？”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 ma5
sentences.english: "Is that so?"

sentences.hanzi: “是。我也去过唐朝，见过李白。”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 wo3 ye3 qu4 guo5 tang2 chao2 jian4 guo5 li3 bai2
sentences.english: "It is. I've also been to the Tang dynasty and met Li Bai."

sentences.hanzi: “老先生，我没见过你这样的人。你看过医生吗？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 xian1 sheng5 wo3 mei2 jian4 guo5 ni3 zhe4 yang4 de5 ren2 ni3 kan4 guo5 yi1 sheng1 ma5
sentences.english: "Sir, I've never met anyone like you. Have you seen a doctor?"

sentences.hanzi: “看过。”他说，“那个医生叫华佗。”
sentences.pinyin: kan4 guo5 ta1 shuo1 na4 ge5 yi1 sheng1 jiao4 hua4 tuo2
sentences.english: "I have," he said. "The doctor's name was Hua Tuo."

glossed.meaning: Qin Shi Huang, China's first emperor
Hua Tuo, famous doctor of about 1,800 years ago

sentences.hanzi: “这是在哪儿买的？”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zai4 na3 r5 mai3 de5
sentences.english: "Where did you buy this?"

sentences.hanzi: “是在西安买的。”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 zai4 xi1 an1 mai3 de5
sentences.english: "I bought it in Xi'an."

sentences.hanzi: “是谁卖给你的？”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 shei2 mai4 gei3 ni3 de5
sentences.english: "Who sold it to you?"

sentences.hanzi: “是一位老人卖给我的。他说这是唐朝的东西。”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2 mai4 gei3 wo3 de5 ta1 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 tang2 chao2 de5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: "An old man sold it to me. He said it's from the Tang dynasty."

sentences.hanzi: “你是花多少钱买的？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 shi4 hua1 duo1 shao5 qian2 mai3 de5
sentences.english: "How much did you pay for it?"

sentences.hanzi: “八千块。”
sentences.pinyin: ba1 qian1 kuai4
sentences.english: "Eight thousand yuan."

sentences.hanzi: 朋友看了看，说：“这不是唐朝的，是去年做的。”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 kan4 le5 kan4 shuo1 zhe4 bu4 shi4 tang2 chao2 de5 shi4 qu4 nian2 zuo4 de5
sentences.english: My friend looked at it and said, "This isn't from the Tang. It was made last year."

sentences.hanzi: “你是怎么知道的？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 shi4 zen3 me5 zhi1 dao4 de5
sentences.english: "How do you know?"

sentences.hanzi: “是我做的。”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 wo3 zuo4 de5
sentences.english: "I made it."

sentences.hanzi: 她穿着新衣服，头上盖着红布，在里面坐着。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 chuan1 zhe5 xin1 yi1 fu5 tou2 shang4 gai4 zhe5 hong2 bu4 zai4 li3 mian4 zuo4 zhe5
sentences.english: She was wearing new clothes, with a red veil over her head, sitting inside.

sentences.hanzi: 她不认识今天要来的那个男人。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 bu4 ren4 shi5 jin1 tian1 yao4 lai2 de5 na4 ge5 nan2 ren2
sentences.english: She didn't know the man who was coming today.

sentences.hanzi: 她想着另一个人：那一天，那个拿着花，一直看着她的人。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 zhe5 ling4 yi1 ge5 ren2 na4 yi1 tian1 na4 ge5 na2 zhe5 hua1 yi1 zhi2 kan4 zhe5 ta1 de5 ren2
sentences.english: She was thinking of someone else: that day, the man holding flowers, who kept looking at her.

sentences.hanzi: 门开了，一个男人走进来，也拿着花。
sentences.pinyin: men2 kai1 le5 yi1 ge5 nan2 ren2 zou3 jin4 lai2 ye3 na2 zhe5 hua1
sentences.english: The door opened and a man walked in, also holding flowers.

sentences.hanzi: 他拿开红布。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 na2 kai1 hong2 bu4
sentences.english: He lifted away the veil.

sentences.hanzi: 她看着他：是你！
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 zhe5 ta1 shi4 ni3
sentences.english: She looked at him: it's you!

sentences.hanzi: “我要走了。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 yao4 zou3 le5
sentences.english: "I'm about to go."

sentences.hanzi: “别走！再坐一下吧。”
sentences.pinyin: bie2 zou3 zai4 zuo4 yi1 xia4 ba5
sentences.english: "Don't go! Sit a little longer."

sentences.hanzi: 一个小时后。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 xiao3 shi2 hou4
sentences.english: An hour later.

sentences.hanzi: “我真要走了，车快要开了。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhen1 yao4 zou3 le5 che1 kuai4 yao4 kai1 le5
sentences.english: "I really am going now. The bus is about to leave."

sentences.hanzi: “还有时间，再喝一杯吧。”
sentences.pinyin: hai2 you3 shi2 jian1 zai4 he1 yi1 bei1 ba5
sentences.english: "There's still time. Have another drink."

sentences.hanzi: 又一个小时后。
sentences.pinyin: you4 yi1 ge5 xiao3 shi2 hou4
sentences.english: Another hour later.

sentences.hanzi: “车已经走了。”他说，“今晚我要住你家了。”
sentences.pinyin: che1 yi3 jing1 zou3 le5 ta1 shuo1 jin1 wan3 wo3 yao4 zhu4 ni3 jia1 le5
sentences.english: "The bus has gone," he said. "Looks like I'm staying at yours tonight."

sentences.hanzi: 朋友想了想，说：“我……我要走了。”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 wo3 wo3 yao4 zou3 le5
sentences.english: His friend thought for a moment and said, "I... I'm about to go."

sentences.hanzi: 一百多年前，中国有了火车。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 zhong1 guo2 you3 le5 huo3 che1
sentences.english: Over a hundred years ago, China got trains.

sentences.hanzi: 火车比马快，比马大，能带的东西也比马多。
sentences.pinyin: huo3 che1 bi3 ma3 kuai4 bi3 ma3 da4 neng2 dai4 de5 dong1 xi5 ye3 bi3 ma3 duo1
sentences.english: A train is faster than a horse and bigger than a horse, and it can carry more than a horse.

sentences.hanzi: 大家都说：“火车比马好！”
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 shuo1 huo3 che1 bi3 ma3 hao3
sentences.english: Everyone said, "Trains are better than horses!"

sentences.hanzi: 但是有人说：“火车走过，死了的皇帝也不高兴！”
sentences.pinyin: dan4 shi4 you3 ren2 shuo1 huo3 che1 zou3 guo4 si3 le5 de5 huang2 di4 ye3 bu4 gao1 xing4
sentences.english: But some people said, "When a train goes past, even the dead emperors are unhappy!"

sentences.hanzi: 还有人说，那时候他们让马带着火车走。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 you3 ren2 shuo1 na4 shi2 hou5 ta1 men5 rang4 ma3 dai4 zhe5 huo3 che1 zou3
sentences.english: Others say that for a time they had horses pull the train.

sentences.hanzi: 这样的火车，比马大，但是比马快吗？
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 de5 huo3 che1 bi3 ma3 da4 dan4 shi4 bi3 ma3 kuai4 ma5
sentences.english: A train like that is bigger than a horse, but is it faster than a horse?

sentences.hanzi: 老王和老李一起吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 wang2 he2 lao3 li3 yi1 qi3 chi1 fan4
sentences.english: Lao Wang and Lao Li were having a meal together.

sentences.hanzi: “老李，你家真漂亮！”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 li3 ni3 jia1 zhen1 piao4 liang5
sentences.english: "Lao Li, your home is really lovely!"

sentences.hanzi: “哪里，我家没有你家大，也没有你家新。”
sentences.pinyin: na3 li3 wo3 jia1 mei2 you3 ni3 jia1 da4 ye3 mei2 you3 ni3 jia1 xin1
sentences.english: "Oh no, my home isn't as big as yours, or as new as yours."

sentences.hanzi: “你的孩子真聪明！”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 de5 hai2 zi5 zhen1 cong1 ming5
sentences.english: "Your child is really clever!"

sentences.hanzi: “哪里，他没有你的孩子那么聪明。”
sentences.pinyin: na3 li3 ta1 mei2 you3 ni3 de5 hai2 zi5 na4 me5 cong1 ming5
sentences.english: "Oh no, he isn't as clever as your child."

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，老板来了：“两位，谁给钱？”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 lao3 ban3 lai2 le5 liang3 wei4 shei2 gei3 qian2
sentences.english: Just then the owner came over. "Gentlemen, who's paying?"

sentences.hanzi: 两个人都说：“你！我没有你有钱！”
sentences.pinyin: liang3 ge4 ren2 dou1 shuo1 ni3 wo3 mei2 you3 ni3 you3 qian2
sentences.english: They both said, "You! I'm not as rich as you!"

sentences.hanzi: 在杭州，我看到一个很高的塔。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 hang2 zhou1 wo3 kan4 dao4 yi1 ge5 hen3 gao1 de5 ta3
sentences.english: In Hangzhou, I saw a very tall tower.

sentences.hanzi: 它跟巴黎的塔一样漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 gen1 ba1 li2 de5 ta3 yi1 yang4 piao4 liang5
sentences.english: It was as beautiful as the tower in Paris.

sentences.hanzi: 这里的房子也跟巴黎的房子一样，路也跟巴黎的路一样。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 de5 fang2 zi5 ye3 gen1 ba1 li2 de5 fang2 zi5 yi1 yang4 lu4 ye3 gen1 ba1 li2 de5 lu4 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: The houses here were the same as the houses in Paris, and the roads were the same as the roads in Paris.

sentences.hanzi: 我问一位老人：“这里跟巴黎一样吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2 zhe4 li3 gen1 ba1 li2 yi1 yang4 ma5
sentences.english: I asked an old man, "Is it the same as Paris here?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“我不知道，我没去过巴黎。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 wo3 mei2 qu4 guo5 ba1 li2
sentences.english: He said, "I don't know. I've never been to Paris."

sentences.hanzi: “可是我的孩子去过。他说，巴黎跟我们这里一样！”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 de5 hai2 zi5 qu4 guo5 ta1 shuo1 ba1 li2 gen1 wo3 men5 zhe4 li3 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: "But my child has. He says Paris is the same as here!"

sentences.hanzi: 在济南，有人对我说：“这里的水最好。”
sentences.pinyin: zai4 ji3 nan2 you3 ren2 dui4 wo3 shuo1 zhe4 li3 de5 shui3 zui4 hao3
sentences.english: In Jinan, someone said to me, "The water here is the best."

sentences.hanzi: 在镇江，也有人说：“这里的水最好。”
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zhen4 jiang1 ye3 you3 ren2 shuo1 zhe4 li3 de5 shui3 zui4 hao3
sentences.english: In Zhenjiang, someone also said, "The water here is the best."

sentences.hanzi: 到了庐山，又有人说：“我们这里的水最好！”
sentences.pinyin: dao4 le5 lu2 shan1 you4 you3 ren2 shuo1 wo3 men5 zhe4 li3 de5 shui3 zui4 hao3
sentences.english: When I got to Mount Lu, someone else said, "Our water here is the best!"

sentences.hanzi: 我问一位老人：“什么地方的水最好？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2 shen2 me5 di4 fang5 de5 shui3 zui4 hao3
sentences.english: I asked an old man, "Where is the water best?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“你最渴的地方，水最好。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ni3 zui4 ke3 de5 di4 fang5 shui3 zui4 hao3
sentences.english: He said, "Where you're thirstiest, the water is best."

sentences.hanzi: 朋友说：“我们走上泰山吧！”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 shuo1 wo3 men5 zou3 shang4 tai4 shan1 ba5
sentences.english: My friend said, "Let's walk up Mount Tai!"

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“太好了！”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 tai4 hao3 le5
sentences.english: I said, "Great!"

sentences.hanzi: 走了一个小时，朋友说：“太难了！”
sentences.pinyin: zou3 le5 yi1 ge5 xiao3 shi2 peng2 you5 shuo1 tai4 nan2 le5
sentences.english: After an hour's walking, my friend said, "This is too hard!"

sentences.hanzi: 走了三个小时，我说：“太累了！”
sentences.pinyin: zou3 le5 san1 ge4 xiao3 shi2 wo3 shuo1 tai4 lei4 le5
sentences.english: After three hours' walking, I said, "I'm so tired!"

sentences.hanzi: 到了山上，我们看到一位老人。
sentences.pinyin: dao4 le5 shan1 shang4 wo3 men5 kan4 dao4 yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2
sentences.english: At the top, we saw an old man.

sentences.hanzi: “老先生，你也走了三个小时吗？太棒了！”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 xian1 sheng5 ni3 ye3 zou3 le5 san1 ge4 xiao3 shi2 ma5 tai4 bang4 le5
sentences.english: "Sir, did you walk for three hours too? That's wonderful!"

sentences.hanzi: 老人说：“我坐车。这里有车，你们不知道吗？你们太年轻了！”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 shuo1 wo3 zuo4 che1 zhe4 li3 you3 che1 ni3 men5 bu4 zhi1 dao4 ma5 ni3 men5 tai4 nian2 qing1 le5
sentences.english: The old man said, "I rode up. You can ride up here, didn't you know? You're too young!"

sentences.hanzi: 因为妈妈想看长城，所以我们去了北京。
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ma1 ma5 xiang3 kan4 chang2 cheng2 suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 qu4 le5 bei3 jing1
sentences.english: Because Mum wanted to see the Great Wall, we went to Beijing.

sentences.hanzi: 因为人太多，所以我们走了很久。
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ren2 tai4 duo1 suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 zou3 le5 hen3 jiu3
sentences.english: Because there were too many people, we walked for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 因为走了很久，所以到了晚上，我们还在长城上。
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zou3 le5 hen3 jiu3 suo3 yi3 dao4 le5 wan3 shang5 wo3 men5 hai2 zai4 chang2 cheng2 shang4
sentences.english: Because we walked for so long, we were still on the Wall when night came.

sentences.hanzi: 因为太晚了，所以没有车回去。
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 tai4 wan3 le5 suo3 yi3 mei2 you3 che1 hui2 qu5
sentences.english: Because it was too late, there were no buses back.

sentences.hanzi: 我很担心，可是妈妈很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 hen3 dan1 xin1 ke3 shi4 ma1 ma5 hen3 gao1 xing4
sentences.english: I was worried, but Mum was delighted.

sentences.hanzi: 她说：“太好了！因为没有车，所以今晚可以看星星了！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 tai4 hao3 le5 yin1 wei4 mei2 you3 che1 suo3 yi3 jin1 wan3 ke3 yi3 kan4 xing1 xing5 le5
sentences.english: She said, "Wonderful! Because there's no bus, we can watch the stars tonight!"

sentences.hanzi: 老王住在长城下。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 wang2 zhu4 zai4 chang2 cheng2 xia4
sentences.english: Old Wang lives at the foot of the Great Wall.

sentences.hanzi: 虽然他七十岁了，但是天天都走上长城。
sentences.pinyin: sui1 ran2 ta1 qi1 shi2 sui4 le5 dan4 shi4 tian1 tian1 dou1 zou3 shang4 chang2 cheng2
sentences.english: Although he's seventy, he walks up onto the Wall every day.

sentences.hanzi: 虽然他只会说中文，但是美国人都喜欢跟他一起走。
sentences.pinyin: sui1 ran2 ta1 zhi3 hui4 shuo1 zhong1 wen2 dan4 shi4 mei3 guo2 ren2 dou1 xi3 huan5 gen1 ta1 yi1 qi3 zou3
sentences.english: Although he only speaks Chinese, Americans all like walking with him.

sentences.hanzi: 虽然他们不明白他说什么，但是都明白他的手。
sentences.pinyin: sui1 ran2 ta1 men5 bu4 ming2 bai5 ta1 shuo1 shen2 me5 dan4 shi4 dou1 ming2 bai5 ta1 de5 shou3
sentences.english: Although they don't understand his words, they all understand his hands.

sentences.hanzi: 老王说：“虽然我老了，但是我的手不老。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 wang2 shuo1 sui1 ran2 wo3 lao3 le5 dan4 shi4 wo3 de5 shou3 bu4 lao3
sentences.english: Old Wang says, "Although I've grown old, my hands haven't."

sentences.hanzi: 小王做了一个时间机器。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 wang2 zuo4 le5 yi1 ge5 shi2 jian1 ji1 qi4
sentences.english: Xiao Wang built a time machine.

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“如果你想看秦朝，我就送你去。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ru2 guo3 ni3 xiang3 kan4 qin2 chao2 wo3 jiu4 song4 ni3 qu4
sentences.english: He said, "If you want to see the Qin dynasty, I'll send you there."

sentences.hanzi: “如果有人要杀我呢？”
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 you3 ren2 yao4 sha1 wo3 ne5
sentences.english: "What if someone tries to kill me?"

sentences.hanzi: “如果有人要杀你，你就快跑。”
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 you3 ren2 yao4 sha1 ni3 ni3 jiu4 kuai4 pao3
sentences.english: "If someone tries to kill you, run fast."

sentences.hanzi: “如果我跑不快呢？”
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 pao3 bu4 kuai4 ne5
sentences.english: "What if I can't run fast?"

sentences.hanzi: “如果跑不快，你就回来。”
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 pao3 bu4 kuai4 ni3 jiu4 hui2 lai5
sentences.english: "If you can't run fast, come back."

sentences.hanzi: “如果我回不来呢？”
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 hui2 bu4 lai2 ne5
sentences.english: "What if I can't get back?"

sentences.hanzi: 他想了想，说：“如果回不来，你就给我打电话。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 ru2 guo3 hui2 bu4 lai2 ni3 jiu4 gei3 wo3 da3 dian4 hua4
sentences.english: He thought for a moment and said, "If you can't get back, give me a call."

title: 最奇怪的东西
titlePinyin: zui4 qi2 guai4 de5 dong1 xi5

sentences.hanzi: 郑和是明朝人。
sentences.pinyin: zheng4 he2 shi4 ming2 chao2 ren2
sentences.english: Zheng He lived in the Ming dynasty.

sentences.hanzi: 他不但去过很多地方，而且到过非洲。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 bu4 dan4 qu4 guo5 hen3 duo1 di4 fang5 er2 qie3 dao4 guo5 fei1 zhou1
sentences.english: He not only went to many places, but even reached Africa.

sentences.hanzi: 他带回来的东西不但多，而且奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dai4 hui2 lai2 de5 dong1 xi5 bu4 dan4 duo1 er2 qie3 qi2 guai4
sentences.english: The things he brought back were not only many, but strange.

sentences.hanzi: 最奇怪的是一只长颈鹿。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 qi2 guai4 de5 shi4 yi1 zhi1 chang2 jing3 lu4
sentences.english: The strangest was a giraffe.

sentences.hanzi: 它不但很高，而且很漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 bu4 dan4 hen3 gao1 er2 qie3 hen3 piao4 liang5
sentences.english: It was not only tall, but beautiful.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候，中国人不但没见过它，而且叫它麒麟。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 zhong1 guo2 ren2 bu4 dan4 mei2 jian4 guo5 ta1 er2 qie3 jiao4 ta1 qi2 lin2
sentences.english: The Chinese of the time had not only never seen one, they called it a qilin.

title: 火星上的老马
titlePinyin: huo3 xing1 shang4 de5 lao3 ma3

sentences.hanzi: 在火星上，老马一个人工作。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 huo3 xing1 shang4 lao3 ma3 yi1 ge5 ren2 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: On Mars, Old Ma works alone.

sentences.hanzi: 他一边工作，一边说话。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 bian1 gong1 zuo4 yi1 bian1 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: He talks while he works.

sentences.hanzi: 他一边吃东西，一边说话。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 bian1 chi1 dong1 xi5 yi1 bian1 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: He talks while he eats.

sentences.hanzi: 他一边走，一边说话。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 bian1 zou3 yi1 bian1 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: He talks while he walks.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，妈妈打电话问他：“你在跟谁说话？”
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 ma1 ma5 da3 dian4 hua4 wen4 ta1 ni3 zai4 gen1 shei2 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: One day his mother phoned and asked, "Who are you talking to?"

sentences.hanzi: 他一边走，一边说：“跟我自己。如果不说话，我会忘了中文。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 bian1 zou3 yi1 bian1 shuo1 gen1 wo3 zi4 ji3 ru2 guo3 bu4 shuo1 hua4 wo3 hui4 wang4 le5 zhong1 wen2
sentences.english: Walking along, he said, "Myself. If I don't talk, I'll forget my Chinese."

title: 先吃还是先看
titlePinyin: xian1 chi1 hai2 shi5 xian1 kan4

sentences.hanzi: 到了西安，小李说：“我们先看兵马俑，再吃东西。”
sentences.pinyin: dao4 le5 xi1 an1 xiao3 li3 shuo1 wo3 men5 xian1 kan4 bing1 ma3 yong3 zai4 chi1 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: When we got to Xi'an, Xiao Li said, "Let's see the Terracotta Warriors first, then eat."

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“不，先吃东西，再看兵马俑。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 bu4 xian1 chi1 dong1 xi5 zai4 kan4 bing1 ma3 yong3
sentences.english: I said, "No, let's eat first, then see the Warriors."

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“那我们先问问西安的朋友，再决定吧。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 na4 wo3 men5 xian1 wen4 wen5 xi1 an1 de5 peng2 you5 zai4 jue2 ding4 ba5
sentences.english: He said, "Then let's ask our friend from Xi'an first, and then decide."

sentences.hanzi: 朋友说：“你们都错了。先吃，再看，看完再吃。”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 shuo1 ni3 men5 dou1 cuo4 le5 xian1 chi1 zai4 kan4 kan4 wan2 zai4 chi1
sentences.english: Our friend said, "You're both wrong. Eat first, then look, and when you've finished looking, eat again."

sentences.hanzi: 朋友带我去吃臭豆腐。
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 dai4 wo3 qu4 chi1 chou4 dou4 fu5
sentences.english: My friend took me to eat stinky tofu.

sentences.hanzi: 那个地方又小又老，又远又难找。
sentences.pinyin: na4 ge5 di4 fang5 you4 xiao3 you4 lao3 you4 yuan3 you4 nan2 zhao3
sentences.english: The place was small and old, far away and hard to find.

sentences.hanzi: 臭豆腐来了，又大又臭。
sentences.pinyin: chou4 dou4 fu5 lai2 le5 you4 da4 you4 chou4
sentences.english: The tofu arrived, big and smelly.

sentences.hanzi: 我不想吃。朋友说：“试试！”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bu4 xiang3 chi1 peng2 you5 shuo1 shi4 shi5
sentences.english: I didn't want to eat it. My friend said, "Try it!"

sentences.hanzi: 我吃了一点。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 chi1 le5 yi1 dian3
sentences.english: I ate a little.

sentences.hanzi: 哇！这东西又臭又好吃！
sentences.pinyin: wa1 zhe4 dong1 xi5 you4 chou4 you4 hao3 chi1
sentences.english: Wow! This stuff was both smelly and delicious!

sentences.hanzi: 现在，我每个月都去那个又小又老的地方。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 mei3 ge5 yue4 dou1 qu4 na4 ge5 you4 xiao3 you4 lao3 de5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: Now I go to that small old place every month.

sentences.hanzi: 小八是我家的机器人。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 ba1 shi4 wo3 jia1 de5 ji1 qi4 ren2
sentences.english: Little Eight is our family's robot.

sentences.hanzi: 开始，它只会说“你好”。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 shi3 ta1 zhi3 hui4 shuo1 ni3 hao3
sentences.english: At first it could only say "hello".

sentences.hanzi: 现在，它话越来越多，做事越来越快。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ta1 hua4 yue4 lai2 yue4 duo1 zuo4 shi4 yue4 lai2 yue4 kuai4
sentences.english: Now it talks more and more, and works faster and faster.

sentences.hanzi: 它也越来越喜欢管我。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ye3 yue4 lai2 yue4 xi3 huan5 guan3 wo3
sentences.english: It also likes bossing me around more and more.

sentences.hanzi: “怎么还不睡？”“别玩了！”“你吃了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: zen3 me5 hai2 bu4 shui4 bie2 wan2 le5 ni3 chi1 le5 ma5
sentences.english: "Why aren't you asleep yet?" "Stop playing!" "Have you eaten?"

sentences.hanzi: 它越来越像我妈妈了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yue4 lai2 yue4 xiang4 wo3 ma1 ma5 le5
sentences.english: It's getting more and more like my mum.

sentences.hanzi: 过年了，爸爸说：“请把这个福贴在门上。”
sentences.pinyin: guo4 nian2 le5 ba4 ba5 shuo1 qing3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 fu2 tie1 zai4 men2 shang4
sentences.english: It was New Year. Dad said, "Please stick this 'fortune' on the door."

sentences.hanzi: 我把它贴在门上了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ba3 ta1 tie1 zai4 men2 shang4 le5
sentences.english: I stuck it on the door.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸看了看，说：“你把它贴倒了！”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 kan4 le5 kan4 shuo1 ni3 ba3 ta1 tie1 dao4 le5
sentences.english: Dad had a look and said, "You've stuck it on upside down!"

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“对不起，我马上把它拿下来。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 dui4 bu5 qi3 wo3 ma3 shang4 ba3 ta1 na2 xia4 lai2
sentences.english: I said, "Sorry, I'll take it down right away."

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“别拿！福倒了，就是福到了！”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 shuo1 bie2 na2 fu2 dao4 le5 jiu4 shi4 fu2 dao4 le5
sentences.english: Dad said, "Don't! Fortune upside down means fortune has arrived!"

sentences.hanzi: 我们去峨眉山玩。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 qu4 e2 mei2 shan1 wan2
sentences.english: We went to Mount Emei for fun.

sentences.hanzi: 那里有很多猴子。
sentences.pinyin: na4 li5 you3 hen3 duo1 hou2 zi5
sentences.english: There are lots of monkeys there.

sentences.hanzi: 小李的水果被猴子吃了。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 li3 de5 shui3 guo3 bei4 hou2 zi5 chi1 le5
sentences.english: Xiao Li's fruit was eaten by a monkey.

sentences.hanzi: 老王的钱被猴子拿了。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 wang2 de5 qian2 bei4 hou2 zi5 na2 le5
sentences.english: Old Wang's money was taken by a monkey.

sentences.hanzi: 老张的衣服被猴子抓坏了。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhang1 de5 yi1 fu5 bei4 hou2 zi5 zhua1 huai4 le5
sentences.english: Old Zhang's clothes were torn by a monkey.

sentences.hanzi: 我的手机也被一只小猴子拿了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 de5 shou3 ji1 ye3 bei4 yi1 zhi1 xiao3 hou2 zi5 na2 le5
sentences.english: My phone was taken too, by a little monkey.

sentences.hanzi: 它看了看，把手机放在我前面，走了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 ba3 shou3 ji1 fang4 zai4 wo3 qian2 mian4 zou3 le5
sentences.english: It had a look, put the phone down in front of me and left.

sentences.hanzi: 我看了看手机，里面多了一张猴子的照片。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 le5 kan4 shou3 ji1 li3 mian4 duo1 le5 yi1 zhang1 hou2 zi5 de5 zhao4 pian4
sentences.english: I looked at my phone. There was a new photo in it, of a monkey.

sentences.hanzi: 老李做了一个电话，可以给过去的人打电话。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 li3 zuo4 le5 yi1 ge5 dian4 hua4 ke3 yi3 gei3 guo4 qu4 de5 ren2 da3 dian4 hua4
sentences.english: Old Li built a phone that could call people in the past.

sentences.hanzi: 他先给九岁的自己打电话：“别玩了！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xian1 gei3 jiu3 sui4 de5 zi4 ji3 da3 dian4 hua4 bie2 wan2 le5
sentences.english: First he called himself at nine: "Stop playing!"

sentences.hanzi: 他又给八年前的自己打电话：“多给妈妈打电话！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 you4 gei3 ba1 nian2 qian2 de5 zi4 ji3 da3 dian4 hua4 duo1 gei3 ma1 ma5 da3 dian4 hua4
sentences.english: Then he called himself eight years ago: "Call Mum more often!"

sentences.hanzi: 最后，他给七年前的妈妈打电话。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ta1 gei3 qi1 nian2 qian2 de5 ma1 ma5 da3 dian4 hua4
