sentences.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 xian4 zai4 shi4 shen2 me5 shi2 hou5
sentences.english: "No idea. What time is it now?"

sentences.hanzi: “不知道。我们为什么在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 wo3 men5 wei4 shen2 me5 zai4 zhe4 li3
sentences.english: "No idea. Why are we here?"

sentences.hanzi: 这时，又来了一个人。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 you4 lai2 le5 yi1 ge5 ren2
sentences.english: Just then, another person came along.

sentences.hanzi: 他看了看我们，问：“请问，我是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 wo3 men5 wen4 qing3 wen4 wo3 shi4 shei2
sentences.english: He looked at us and asked, "Excuse me, who am I?"

title: 吃东西的时候
titlePinyin: chi1 dong1 xi5 de5 shi2 hou5

sentences.hanzi: 我小的时候，妈妈总是说：“吃东西的时候别玩！”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiao3 de5 shi2 hou5 ma1 ma5 zong3 shi4 shuo1 chi1 dong1 xi5 de5 shi2 hou5 bie2 wan2
sentences.english: When I was little, Mum always said, "Don't play while you're eating!"

sentences.hanzi: 她还说：“走的时候别忘了东西。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hai2 shuo1 zou3 de5 shi2 hou5 bie2 wang4 le5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: She also said, "Don't forget your things when you leave."

sentences.hanzi: “过年的时候别说错话。”
sentences.pinyin: guo4 nian2 de5 shi2 hou5 bie2 shuo1 cuo4 hua4
sentences.english: "Don't say the wrong thing at New Year."

sentences.hanzi: 我不喜欢听。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bu4 xi3 huan5 ting1
sentences.english: I didn't like hearing it.

sentences.hanzi: 现在我有孩子了。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 you3 hai2 zi5 le5
sentences.english: Now I have children.

sentences.hanzi: 今天吃东西的时候，我听到有人说：“吃东西的时候别玩！”
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 chi1 dong1 xi5 de5 shi2 hou5 wo3 ting1 dao4 you3 ren2 shuo1 chi1 dong1 xi5 de5 shi2 hou5 bie2 wan2
sentences.english: While we were eating today, I heard someone say, "Don't play while you're eating!"

sentences.hanzi: 说话的人是我。
sentences.pinyin: shuo1 hua4 de5 ren2 shi4 wo3
sentences.english: The person speaking was me.

sentences.hanzi: 叶公说他最爱龙。
sentences.pinyin: ye4 gong1 shuo1 ta1 zui4 ai4 long2
sentences.english: Lord Ye said he loved dragons more than anything.

sentences.hanzi: 他一说话，就说龙。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 shuo1 hua4 jiu4 shuo1 long2
sentences.english: As soon as he spoke, he spoke of dragons.

sentences.hanzi: 他一有时间，就画龙。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 you3 shi2 jian1 jiu4 hua4 long2
sentences.english: As soon as he had time, he drew dragons.

sentences.hanzi: 天上的真龙听说了，很高兴，就来看他。
sentences.pinyin: tian1 shang4 de5 zhen1 long2 ting1 shuo1 le5 hen3 gao1 xing4 jiu4 lai2 kan4 ta1
sentences.english: A real dragon in the sky heard of this, was delighted, and came to see him.

sentences.hanzi: 叶公一回家，就看见了它。
sentences.pinyin: ye4 gong1 yi1 hui2 jia1 jiu4 kan4 jian4 le5 ta1
sentences.english: As soon as Lord Ye got home, he saw it.

sentences.hanzi: 他一看见真龙，就跑了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 kan4 jian4 zhen1 long2 jiu4 pao3 le5
sentences.english: As soon as he saw the real dragon, he ran away.

title: 你怎么才来
titleEnglish: Why are you only here now

sentences.hanzi: 中国只用一个时间。
sentences.pinyin: zhong1 guo2 zhi3 yong4 yi1 ge5 shi2 jian1
sentences.english: All of China uses one time.

sentences.hanzi: 冬天，北京七点多天就亮了，喀什九点多才亮。
sentences.pinyin: dong1 tian1 bei3 jing1 qi1 dian3 duo1 tian1 jiu4 liang4 le5 ka1 shi2 jiu3 dian3 duo1 cai2 liang4
sentences.english: In winter it's light in Beijing soon after seven. In Kashgar it isn't light until after nine.

sentences.hanzi: 朋友请我在喀什吃晚饭，我七点就到了。
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 qing3 wo3 zai4 ka1 shi2 chi1 wan3 fan4 wo3 qi1 dian3 jiu4 dao4 le5
sentences.english: A friend invited me to dinner in Kashgar. I was there by seven.

sentences.hanzi: 他九点才来。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 jiu3 dian3 cai2 lai2
sentences.english: He didn't come until nine.

sentences.hanzi: 我问：“你怎么现在才来？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 zen3 me5 xian4 zai4 cai2 lai2
sentences.english: I asked, "Why have you only come now?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“这里九点才吃晚饭，你怎么七点就来了？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zhe4 li3 jiu3 dian3 cai2 chi1 wan3 fan4 ni3 zen3 me5 qi1 dian3 jiu4 lai2 le5
sentences.english: He said, "People here don't eat dinner until nine. Why did you come at seven?"

sentences.hanzi: 我在桂林问一位老人：“这里除了山以外，还有什么？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 gui4 lin2 wen4 yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2 zhe4 li3 chu2 le5 shan1 yi3 wai4 hai2 you3 shen2 me5
sentences.english: In Guilin I asked an old man, "Besides the mountains, what else is there here?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“除了山以外，还有水。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 chu2 le5 shan1 yi3 wai4 hai2 you3 shui3
sentences.english: He said, "Besides the mountains, there's also water."

sentences.hanzi: “除了水以外呢？”
sentences.pinyin: chu2 le5 shui3 yi3 wai4 ne5
sentences.english: "And besides the water?"

sentences.hanzi: “除了水以外，什么都没有了。”
sentences.pinyin: chu2 le5 shui3 yi3 wai4 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: "Apart from the water, there's nothing."

sentences.hanzi: 我问：“那您为什么不离开这里？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 na4 nin2 wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 li2 kai1 zhe4 li3
sentences.english: I asked, "Then why don't you leave?"

sentences.hanzi: 他看了看山，说：“除了这里以外，别的地方我都不喜欢。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 shan1 shuo1 chu2 le5 zhe4 li3 yi3 wai4 bie2 de5 di4 fang5 wo3 dou1 bu4 xi3 huan5
sentences.english: He looked at the mountains and said, "Apart from here, I don't like anywhere else."

title: 这位先生是谁
titlePinyin: zhe4 wei4 xian1 sheng5 shi4 shei2

sentences.hanzi: 老王在上海工作，太忙了。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 wang2 zai4 shang4 hai3 gong1 zuo4 tai4 mang2 le5
sentences.english: Old Wang worked in Shanghai and was far too busy.

sentences.hanzi: 他连吃东西的时间都没有。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 lian2 chi1 dong1 xi5 de5 shi2 jian1 dou1 mei2 you3
sentences.english: He didn't even have time to eat.

sentences.hanzi: 他连过年也不回家。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 lian2 guo4 nian2 ye3 bu4 hui2 jia1
sentences.english: He didn't even go home for New Year.

sentences.hanzi: 八年以后，他回家了。
sentences.pinyin: ba1 nian2 yi3 hou4 ta1 hui2 jia1 le5
sentences.english: Eight years later, he went home.

sentences.hanzi: 连家里的狗都不认识他了。
sentences.pinyin: lian2 jia1 li3 de5 gou3 dou1 bu4 ren4 shi5 ta1 le5
sentences.english: Even the family dog didn't recognize him.

sentences.hanzi: 连他的孩子也问妈妈：“这位先生是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: lian2 ta1 de5 hai2 zi5 ye3 wen4 ma1 ma5 zhe4 wei4 xian1 sheng5 shi4 shei2
sentences.english: Even his child asked their mother, "Who is this gentleman?"

sentences.hanzi: 一个老人走过来，对我说：“今天别坐车。”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 zou3 guo4 lai2 dui4 wo3 shuo1 jin1 tian1 bie2 zuo4 che1
sentences.english: An old man came over and said to me, "Don't take the bus today."

sentences.hanzi: 我问：“你是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 shi4 shei2
sentences.english: I asked, "Who are you?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“别问了。也不要去那个地方。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 bie2 wen4 le5 ye3 bu4 yao4 qu4 na4 ge5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: He said, "Stop asking. And don't go to that place."

sentences.hanzi: “你怎么知道？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 zen3 me5 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: "How do you know?"

sentences.hanzi: “别担心。我是三十年后的你。”
sentences.pinyin: bie2 dan1 xin1 wo3 shi4 san1 shi2 nian2 hou4 de5 ni3
sentences.english: "Don't worry. I'm you, thirty years from now."

sentences.hanzi: 我很高兴，问：“太好了！三十年后，我有钱吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 hen3 gao1 xing4 wen4 tai4 hao3 le5 san1 shi2 nian2 hou4 wo3 you3 qian2 ma5
sentences.english: I was delighted and asked, "Great! In thirty years, will I be rich?"

sentences.hanzi: 他看了看我，说：“这个……别问了。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 wo3 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 bie2 wen4 le5
sentences.english: He looked at me and said, "That... stop asking."

title: 你家有几个人
titlePinyin: ni3 jia1 you3 ji3 ge4 ren2
titleEnglish: How Many People Are in Your Family?

sentences.hanzi: 我有一个朋友，叫阿明。他是客家人。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 you3 yi1 ge5 peng2 you5 jiao4 a1 ming2 ta1 shi4 ke4 jia1 ren2
sentences.english: I have a friend called Aming. He's Hakka.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，他带我回家看看。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 ta1 dai4 wo3 hui2 jia1 kan4 kan5
sentences.english: One day he took me home for a visit.

sentences.hanzi: 我问：“你家有几个人？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 jia1 you3 ji3 ge4 ren2
sentences.english: I asked: "How many people are in your family?"

sentences.hanzi: 他想了想，说：“今天家里有两百多个。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 jin1 tian1 jia1 li3 you3 liang3 bai3 duo1 ge4
sentences.english: He thought about it and said: "Today? Over two hundred at home."

sentences.hanzi: 我不相信。这么大的家，住在哪里？
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bu4 xiang1 xin4 zhe4 me5 da4 de5 jia1 zhu4 zai4 na3 li3
sentences.english: I didn't believe him. Where could a family that big live?

sentences.hanzi: 我们坐了很久的车，到了福建。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 zuo4 le5 hen3 jiu3 de5 che1 dao4 le5 fu2 jian4
sentences.english: We rode for a long time and reached Fujian.

sentences.hanzi: 我看见了他的家：一个很大很高的圆楼。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 jian4 le5 ta1 de5 jia1 yi1 ge5 hen3 da4 hen3 gao1 de5 yuan2 lou2
sentences.english: I saw his home: a huge, tall, round building.

sentences.hanzi: 这就是土楼。门很小，可是进了门，里面就是一个世界。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 tu3 lou2 men2 hen3 xiao3 ke3 shi4 jin4 le5 men2 li3 mian4 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ge5 shi4 jie4
sentences.english: This was a tulou. The door was small, but inside was a whole world.

sentences.hanzi: 这里有住的地方，有放东西的地方，孩子们也有玩的地方。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 you3 zhu4 de5 di4 fang5 you3 fang4 dong1 xi5 de5 di4 fang5 hai2 zi5 men5 ye3 you3 wan2 de5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: There were places to live, places to store things, and places for the children to play.

sentences.hanzi: 阿明说：“这是我爷爷的弟弟，这是我叔叔，这是我姐姐的孩子。”
sentences.pinyin: a1 ming2 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 wo3 ye2 ye5 de5 di4 di5 zhe4 shi4 wo3 shu1 shu5 zhe4 shi4 wo3 jie3 jie5 de5 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: Aming said: "This is my grandpa's brother, this is my uncle, this is my sister's child."

sentences.hanzi: 我问：“你们的邻居呢？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 men5 de5 lin2 ju1 ne5
sentences.english: I asked: "What about your neighbours?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“我们没有邻居。这里的人，都是一个家族的。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 men5 mei2 you3 lin2 ju1 zhe4 li3 de5 ren2 dou1 shi4 yi1 ge5 jia1 zu2 de5
sentences.english: He said: "We don't have neighbours. Everyone here belongs to one clan."

sentences.hanzi: 他告诉我，很久以前，他们的家族从北方到了这里。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 gao4 su5 wo3 hen3 jiu3 yi3 qian2 ta1 men5 de5 jia1 zu2 cong2 bei3 fang1 dao4 le5 zhe4 li3
sentences.english: He told me that long ago, his clan had come here from the north.

sentences.hanzi: 他们人不多，只有住在一起，别人才不敢来打他们。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 ren2 bu4 duo1 zhi3 you3 zhu4 zai4 yi1 qi3 bie2 ren2 cai2 bu4 gan3 lai2 da3 ta1 men5
sentences.english: There weren't many of them. Only by living together could they stop others from attacking.

sentences.hanzi: 所以一个楼就是一个家，一个家就是几百个人。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yi1 ge5 lou2 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ge5 jia1 yi1 ge5 jia1 jiu4 shi4 ji3 bai3 ge4 ren2
sentences.english: So one building is one family, and one family is several hundred people.

sentences.hanzi: 回家以后，我站在我住的楼前面，看了很久。
sentences.pinyin: hui2 jia1 yi3 hou4 wo3 zhan4 zai4 wo3 zhu4 de5 lou2 qian2 mian4 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3
sentences.english: After I got home, I stood in front of my own building and looked at it for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 这个楼也很大，也住着两百多个人。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 lou2 ye3 hen3 da4 ye3 zhu4 zhe5 liang3 bai3 duo1 ge4 ren2
sentences.english: This building was big too, and over two hundred people lived in it as well.

sentences.hanzi: 可是我一个也不认识。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 yi1 ge5 ye3 bu4 ren4 shi5
sentences.english: But I didn't know a single one of them.

glossed.meaning: Fujian, a province in southeast China

title: 两千年前的家信
titlePinyin: liang3 qian1 nian2 qian2 de5 jia1 xin4
titleEnglish: A Letter Home from Two Thousand Years Ago

sentences.hanzi: 有人在中国发现了一个两千多年前的墓。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 zai4 zhong1 guo2 fa1 xian4 le5 yi1 ge5 liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 de5 mu4
sentences.english: Someone in China found a tomb more than two thousand years old.

sentences.hanzi: 墓里有两块木头。木头上，是两份家信。
sentences.pinyin: mu4 li3 you3 liang3 kuai4 mu4 tou5 mu4 tou5 shang4 shi4 liang3 fen4 jia1 xin4
sentences.english: In the tomb were two pieces of wood. On the wood were two letters home.

sentences.hanzi: 这是现在知道的中国最老的家信。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 xian4 zai4 zhi1 dao4 de5 zhong1 guo2 zui4 lao3 de5 jia1 xin4
sentences.english: They are the oldest family letters known in China.

sentences.hanzi: 写信的是兄弟俩，一个叫黑夫，一个叫惊。
sentences.pinyin: xie3 xin4 de5 shi4 xiong1 di4 lia3 yi1 ge5 jiao4 hei1 fu1 yi1 ge5 jiao4 jing1
sentences.english: The writers were two brothers, one called Heifu, the other called Jing.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候，秦国正在打楚国，兄弟俩都去了。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 qin2 guo2 zheng4 zai4 da3 chu3 guo2 xiong1 di4 lia3 dou1 qu4 le5
sentences.english: At the time, the state of Qin was at war with Chu, and both brothers had gone.

sentences.hanzi: 他们离家很远，很久没有见到家人。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 li2 jia1 hen3 yuan3 hen3 jiu3 mei2 you3 jian4 dao4 jia1 ren2
sentences.english: They were far from home and hadn't seen their family for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 两千多年前的人，给家里写信，会写什么呢？
sentences.pinyin: liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 de5 ren2 gei3 jia1 li3 xie3 xin4 hui4 xie3 shen2 me5 ne5
sentences.english: What would people two thousand years ago write home about?

sentences.hanzi: 黑夫说：“哥哥好吗？母亲好吗？我们都好。”
sentences.pinyin: hei1 fu1 shuo1 ge1 ge5 hao3 ma5 mu3 qin1 hao3 ma5 wo3 men5 dou1 hao3
sentences.english: Heifu said: "How are you, brother? How is Mother? We are both well."

sentences.hanzi: “请母亲给我做衣服，再送一点钱来。”
sentences.pinyin: qing3 mu3 qin1 gei3 wo3 zuo4 yi1 fu5 zai4 song4 yi1 dian3 qian2 lai2
sentences.english: "Please ask Mother to make me clothes, and send a little money."

sentences.hanzi: 惊说：“请母亲给我五六百钱。”
sentences.pinyin: jing1 shuo1 qing3 mu3 qin1 gei3 wo3 wu3 liu4 bai3 qian2
sentences.english: Jing said: "Please ask Mother to give me five or six hundred coins."

sentences.hanzi: “如果家里不送，我就要死了。快！快！快！”
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 jia1 li3 bu4 song4 wo3 jiu4 yao4 si3 le5 kuai4 kuai4 kuai4
sentences.english: "If home doesn't send it, I'll die. Quick! Quick! Quick!"

sentences.hanzi: 两千多年过去了，世界完全变了。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 guo4 qu4 le5 shi4 jie4 wan2 quan2 bian4 le5
sentences.english: More than two thousand years have passed, and the world has changed completely.

sentences.hanzi: 可是离开家的儿子，还是在给妈妈打电话要钱。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 li2 kai1 jia1 de5 er2 zi5 hai2 shi5 zai4 gei3 ma1 ma5 da3 dian4 hua4 yao4 qian2
sentences.english: But sons who leave home are still phoning their mothers for money.

sentences.hanzi: 我们不知道兄弟俩有没有回家。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 bu4 zhi1 dao4 xiong1 di4 lia3 you3 mei2 you3 hui2 jia1
sentences.english: We don't know if the brothers ever came home.

sentences.hanzi: 也不知道母亲有没有送钱。
sentences.pinyin: ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 mu3 qin1 you3 mei2 you3 song4 qian2
sentences.english: We don't know if their mother sent the money.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人认为，这是他们哥哥的墓。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 ren4 wei2 zhe4 shi4 ta1 men5 ge1 ge5 de5 mu4
sentences.english: Many people think this was their older brother's tomb.

sentences.hanzi: 他死的时候，还带着弟弟的信。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 si3 de5 shi2 hou5 hai2 dai4 zhe5 di4 di5 de5 xin4
sentences.english: When he died, he still had his younger brothers' letters with him.

sentences.hanzi: 今天弟弟一岁了。家里来了很多人。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 di4 di5 yi1 sui4 le5 jia1 li3 lai2 le5 hen3 duo1 ren2
sentences.english: My little brother turned one today. Lots of people came to our home.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷、奶奶、叔叔都来了，可是谁也没有看我。
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 nai3 nai5 shu1 shu5 dou1 lai2 le5 ke3 shi4 shei2 ye3 mei2 you3 kan4 wo3
sentences.english: Grandpa, Grandma and my uncle all came, but nobody looked at me.

sentences.hanzi: 从弟弟来了以后，大家都只看他。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 di4 di5 lai2 le5 yi3 hou4 da4 jia1 dou1 zhi3 kan4 ta1
sentences.english: Ever since my brother came along, everyone only looks at him.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈说，今天要抓周。
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 shuo1 jin1 tian1 yao4 zhua1 zhou1
sentences.english: Mum said that today we'd do the zhuazhou.

sentences.hanzi: 孩子一岁生日的时候，家人把很多东西放在他前面。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 yi1 sui4 sheng1 ri4 de5 shi2 hou5 jia1 ren2 ba3 hen3 duo1 dong1 xi5 fang4 zai4 ta1 qian2 mian4
sentences.english: On a child's first birthday, the family puts lots of things in front of him.

sentences.hanzi: 他先抓什么，以后就可能做什么。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xian1 zhua1 shen2 me5 yi3 hou4 jiu4 ke3 neng2 zuo4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: Whatever he grabs first is what he may do in life.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷放了一本书：“宝贝，抓书！书里什么都有！”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 fang4 le5 yi1 ben3 shu1 bao3 bei4 zhua1 shu1 shu1 li3 shen2 me5 dou1 you3
sentences.english: Grandpa put down a book: "Sweetheart, grab the book! Everything's in books!"

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸放了他的电话：“抓这个！”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 fang4 le5 ta1 de5 dian4 hua4 zhua1 zhe4 ge5
sentences.english: Dad put down his phone: "Grab this!"

sentences.hanzi: 叔叔放了一些钱：“抓钱！这个才重要！”
sentences.pinyin: shu1 shu5 fang4 le5 yi1 xie1 qian2 zhua1 qian2 zhe4 ge5 cai2 zhong4 yao4
sentences.english: My uncle put down some money: "Grab the money! That's what matters!"

sentences.hanzi: 大家都很高兴。我站在门旁边，没有人叫我。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 hen3 gao1 xing4 wo3 zhan4 zai4 men2 pang2 bian1 mei2 you3 ren2 jiao4 wo3
sentences.english: Everyone was happy. I stood by the door, and nobody called me.

sentences.hanzi: 弟弟看看书，看看电话，看看钱，不动。
sentences.pinyin: di4 di5 kan4 kan5 shu1 kan4 kan5 dian4 hua4 kan4 kan5 qian2 bu4 dong4
sentences.english: My brother looked at the book, the phone and the money, and didn't move.

sentences.hanzi: 大家都不说话了。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 bu4 shuo1 hua4 le5
sentences.english: Everyone went quiet.

sentences.hanzi: 然后，他动了。
sentences.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 dong4 le5
sentences.english: Then he moved.

sentences.hanzi: 他从书的旁边过去，从钱的旁边过去，一直到了门旁边。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 cong2 shu1 de5 pang2 bian1 guo4 qu4 cong2 qian2 de5 pang2 bian1 guo4 qu4 yi1 zhi2 dao4 le5 men2 pang2 bian1
sentences.english: He went past the book, past the money, all the way to the door.

sentences.hanzi: 他抓了我的手。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zhua1 le5 wo3 de5 shou3
sentences.english: He grabbed my hand.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷问：“这是什么意思？”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 wen4 zhe4 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5
sentences.english: Grandpa asked: "What does that mean?"

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶说：“这孩子什么都知道。书和钱以后都会有，姐姐只有一个。”
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 shuo1 zhe4 hai2 zi5 shen2 me5 dou1 zhi1 dao4 shu1 he2 qian2 yi3 hou4 dou1 hui4 you3 jie3 jie5 zhi3 you3 yi1 ge5
sentences.english: Grandma said: "This child knows everything. Books and money will come later. He only has one big sister."

sentences.hanzi: 他的手很小，抓着我，不放。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 shou3 hen3 xiao3 zhua1 zhe5 wo3 bu4 fang4
sentences.english: His hand was tiny. It held on to me and wouldn't let go.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，我把最大的一块蛋糕给了他。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 wo3 ba3 zui4 da4 de5 yi1 kuai4 dan4 gao1 gei3 le5 ta1
sentences.english: That night, I gave him the biggest piece of cake.

sentences.hanzi: 九百多年前的宋朝，有一对夫妇。
sentences.pinyin: jiu3 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 de5 song4 chao2 you3 yi1 dui4 fu1 fu4
sentences.english: Over nine hundred years ago, in the Song dynasty, there was a married couple.

sentences.hanzi: 妻子叫李清照，丈夫叫赵明诚。
sentences.pinyin: qi1 zi5 jiao4 li3 qing1 zhao4 zhang4 fu5 jiao4 zhao4 ming2 cheng2
sentences.english: The wife was called Li Qingzhao, and the husband Zhao Mingcheng.

sentences.hanzi: 李清照会写诗，是中国最有名的女诗人。
sentences.pinyin: li3 qing1 zhao4 hui4 xie3 shi1 shi4 zhong1 guo2 zui4 you3 ming2 de5 nu:3 shi1 ren2
sentences.english: Li Qingzhao wrote poetry, and she is China's most famous woman poet.

sentences.hanzi: 他们结婚以后，没有很多钱，可是两个人都爱书。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 jie2 hun1 yi3 hou4 mei2 you3 hen3 duo1 qian2 ke3 shi4 liang3 ge4 ren2 dou1 ai4 shu1
sentences.english: After they married they didn't have much money, but they both loved books.

sentences.hanzi: 有了一点钱，他们就去买书。没有钱，就拿衣服去换。
sentences.pinyin: you3 le5 yi1 dian3 qian2 ta1 men5 jiu4 qu4 mai3 shu1 mei2 you3 qian2 jiu4 na2 yi1 fu5 qu4 huan4
sentences.english: When they had a little money, they bought books. When they had none, they traded clothes for them.

sentences.hanzi: 家里的书一年比一年多。晚上，两个人有一件最喜欢的事。
sentences.pinyin: jia1 li3 de5 shu1 yi1 nian2 bi3 yi1 nian2 duo1 wan3 shang5 liang3 ge4 ren2 you3 yi1 jian4 zui4 xi3 huan5 de5 shi4
sentences.english: Their home filled with more books every year. In the evenings, the two had a favourite thing to do.

sentences.hanzi: 他们坐在一起，一个人说一句话，另一个人要说出，这句话在什么书的什么地方。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 zuo4 zai4 yi1 qi3 yi1 ge5 ren2 shuo1 yi1 ju4 hua4 ling4 yi1 ge5 ren2 yao4 shuo1 chu1 zhe4 ju4 hua4 zai4 shen2 me5 shu1 de5 shen2 me5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: They sat together. One would say a line, and the other had to say which book it was in, and where.

sentences.hanzi: 谁说对了，谁就先喝茶。
sentences.pinyin: shei2 shuo1 dui4 le5 shei2 jiu4 xian1 he1 cha2
sentences.english: Whoever got it right drank tea first.

sentences.hanzi: 李清照说对的时候很多。
sentences.pinyin: li3 qing1 zhao4 shuo1 dui4 de5 shi2 hou5 hen3 duo1
sentences.english: Li Qingzhao was often right.

sentences.hanzi: 有一次，她又说对了。她太高兴了，手上的茶全倒在了衣服上。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 ci4 ta1 you4 shuo1 dui4 le5 ta1 tai4 gao1 xing4 le5 shou3 shang4 de5 cha2 quan2 dao4 zai4 le5 yi1 fu5 shang4
sentences.english: Once she got it right again. She was so happy that the tea in her hand spilled all over her clothes.

sentences.hanzi: 结果，她什么也没有喝到。
sentences.pinyin: jie2 guo3 ta1 shen2 me5 ye3 mei2 you3 he1 dao4
sentences.english: So she got nothing to drink at all.

sentences.hanzi: 那是他们最亲密的时候。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi4 ta1 men5 zui4 qin1 mi4 de5 shi2 hou5
sentences.english: That was the closest they ever were.

sentences.hanzi: 之后，金国打了过来，他们必须离开家。
sentences.pinyin: zhi1 hou4 jin1 guo2 da3 le5 guo4 lai2 ta1 men5 bi4 xu1 li2 kai1 jia1
sentences.english: Later the Jin invaded, and they had to leave home.

sentences.hanzi: 很多书都没有了。丈夫也死了。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 shu1 dou1 mei2 you3 le5 zhang4 fu5 ye3 si3 le5
sentences.english: Many of the books were lost. Her husband died too.

sentences.hanzi: 李清照一个人带着最后的一些书，向南走了很多年。
sentences.pinyin: li3 qing1 zhao4 yi1 ge5 ren2 dai4 zhe5 zui4 hou4 de5 yi1 xie1 shu1 xiang4 nan2 zou3 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2
sentences.english: Li Qingzhao alone carried the last of the books, moving south for many years.

sentences.hanzi: 老了以后，她把这些事都写了下来。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 le5 yi3 hou4 ta1 ba3 zhe4 xie1 shi4 dou1 xie3 le5 xia4 lai5
sentences.english: When she was old, she wrote it all down.

sentences.hanzi: 那杯茶，她写得非常清楚。
sentences.pinyin: na4 bei1 cha2 ta1 xie3 de5 fei1 chang2 qing1 chu5
sentences.english: That cup of tea, she described very clearly.

sentences.hanzi: 那杯茶她没有喝到。可是她最想再喝的，就是那一杯。
sentences.pinyin: na4 bei1 cha2 ta1 mei2 you3 he1 dao4 ke3 shi4 ta1 zui4 xiang3 zai4 he1 de5 jiu4 shi4 na4 yi1 bei1
sentences.english: She never drank that cup of tea. But it was the one she most wanted to have again.

glossed.meaning: Li Qingzhao, a Song dynasty poet

sentences.hanzi: 我七岁生日的时候，爸爸走了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 qi1 sui4 sheng1 ri4 de5 shi2 hou5 ba4 ba5 zou3 le5
sentences.english: On my seventh birthday, my father left.

sentences.hanzi: 他要坐飞船去很远的地方。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yao4 zuo4 fei1 chuan2 qu4 hen3 yuan3 de5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: He was going far away on a spaceship.

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“宝贝，爸爸回来的时候，给你过生日。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 bao3 bei4 ba4 ba5 hui2 lai5 de5 shi2 hou5 gei3 ni3 guo4 sheng1 ri4
sentences.english: He said: "Sweetheart, when Daddy gets back, we'll celebrate your birthday."

sentences.hanzi: 这个飞船非常快，快到时间都变了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fei1 chuan2 fei1 chang2 kuai4 kuai4 dao4 shi2 jian1 dou1 bian4 le5
sentences.english: The ship was so fast that time itself changed.

sentences.hanzi: 在飞船上过一年，我们这里就过了十二年。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 fei1 chuan2 shang4 guo4 yi1 nian2 wo3 men5 zhe4 li3 jiu4 guo4 le5 shi2 er4 nian2
sentences.english: One year on the ship was twelve years here.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸走了五年。我等了六十年。
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 zou3 le5 wu3 nian2 wo3 deng3 le5 liu4 shi2 nian2
sentences.english: My father was gone five years. I waited sixty.

sentences.hanzi: 我结婚了，有了孩子，孩子又有了孩子。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 jie2 hun1 le5 you3 le5 hai2 zi5 hai2 zi5 you4 you3 le5 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: I married and had children, and they had children.

sentences.hanzi: 我已经是老奶奶了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 yi3 jing1 shi4 lao3 nai3 nai5 le5
sentences.english: I became a grandmother.

sentences.hanzi: 今天，飞船回来了。很多人在等。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 fei1 chuan2 hui2 lai5 le5 hen3 duo1 ren2 zai4 deng3
sentences.english: Today, the ship came back. Many people were waiting.

sentences.hanzi: 一个年轻的男人走了出来。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 nian2 qing1 de5 nan2 ren2 zou3 le5 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: A young man walked out.

sentences.hanzi: 他看了看每个人，还在找。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 mei3 ge5 ren2 hai2 zai4 zhao3
sentences.english: He looked at everyone, still searching.

sentences.hanzi: 我知道他在找谁。他在找一个七岁的女孩。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 ta1 zai4 zhao3 shei2 ta1 zai4 zhao3 yi1 ge5 qi1 sui4 de5 nu:3 hai2
sentences.english: I knew who he was looking for. A seven-year-old girl.

sentences.hanzi: 我走过去，说：“爸爸。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zou3 guo4 qu4 shuo1 ba4 ba5
sentences.english: I walked over and said: "Dad."

sentences.hanzi: 他看着我，很久没有说话。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 zhe5 wo3 hen3 jiu3 mei2 you3 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: He looked at me and said nothing for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 这个比我年轻很多的男人，是我的父亲。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bi3 wo3 nian2 qing1 hen3 duo1 de5 nan2 ren2 shi4 wo3 de5 fu4 qin1
sentences.english: This man, so much younger than me, was my father.

sentences.hanzi: 然后，他从衣服里拿出一块巧克力。
sentences.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 cong2 yi1 fu5 li3 na2 chu1 yi1 kuai4 qiao3 ke4 li4
sentences.english: Then he took a piece of chocolate from his clothes.

sentences.hanzi: 这是我七岁的时候最喜欢的。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wo3 qi1 sui4 de5 shi2 hou5 zui4 xi3 huan5 de5
sentences.english: It was my favourite when I was seven.

sentences.hanzi: “宝贝，对不起，爸爸来晚了。”
sentences.pinyin: bao3 bei4 dui4 bu5 qi3 ba4 ba5 lai2 wan3 le5
sentences.english: "Sweetheart, I'm sorry. Daddy's late."

sentences.hanzi: 已经很多年没有人叫我宝贝了。
sentences.pinyin: yi3 jing1 hen3 duo1 nian2 mei2 you3 ren2 jiao4 wo3 bao3 bei4 le5
sentences.english: Nobody had called me sweetheart for many years.

sentences.hanzi: 这一天，我又七岁了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 tian1 wo3 you4 qi1 sui4 le5
sentences.english: That day, I was seven again.

title: 油条为什么有两条
titlePinyin: you2 tiao2 wei4 shen2 me5 you3 liang3 tiao2

sentences.hanzi: 早餐吃什么？很多中国人会说：油条。
sentences.pinyin: zao3 can1 chi1 shen2 me5 hen3 duo1 zhong1 guo2 ren2 hui4 shuo1 you2 tiao2
sentences.english: What's for breakfast? Many Chinese people will say: youtiao.

sentences.hanzi: 油条是用面做的，长长的，放在油里炸，很香。
sentences.pinyin: you2 tiao2 shi4 yong4 mian4 zuo4 de5 chang2 chang2 de5 fang4 zai4 you2 li3 zha2 hen3 xiang1
sentences.english: Youtiao are made of dough. They're long, fried in oil, and smell wonderful.

sentences.hanzi: 你吃油条的时候，注意过吗？
sentences.pinyin: ni3 chi1 you2 tiao2 de5 shi2 hou5 zhu4 yi4 guo5 ma5
sentences.english: When you eat youtiao, have you ever noticed?

sentences.hanzi: 它总是两条在一起，不是一条。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zong3 shi4 liang3 tiao2 zai4 yi1 qi3 bu4 shi4 yi1 tiao2
sentences.english: It's always two strips together, never one.

sentences.hanzi: 这是为什么呢？
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
sentences.english: Why is that?

sentences.hanzi: 听说，这和八百多年前的一个人有关系。
sentences.pinyin: ting1 shuo1 zhe4 he2 ba1 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 de5 yi1 ge5 ren2 you3 guan1 xi5
sentences.english: They say it has to do with a man from over eight hundred years ago.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候是宋朝，有一个人叫岳飞。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 shi4 song4 chao2 you3 yi1 ge5 ren2 jiao4 yue4 fei1
sentences.english: It was the Song dynasty, and there was a man called Yue Fei.

sentences.hanzi: 他为了宋朝打了很多年，大家都爱他。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 wei4 le5 song4 chao2 da3 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2 da4 jia1 dou1 ai4 ta1
sentences.english: He fought for the Song for many years, and everyone loved him.

sentences.hanzi: 可是还有一个很坏的人，叫秦桧。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 hai2 you3 yi1 ge5 hen3 huai4 de5 ren2 jiao4 qin2 hui4
sentences.english: But there was also a very bad man called Qin Hui.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人说，秦桧和他的妻子一起，让人杀死了岳飞。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 shuo1 qin2 hui4 he2 ta1 de5 qi1 zi5 yi1 qi3 rang4 ren2 sha1 si3 le5 yue4 fei1
sentences.english: Many say that Qin Hui and his wife together had Yue Fei killed.

sentences.hanzi: 大家都知道这是错的，可是谁也不敢说。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 shi4 cuo4 de5 ke3 shi4 shei2 ye3 bu4 gan3 shuo1
sentences.english: Everyone knew this was wrong, but nobody dared say so.

sentences.hanzi: 听说，有一个做饼的老人想了一个办法。
sentences.pinyin: ting1 shuo1 you3 yi1 ge5 zuo4 bing3 de5 lao3 ren2 xiang3 le5 yi1 ge5 ban4 fa3
sentences.english: The story goes that an old man who made flatbreads came up with a plan.

sentences.hanzi: 他用面做了两个小人，一个是秦桧，一个是秦桧的妻子。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yong4 mian4 zuo4 le5 liang3 ge4 xiao3 ren2 yi1 ge5 shi4 qin2 hui4 yi1 ge5 shi4 qin2 hui4 de5 qi1 zi5
sentences.english: He made two little people out of dough: one was Qin Hui, the other Qin Hui's wife.

sentences.hanzi: 他把这两个小人放在一起，放进油里炸。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ba3 zhe4 liang3 ge4 xiao3 ren2 fang4 zai4 yi1 qi3 fang4 jin4 you2 li3 zha2
sentences.english: He put the two little people together and fried them in oil.

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“快来看！快来吃！今天我们炸秦桧！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 kuai4 lai2 kan4 kuai4 lai2 chi1 jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 zha2 qin2 hui4
sentences.english: He said: "Come and see! Come and eat! Today we're frying Qin Hui!"

sentences.hanzi: 大家都跑来了。这个早点味道特别好。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 pao3 lai2 le5 zhe4 ge5 zao3 dian3 wei4 dao5 te4 bie2 hao3
sentences.english: Everyone came running. This breakfast tasted especially good.

sentences.hanzi: 很快，很多地方的人都开始吃。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 hen3 duo1 di4 fang5 de5 ren2 dou1 kai1 shi3 chi1
sentences.english: Soon people in many places began to eat it.

sentences.hanzi: 八百多年过去了，很多人已经忘了这件事。
sentences.pinyin: ba1 bai3 duo1 nian2 guo4 qu4 le5 hen3 duo1 ren2 yi3 jing1 wang4 le5 zhe4 jian4 shi4
sentences.english: Over eight hundred years have passed, and many people have forgotten all this.

sentences.hanzi: 可是每一天，这两个人还是要被放进油里。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 mei3 yi1 tian1 zhe4 liang3 ge4 ren2 hai2 shi5 yao4 bei4 fang4 jin4 you2 li3
sentences.english: But every day, those two people still get thrown into the oil.

glossed.meaning: Yue Fei, a Song dynasty general
Qin Hui, a Song dynasty official

sentences.hanzi: 你喜欢吃面吗？
sentences.pinyin: ni3 xi3 huan5 chi1 mian4 ma5
sentences.english: Do you like noodles?

sentences.hanzi: 现在知道的最老的一碗面，是在中国发现的。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 zhi1 dao4 de5 zui4 lao3 de5 yi1 wan3 mian4 shi4 zai4 zhong1 guo2 fa1 xian4 de5
sentences.english: The oldest bowl of noodles known today was found in China.

sentences.hanzi: 这碗面已经四千岁了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 wan3 mian4 yi3 jing1 si4 qian1 sui4 le5
sentences.english: That bowl of noodles is four thousand years old.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，一些人在黄河旁边的喇家工作，他们发现了一个老碗。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 yi1 xie1 ren2 zai4 huang2 he2 pang2 bian1 de5 la3 jia1 gong1 zuo4 ta1 men5 fa1 xian4 le5 yi1 ge5 lao3 wan3
sentences.english: One day some people working at Lajia, beside the Yellow River, found an old bowl.

sentences.hanzi: 碗是倒着的，里面好像有东西。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shi4 dao4 zhe5 de5 li3 mian4 hao3 xiang4 you3 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: The bowl was upside down, and something seemed to be inside.

sentences.hanzi: 他们把碗拿起来，看到一些又长又细的东西。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 ba3 wan3 na2 qi3 lai5 kan4 dao4 yi1 xie1 you4 chang2 you4 xi4 de5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: They lifted the bowl and saw some long, thin things.

sentences.hanzi: 这是面吗？四千年前的人也吃面吗？
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 mian4 ma5 si4 qian1 nian2 qian2 de5 ren2 ye3 chi1 mian4 ma5
sentences.english: Were these noodles? Did people four thousand years ago eat noodles too?

sentences.hanzi: 他们带回去看了很久，最后确定：这就是面，可能是用小米做的。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 dai4 hui2 qu5 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 zui4 hou4 que4 ding4 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 mian4 ke3 neng2 shi4 yong4 xiao3 mi3 zuo4 de5
sentences.english: They took them back and studied them for a long time. In the end they were sure: these were noodles, probably made of millet.

sentences.hanzi: 一碗面只要放几天，就坏了。四千年前的食物，怎么还在呢？
sentences.pinyin: yi1 wan3 mian4 zhi3 yao4 fang4 ji3 tian1 jiu4 huai4 le5 si4 qian1 nian2 qian2 de5 shi2 wu4 zen3 me5 hai2 zai4 ne5
sentences.english: A bowl of noodles goes bad in a few days. How could food from four thousand years ago still be here?

sentences.hanzi: 这碗面为什么没有吃完呢？
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 wan3 mian4 wei4 shen2 me5 mei2 you3 chi1 wan2 ne5
sentences.english: And why had nobody finished this bowl?

sentences.hanzi: 他们认为，四千年前，这里发生过地震，大水也来了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 ren4 wei2 si4 qian1 nian2 qian2 zhe4 li3 fa1 sheng1 guo5 di4 zhen4 da4 shui3 ye3 lai2 le5
sentences.english: They think that four thousand years ago there was an earthquake here, and a great flood came as well.

sentences.hanzi: 整个地方都没有了，很多人死了。
sentences.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 di4 fang5 dou1 mei2 you3 le5 hen3 duo1 ren2 si3 le5
sentences.english: The whole place was gone, and many people died.

sentences.hanzi: 那一天，也许有一个妈妈刚做好饭。
sentences.pinyin: na4 yi1 tian1 ye3 xu3 you3 yi1 ge5 ma1 ma5 gang1 zuo4 hao3 fan4
sentences.english: That day, perhaps a mother had just finished cooking.

sentences.hanzi: 也许她的孩子饿了，正在跑回家吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: ye3 xu3 ta1 de5 hai2 zi5 e4 le5 zheng4 zai4 pao3 hui2 jia1 chi1 fan4
sentences.english: Perhaps her child was hungry and running home to eat.

sentences.hanzi: 可是没有人吃完这碗面。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 mei2 you3 ren2 chi1 wan2 zhe4 wan3 mian4
sentences.english: But nobody finished this bowl of noodles.

sentences.hanzi: 碗倒了，水来了，面留下来了。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 dao3 le5 shui3 lai2 le5 mian4 liu2 xia4 lai2 le5
sentences.english: The bowl tipped over, the water came, and the noodles stayed.

sentences.hanzi: 四千年以后，它还在等人来吃。
sentences.pinyin: si4 qian1 nian2 yi3 hou4 ta1 hai2 zai4 deng3 ren2 lai2 chi1
sentences.english: Four thousand years later, it was still waiting for someone to come and eat.

glossed.meaning: Lajia, an ancient site in Qinghai

title: 太空里的第一次晚餐
titlePinyin: tai4 kong1 li3 de5 di4 yi1 ci4 wan3 can1

sentences.hanzi: 新的空间站开始工作了，里面住着十二个人。
sentences.pinyin: xin1 de5 kong1 jian1 zhan4 kai1 shi3 gong1 zuo4 le5 li3 mian4 zhu4 zhe5 shi2 er4 ge4 ren2
sentences.english: The new space station had started work, and twelve people lived on it.

sentences.hanzi: 今天晚上，是他们在这里的第一次晚餐。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wan3 shang5 shi4 ta1 men5 zai4 zhe4 li3 de5 di4 yi1 ci4 wan3 can1
sentences.english: Tonight was their first dinner here.

sentences.hanzi: 大家都很高兴。厨房的机器做了鸡、鱼汤和蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 hen3 gao1 xing4 chu2 fang2 de5 ji1 qi4 zuo4 le5 ji1 yu2 tang1 he2 dan4 gao1
sentences.english: Everyone was happy. The machine in the kitchen had made chicken, fish soup and cake.

sentences.hanzi: 菜很漂亮。可是大家尝了一下，都不说话了。
sentences.pinyin: cai4 hen3 piao4 liang5 ke3 shi4 da4 jia1 chang2 le5 yi1 xia4 dou1 bu4 shuo1 hua4 le5
sentences.english: The food looked beautiful. But when they tasted it, nobody spoke.

sentences.hanzi: “这是鸡吗？”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 ji1 ma5
sentences.english: "Is this chicken?"

sentences.hanzi: “我吃的是鱼，还是蛋糕？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 chi1 de5 shi4 yu2 hai2 shi5 dan4 gao1
sentences.english: "Am I eating the fish or the cake?"

sentences.hanzi: 在太空里，很多人吃什么都没有味道。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 tai4 kong1 li3 hen3 duo1 ren2 chi1 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 you3 wei4 dao5
sentences.english: In space, everything tastes of nothing to many people.

sentences.hanzi: 地球上的美味，到了这里，都成了一样的东西。
sentences.pinyin: di4 qiu2 shang4 de5 mei3 wei4 dao4 le5 zhe4 li3 dou1 cheng2 le5 yi1 yang4 de5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: The delicious food of Earth all turns into the same thing up here.

sentences.hanzi: 大家看着盘里的菜，没有人想吃了。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 kan4 zhe5 pan2 li3 de5 cai4 mei2 you3 ren2 xiang3 chi1 le5
sentences.english: They looked at the food on their plates. Nobody wanted to eat any more.

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，最老的老陈站起来，走了出去。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 zui4 lao3 de5 lao3 chen2 zhan4 qi3 lai5 zou3 le5 chu1 qu4
sentences.english: Just then old Chen, the oldest of them, stood up and walked out.

sentences.hanzi: 他回来的时候，手上拿着一个小瓶。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hui2 lai5 de5 shi2 hou5 shou3 shang4 na2 zhe5 yi1 ge5 xiao3 ping2
sentences.english: When he came back, he was holding a small bottle.

sentences.hanzi: “这是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: "What's that?"

sentences.hanzi: “我妈妈做的辣油。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ma1 ma5 zuo4 de5 la4 you2
sentences.english: "Chili oil my mother made."

sentences.hanzi: 他在每个盘里都放了一点。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 mei3 ge5 pan2 li3 dou1 fang4 le5 yi1 dian3
sentences.english: He put a little on every plate.

sentences.hanzi: 很快，整个空间站都香了。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 zheng3 ge4 kong1 jian1 zhan4 dou1 xiang1 le5
sentences.english: Soon the whole space station smelled delicious.

sentences.hanzi: 有人尝了一下，马上站起来找水。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 chang2 le5 yi1 xia4 ma3 shang4 zhan4 qi3 lai5 zhao3 shui3
sentences.english: Someone tasted it and jumped up at once to look for water.

sentences.hanzi: “太辣了！”他喝了一大杯水，又说：“再来一点！”
sentences.pinyin: tai4 la4 le5 ta1 he1 le5 yi1 da4 bei1 shui3 you4 shuo1 zai4 lai2 yi1 dian3
sentences.english: "Too hot!" He drank a big glass of water, then said: "A bit more!"

sentences.hanzi: 这天晚上，所有的菜都吃完了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 wan3 shang5 suo3 you3 de5 cai4 dou1 chi1 wan2 le5
sentences.english: That night, all the food was eaten.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，地球问他们：“你们还需要什么？要不要新的机器？”
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 di4 qiu2 wen4 ta1 men5 ni3 men5 hai2 xu1 yao4 shen2 me5 yao4 bu4 yao4 xin1 de5 ji1 qi4
sentences.english: The next day Earth asked them: "What else do you need? Do you want a new machine?"

sentences.hanzi: 大家想了想，说：“不要机器。请把老陈的妈妈送上来！”
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 bu4 yao4 ji1 qi4 qing3 ba3 lao3 chen2 de5 ma1 ma5 song4 shang4 lai2
sentences.english: They thought about it and said: "No machine. Please send up old Chen's mother!"

sentences.hanzi: 唐朝的时候，长安的人非常喜欢吃一种饼，叫胡饼。
sentences.pinyin: tang2 chao2 de5 shi2 hou5 chang2 an1 de5 ren2 fei1 chang2 xi3 huan5 chi1 yi1 zhong3 bing3 jiao4 hu2 bing3
sentences.english: In the Tang dynasty, the people of Chang'an loved a kind of flatbread called hu bing.

sentences.hanzi: 这种饼是从很远的地方来的。饼上有很多芝麻，烤出来特别香。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 bing3 shi4 cong2 hen3 yuan3 de5 di4 fang5 lai2 de5 bing3 shang4 you3 hen3 duo1 zhi1 ma2 kao3 chu1 lai2 te4 bie2 xiang1
sentences.english: This bread came from far away. It had lots of sesame on top and smelled wonderful when baked.

sentences.hanzi: 阿福就是做胡饼的。他在离长安不远的路旁边，烤了很多年饼。
sentences.pinyin: a1 fu2 jiu4 shi4 zuo4 hu2 bing3 de5 ta1 zai4 li2 chang2 an1 bu4 yuan3 de5 lu4 pang2 bian1 kao3 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2 bing3
sentences.english: Afu was a hu bing maker. He had been baking beside a road not far from Chang'an for many years.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，来了很多很多人。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 lai2 le5 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 ren2
sentences.english: One day, a huge crowd of people came.

sentences.hanzi: 他们都饿了，可是走得很快，谁也不说话。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 dou1 e4 le5 ke3 shi4 zou3 de5 hen3 kuai4 shei2 ye3 bu4 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: They were all hungry, but they walked fast, and nobody spoke.

sentences.hanzi: 阿福听说，长安发生了很大的事，有人带着很多人打了过来。
sentences.pinyin: a1 fu2 ting1 shuo1 chang2 an1 fa1 sheng1 le5 hen3 da4 de5 shi4 you3 ren2 dai4 zhe5 hen3 duo1 ren2 da3 le5 guo4 lai2
sentences.english: Afu heard that something huge had happened in Chang'an: someone had come to attack with a large force.

sentences.hanzi: 他不相信。长安这么大，谁敢打长安？
sentences.pinyin: ta1 bu4 xiang1 xin4 chang2 an1 zhe4 me5 da4 shei2 gan3 da3 chang2 an1
sentences.english: He didn't believe it. Chang'an was so great. Who would dare attack it?

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，一个穿漂亮衣服的男人走过来，说：“这些饼，我都要了。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 yi1 ge5 chuan1 piao4 liang5 yi1 fu5 de5 nan2 ren2 zou3 guo4 lai2 shuo1 zhe4 xie1 bing3 wo3 dou1 yao4 le5
sentences.english: Just then a man in beautiful clothes came over and said: "I'll take all these breads."

sentences.hanzi: 阿福问：“您要这么多做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: a1 fu2 wen4 nin2 yao4 zhe4 me5 duo1 zuo4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: Afu asked: "What do you want so many for?"

sentences.hanzi: 男人没有说话，只是把饼都拿了过去。
sentences.pinyin: nan2 ren2 mei2 you3 shuo1 hua4 zhi3 shi4 ba3 bing3 dou1 na2 le5 guo4 qu4
sentences.english: The man said nothing and just took all the bread.

sentences.hanzi: 阿福向那边看。路旁边坐着一个老人，穿得比谁都好。
sentences.pinyin: a1 fu2 xiang4 na4 bian5 kan4 lu4 pang2 bian1 zuo4 zhe5 yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 chuan1 de5 bi3 shei2 dou1 hao3
sentences.english: Afu looked over. An old man sat beside the road, better dressed than anyone.

sentences.hanzi: 这一天，他还什么都没有吃。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 tian1 ta1 hai2 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 you3 chi1
sentences.english: He had eaten nothing yet that day.

sentences.hanzi: 男人把饼送到他的手上。老人吃了很久，一句话也没有说。
sentences.pinyin: nan2 ren2 ba3 bing3 song4 dao4 ta1 de5 shou3 shang4 lao3 ren2 chi1 le5 hen3 jiu3 yi1 ju4 hua4 ye3 mei2 you3 shuo1
sentences.english: The man put a bread in his hands. The old man ate slowly, without a word.

sentences.hanzi: 阿福问旁边的人：“他是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: a1 fu2 wen4 pang2 bian1 de5 ren2 ta1 shi4 shei2
sentences.english: Afu asked someone nearby: "Who is he?"

sentences.hanzi: 那个人说：“别问了。他是皇帝。”
sentences.pinyin: na4 ge5 ren2 shuo1 bie2 wen4 le5 ta1 shi4 huang2 di4
sentences.english: The person said: "Don't ask. He's the emperor."

sentences.hanzi: 阿福站在那里，动也不敢动。
sentences.pinyin: a1 fu2 zhan4 zai4 na4 li5 dong4 ye3 bu4 gan3 dong4
sentences.english: Afu stood there, not daring to move.

sentences.hanzi: 皇帝吃过世界上所有的美味。
sentences.pinyin: huang2 di4 chi1 guo5 shi4 jie4 shang4 suo3 you3 de5 mei3 wei4
sentences.english: The emperor had eaten all the delicacies in the world.

sentences.hanzi: 可是这一天，他的午饭只有一个路旁边的胡饼。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 yi1 tian1 ta1 de5 wu3 fan4 zhi3 you3 yi1 ge5 lu4 pang2 bian1 de5 hu2 bing3
sentences.english: But on this day, his lunch was just one hu bing from the side of the road.

sentences.hanzi: 阿福想，这也许是他吃过最好吃的饼。
sentences.pinyin: a1 fu2 xiang3 zhe4 ye3 xu3 shi4 ta1 chi1 guo5 zui4 hao3 chi1 de5 bing3
sentences.english: Afu thought: perhaps it was the best bread he had ever tasted.

sentences.hanzi: 广东人喜欢去餐厅喝茶。一杯茶，几盘早点，可以坐很久。
sentences.pinyin: guang3 dong1 ren2 xi3 huan5 qu4 can1 ting1 he1 cha2 yi1 bei1 cha2 ji3 pan2 zao3 dian3 ke3 yi3 zuo4 hen3 jiu3
sentences.english: People in Guangdong love going to restaurants for tea. With a cup of tea and a few plates of breakfast dishes, you can sit for ages.

sentences.hanzi: 在那里，你会看到一件特别的事。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 na4 li5 ni3 hui4 kan4 dao4 yi1 jian4 te4 bie2 de5 shi4
sentences.english: There you'll see something special.

sentences.hanzi: 朋友给你倒茶，你不说谢谢，只用手指在茶杯旁边点两下。
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 gei3 ni3 dao4 cha2 ni3 bu4 shuo1 xie4 xie5 zhi3 yong4 shou3 zhi3 zai4 cha2 bei1 pang2 bian1 dian3 liang3 xia4
sentences.english: A friend pours your tea. You don't say thank you, you just tap twice beside the cup with your fingers.

sentences.hanzi: 这是为什么呢？听说，这和一个皇帝有关系。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5 ting1 shuo1 zhe4 he2 yi1 ge5 huang2 di4 you3 guan1 xi5
sentences.english: Why is that? They say it has to do with an emperor.

sentences.hanzi: 听说，清朝的乾隆皇帝出去玩的时候，喜欢穿得和大家一样。
sentences.pinyin: ting1 shuo1 qing1 chao2 de5 qian2 long2 huang2 di4 chu1 qu4 wan2 de5 shi2 hou5 xi3 huan5 chuan1 de5 he2 da4 jia1 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: They say that Emperor Qianlong of the Qing dynasty, when he went out, liked to dress like everyone else.

sentences.hanzi: 有一次，他带着几个人，走进了一个小餐馆。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 ci4 ta1 dai4 zhe5 ji3 ge4 ren2 zou3 jin4 le5 yi1 ge5 xiao3 can1 guan3
sentences.english: Once he took a few men with him and walked into a small restaurant.

sentences.hanzi: 他不想让大家知道他是皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 bu4 xiang3 rang4 da4 jia1 zhi1 dao4 ta1 shi4 huang2 di4
sentences.english: He didn't want anyone to know he was the emperor.

sentences.hanzi: 茶很香。皇帝拿起茶，给旁边的人倒了一杯。
sentences.pinyin: cha2 hen3 xiang1 huang2 di4 na2 qi3 cha2 gei3 pang2 bian1 de5 ren2 dao4 le5 yi1 bei1
sentences.english: The tea smelled wonderful. The emperor picked it up and poured a cup for the man beside him.

sentences.hanzi: 那个人非常害怕。皇帝给我倒茶！
sentences.pinyin: na4 ge5 ren2 fei1 chang2 hai4 pa4 huang2 di4 gei3 wo3 dao4 cha2
sentences.english: The man was terrified. The emperor was pouring him tea!

sentences.hanzi: 如果在别的地方，他要马上跪下来，说：“谢谢皇帝！”
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zai4 bie2 de5 di4 fang5 ta1 yao4 ma3 shang4 gui4 xia4 lai5 shuo1 xie4 xie5 huang2 di4
sentences.english: Anywhere else he would have to kneel at once and say: "Thank you, Your Majesty!"

sentences.hanzi: 可是这里不能跪。他一跪，大家就都知道了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 li3 bu4 neng2 gui4 ta1 yi1 gui4 da4 jia1 jiu4 dou1 zhi1 dao4 le5
sentences.english: But he couldn't kneel here. If he did, everyone would know.

sentences.hanzi: 不跪，也不可以。怎么办？
sentences.pinyin: bu4 gui4 ye3 bu4 ke3 yi3 zen3 me5 ban4
sentences.english: But he couldn't not kneel either. What could he do?

sentences.hanzi: 他想到了一个办法。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 dao4 le5 yi1 ge5 ban4 fa3
sentences.english: He thought of a way.

sentences.hanzi: 他把两个手指放在茶杯旁边，点了两下。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ba3 liang3 ge4 shou3 zhi3 fang4 zai4 cha2 bei1 pang2 bian1 dian3 le5 liang3 xia4
sentences.english: He put two fingers beside the cup and tapped twice.

sentences.hanzi: 你看，这两个手指，就像一个跪着的小人。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 kan4 zhe4 liang3 ge4 shou3 zhi3 jiu4 xiang4 yi1 ge5 gui4 zhe5 de5 xiao3 ren2
sentences.english: Look: those two fingers are just like a tiny person kneeling.

sentences.hanzi: 皇帝看懂了，什么也没有说。
sentences.pinyin: huang2 di4 kan4 dong3 le5 shen2 me5 ye3 mei2 you3 shuo1
sentences.english: The emperor understood and said nothing.

sentences.hanzi: 今天在广东，很多人还是这样说谢谢。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 zai4 guang3 dong1 hen3 duo1 ren2 hai2 shi5 zhe4 yang4 shuo1 xie4 xie5
sentences.english: Today in Guangdong, many people still say thank you this way.

sentences.hanzi: 如果有人给你倒茶，你也试试吧。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 you3 ren2 gei3 ni3 dao4 cha2 ni3 ye3 shi4 shi5 ba5
sentences.english: If someone pours you tea, give it a try.

sentences.hanzi: 别说话，让你的手指跪下来。
sentences.pinyin: bie2 shuo1 hua4 rang4 ni3 de5 shou3 zhi3 gui4 xia4 lai5
sentences.english: Don't say a word. Let your fingers kneel.

glossed.meaning: Guangdong, a province in southern China

sentences.hanzi: 两千多年前的书里说，有一个有名的医生，叫扁鹊。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 de5 shu1 li3 shuo1 you3 yi1 ge5 you3 ming2 de5 yi1 sheng1 jiao4 bian3 que4
sentences.english: A book from over two thousand years ago tells of a famous doctor called Bian Que.

sentences.hanzi: 他看人的脸，就知道这个人有什么病。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 ren2 de5 lian3 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 ge5 ren2 you3 shen2 me5 bing4
sentences.english: He could look at a person's face and know what illness they had.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，他见到了蔡桓公。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 ta1 jian4 dao4 le5 cai4 huan2 gong1
sentences.english: One day he met Duke Huan of Cai.

sentences.hanzi: 他看了看蔡桓公的脸，说：“您生病了。病在皮肤上，现在治疗还不难。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 cai4 huan2 gong1 de5 lian3 shuo1 nin2 sheng1 bing4 le5 bing4 zai4 pi2 fu1 shang4 xian4 zai4 zhi4 liao2 hai2 bu4 nan2
sentences.english: He looked at the duke's face and said: "You are ill. The illness is in your skin, and treating it now isn't hard."

sentences.hanzi: 蔡桓公说：“我没有病。”
sentences.pinyin: cai4 huan2 gong1 shuo1 wo3 mei2 you3 bing4
sentences.english: The duke said: "I'm not sick."

sentences.hanzi: 扁鹊走了以后，蔡桓公说：“医生就是这样，总说没有病的人有病。”
sentences.pinyin: bian3 que4 zou3 le5 yi3 hou4 cai4 huan2 gong1 shuo1 yi1 sheng1 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 zong3 shuo1 mei2 you3 bing4 de5 ren2 you3 bing4
sentences.english: After Bian Que left, the duke said: "Doctors are all like this, always saying healthy people are ill."

sentences.hanzi: 过了十天，扁鹊又来了：“您的病到肌肉里了。”
sentences.pinyin: guo4 le5 shi2 tian1 bian3 que4 you4 lai2 le5 nin2 de5 bing4 dao4 ji1 rou4 li3 le5
sentences.english: Ten days later Bian Que came again: "Your illness has reached your muscles."

sentences.hanzi: 蔡桓公不说话。
sentences.pinyin: cai4 huan2 gong1 bu4 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: The duke said nothing.

sentences.hanzi: 又过了十天，扁鹊说：“您的病到肚子里了。再不治疗，就晚了。”
sentences.pinyin: you4 guo4 le5 shi2 tian1 bian3 que4 shuo1 nin2 de5 bing4 dao4 du4 zi5 li3 le5 zai4 bu4 zhi4 liao2 jiu4 wan3 le5
sentences.english: Ten days after that Bian Que said: "Your illness has reached your belly. If it isn't treated now, it will be too late."

sentences.hanzi: 蔡桓公还是不说话，很不高兴。
sentences.pinyin: cai4 huan2 gong1 hai2 shi5 bu4 shuo1 hua4 hen3 bu4 gao1 xing4
sentences.english: The duke still said nothing, and was very displeased.

sentences.hanzi: 又过了十天，扁鹊来了。他看了一下蔡桓公的脸，什么也没说，马上走了。
sentences.pinyin: you4 guo4 le5 shi2 tian1 bian3 que4 lai2 le5 ta1 kan4 le5 yi1 xia4 cai4 huan2 gong1 de5 lian3 shen2 me5 ye3 mei2 shuo1 ma3 shang4 zou3 le5
sentences.english: Ten days later Bian Que came, glanced at the duke's face, said nothing and left at once.

sentences.hanzi: 蔡桓公让人去问他：“这次你为什么不说话？”
sentences.pinyin: cai4 huan2 gong1 rang4 ren2 qu4 wen4 ta1 zhe4 ci4 ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: The duke sent someone to ask him: "Why didn't you say anything this time?"

sentences.hanzi: 扁鹊说：“病在皮肤上，可以用药。病在肌肉里、肚子里，也还有办法。”
sentences.pinyin: bian3 que4 shuo1 bing4 zai4 pi2 fu1 shang4 ke3 yi3 yong4 yao4 bing4 zai4 ji1 rou4 li3 du4 zi5 li3 ye3 hai2 you3 ban4 fa3
sentences.english: Bian Que said: "When an illness is in the skin, medicine can help. In the muscles or the belly, there is still a way."

sentences.hanzi: “现在病已经到了骨头里。谁也没有办法了。”
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 bing4 yi3 jing1 dao4 le5 gu3 tou5 li3 shei2 ye3 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 le5
sentences.english: "Now it has reached the bones. Nobody can do anything."

sentences.hanzi: 五天以后，蔡桓公的身体开始疼。
sentences.pinyin: wu3 tian1 yi3 hou4 cai4 huan2 gong1 de5 shen1 ti3 kai1 shi3 teng2
sentences.english: Five days later, the duke's body began to hurt.

sentences.hanzi: 他马上叫人去找扁鹊。可是扁鹊已经离开了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ma3 shang4 jiao4 ren2 qu4 zhao3 bian3 que4 ke3 shi4 bian3 que4 yi3 jing1 li2 kai1 le5
sentences.english: He sent for Bian Que at once. But Bian Que had already left.

sentences.hanzi: 蔡桓公很快就死了。
sentences.pinyin: cai4 huan2 gong1 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 si3 le5
sentences.english: The duke soon died.

sentences.hanzi: 今天，还有很多人这样说：“我没有病。”
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 hai2 you3 hen3 duo1 ren2 zhe4 yang4 shuo1 wo3 mei2 you3 bing4
sentences.english: Today, many people still say: "I'm not sick."

sentences.hanzi: 你呢？你上一次看医生，是什么时候？
sentences.pinyin: ni3 ne5 ni3 shang4 yi1 ci4 kan4 yi1 sheng1 shi4 shen2 me5 shi2 hou5
sentences.english: What about you? When did you last see a doctor?

sentences.hanzi: 一千八百年前，有一个很有名的医生，叫华佗。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 qian1 ba1 bai3 nian2 qian2 you3 yi1 ge5 hen3 you3 ming2 de5 yi1 sheng1 jiao4 hua4 tuo2
sentences.english: Eighteen hundred years ago there was a very famous doctor called Hua Tuo.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候，手术非常痛。可是华佗有一种药，病人喝了，就什么也不知道了。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 shou3 shu4 fei1 chang2 tong4 ke3 shi4 hua4 tuo2 you3 yi1 zhong3 yao4 bing4 ren2 he1 le5 jiu4 shen2 me5 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 le5
sentences.english: In those days surgery was terribly painful. But Hua Tuo had a medicine, and patients who drank it felt nothing.

sentences.hanzi: 手术做完了，病人还在睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: shou3 shu4 zuo4 wan2 le5 bing4 ren2 hai2 zai4 shui4 jiao4
sentences.english: When the operation was over, the patient was still asleep.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候，有一个非常重要的人，叫曹操。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 you3 yi1 ge5 fei1 chang2 zhong4 yao4 de5 ren2 jiao4 cao2 cao1
sentences.english: At the time, there was a very powerful man called Cao Cao.

sentences.hanzi: 曹操总是头疼，疼起来什么事都不能做。
sentences.pinyin: cao2 cao1 zong3 shi4 tou2 teng2 teng2 qi3 lai5 shen2 me5 shi4 dou1 bu4 neng2 zuo4
sentences.english: Cao Cao always had headaches. When they came, he could do nothing.

sentences.hanzi: 他叫华佗来。华佗一治疗，他的头就不疼了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 jiao4 hua4 tuo2 lai2 hua4 tuo2 yi1 zhi4 liao2 ta1 de5 tou2 jiu4 bu4 teng2 le5
sentences.english: He called for Hua Tuo. As soon as Hua Tuo treated him, the pain stopped.

sentences.hanzi: 曹操要华佗留下来，只给他一个人看病。
sentences.pinyin: cao2 cao1 yao4 hua4 tuo2 liu2 xia4 lai5 zhi3 gei3 ta1 yi1 ge5 ren2 kan4 bing4
sentences.english: Cao Cao told Hua Tuo to stay and treat only him.

sentences.hanzi: 可是华佗不愿意。他说：“我妻子病了，我要回家看看。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 hua4 tuo2 bu4 yuan4 yi4 ta1 shuo1 wo3 qi1 zi5 bing4 le5 wo3 yao4 hui2 jia1 kan4 kan5
sentences.english: But Hua Tuo wasn't willing. He said: "My wife is ill. I need to go home and see her."

sentences.hanzi: 他回了家，就不回来了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hui2 le5 jia1 jiu4 bu4 hui2 lai5 le5
sentences.english: He went home and didn't come back.

sentences.hanzi: 曹操让人去看，发现他的妻子没有病。
sentences.pinyin: cao2 cao1 rang4 ren2 qu4 kan4 fa1 xian4 ta1 de5 qi1 zi5 mei2 you3 bing4
sentences.english: Cao Cao sent someone to check, and found his wife wasn't ill.

sentences.hanzi: 曹操让人把他抓了回来，要杀他。
sentences.pinyin: cao2 cao1 rang4 ren2 ba3 ta1 zhua1 le5 hui2 lai5 yao4 sha1 ta1
sentences.english: Cao Cao had him arrested and brought back, and meant to kill him.

sentences.hanzi: 有人求曹操，别杀这样的医生。曹操不听。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 qiu2 cao2 cao1 bie2 sha1 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi1 sheng1 cao2 cao1 bu4 ting1
sentences.english: Someone begged Cao Cao not to kill such a doctor. Cao Cao wouldn't listen.

sentences.hanzi: 死之前，华佗拿出自己写的东西，给了看着他的人。
sentences.pinyin: si3 zhi1 qian2 hua4 tuo2 na2 chu1 zi4 ji3 xie3 de5 dong1 xi5 gei3 le5 kan4 zhe5 ta1 de5 ren2
sentences.english: Before he died, Hua Tuo took out what he had written and gave it to his guard.

sentences.hanzi: 那个人不敢要。华佗没有办法，把它烧了。
sentences.pinyin: na4 ge5 ren2 bu4 gan3 yao4 hua4 tuo2 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 ba3 ta1 shao1 le5
sentences.english: The man didn't dare take it. Hua Tuo saw no other way, and burned it.

sentences.hanzi: 之后，曹操最爱的儿子曹冲生病了。
sentences.pinyin: zhi1 hou4 cao2 cao1 zui4 ai4 de5 er2 zi5 cao2 chong1 sheng1 bing4 le5
sentences.english: Later, Cao Cao's favourite son, Cao Chong, fell ill.

sentences.hanzi: 所有的医生都来了，都没有办法。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 yi1 sheng1 dou1 lai2 le5 dou1 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3
sentences.english: All the doctors came, and none of them could help.

sentences.hanzi: 孩子死了。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 si3 le5
sentences.english: The boy died.

sentences.hanzi: 曹操说：“我不应该杀华佗。这孩子死，是因为我。”
sentences.pinyin: cao2 cao1 shuo1 wo3 bu4 ying1 gai1 sha1 hua4 tuo2 zhe4 hai2 zi5 si3 shi4 yin1 wei4 wo3
sentences.english: Cao Cao said: "I should not have killed Hua Tuo. This child's death is because of me."

sentences.hanzi: 今天，还是没有人知道，华佗的药是什么。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 hai2 shi5 mei2 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4 hua4 tuo2 de5 yao4 shi4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: Even today, nobody knows what Hua Tuo's medicine was.

glossed.meaning: Hua Tuo, a Han dynasty doctor
Cao Cao, a warlord and statesman

title: 一个月不洗头
titlePinyin: yi1 ge5 yue4 bu4 xi3 tou2
titleEnglish: A Month Without Washing Your Hair

sentences.hanzi: 安娜是美国人，住在中国。她怀孕了。
sentences.pinyin: an1 na4 shi4 mei3 guo2 ren2 zhu4 zai4 zhong1 guo2 ta1 huai2 yun4 le5
sentences.english: Anna is American and lives in China. She was pregnant.

sentences.hanzi: 孩子才一天大，她就想回家洗头。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 cai2 yi1 tian1 da4 ta1 jiu4 xiang3 hui2 jia1 xi3 tou2
sentences.english: When the baby was only a day old, she wanted to go home and wash her hair.

sentences.hanzi: 婆婆说：“不能洗！你要坐月子。”
sentences.pinyin: po2 po5 shuo1 bu4 neng2 xi3 ni3 yao4 zuo4 yue4 zi5
sentences.english: Her mother-in-law said: "No washing! You have to do the sitting month."

sentences.hanzi: “什么是坐月子？”
sentences.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi4 zuo4 yue4 zi5
sentences.english: "What's the sitting month?"

sentences.hanzi: “生了孩子，一个月不出去，不洗头，多吃，多睡，多休息。”
sentences.pinyin: sheng1 le5 hai2 zi5 yi1 ge5 yue4 bu4 chu1 qu4 bu4 xi3 tou2 duo1 chi1 duo1 shui4 duo1 xiu1 xi5
sentences.english: "After a baby, for one month you don't go out, you don't wash your hair, you eat lots, sleep lots and rest lots."

sentences.hanzi: 安娜问医生。医生说：“你的身体很好，可以洗头。”
sentences.pinyin: an1 na4 wen4 yi1 sheng1 yi1 sheng1 shuo1 ni3 de5 shen1 ti3 hen3 hao3 ke3 yi3 xi3 tou2
sentences.english: Anna asked the doctor. The doctor said: "You're fine. You can wash your hair."

sentences.hanzi: 可是婆婆不听。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 po2 po5 bu4 ting1
sentences.english: But her mother-in-law wouldn't listen.

sentences.hanzi: 安娜说：“在美国，很多妈妈生了孩子，很快就开始工作。我不是病人！”
sentences.pinyin: an1 na4 shuo1 zai4 mei3 guo2 hen3 duo1 ma1 ma5 sheng1 le5 hai2 zi5 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 kai1 shi3 gong1 zuo4 wo3 bu4 shi4 bing4 ren2
sentences.english: Anna said: "In America, many mothers go back to work soon after having a baby. I'm not a patient!"

sentences.hanzi: 婆婆没有说话，又给她拿来吃的。
sentences.pinyin: po2 po5 mei2 you3 shuo1 hua4 you4 gei3 ta1 na2 lai2 chi1 de5
sentences.english: Her mother-in-law said nothing and brought her more food.

sentences.hanzi: 第一周，安娜觉得这个月太长了。
sentences.pinyin: di4 yi1 zhou1 an1 na4 jue2 de5 zhe4 ge5 yue4 tai4 chang2 le5
sentences.english: In the first week, Anna felt this month was far too long.

sentences.hanzi: 可是晚上，孩子一动，婆婆就走过来，把孩子带出去。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wan3 shang5 hai2 zi5 yi1 dong4 po2 po5 jiu4 zou3 guo4 lai2 ba3 hai2 zi5 dai4 chu1 qu4
sentences.english: But at night, whenever the baby stirred, her mother-in-law came and took the baby out.

sentences.hanzi: “你睡，我来。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 shui4 wo3 lai2
sentences.english: "You sleep. I'll do it."

sentences.hanzi: 安娜睡了，婆婆没有睡。
sentences.pinyin: an1 na4 shui4 le5 po2 po5 mei2 you3 shui4
sentences.english: Anna slept. Her mother-in-law didn't.

sentences.hanzi: 婆婆腿疼，可是每个晚上，她都起来很多次。
sentences.pinyin: po2 po5 tui3 teng2 ke3 shi4 mei3 ge5 wan3 shang5 ta1 dou1 qi3 lai5 hen3 duo1 ci4
sentences.english: Her mother-in-law's legs hurt, but every night she got up many times.

sentences.hanzi: 一个月的最后一天，安娜问：“您生孩子的时候，也这样吗？”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 yue4 de5 zui4 hou4 yi1 tian1 an1 na4 wen4 nin2 sheng1 hai2 zi5 de5 shi2 hou5 ye3 zhe4 yang4 ma5
sentences.english: On the last day of the month, Anna asked: "When you had your baby, was it like this too?"

sentences.hanzi: 婆婆想了很久，说：“没有。”
sentences.pinyin: po2 po5 xiang3 le5 hen3 jiu3 shuo1 mei2 you3
sentences.english: Her mother-in-law thought for a long time and said: "No."

sentences.hanzi: “我生了孩子，第三天就去地里工作了。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 sheng1 le5 hai2 zi5 di4 san1 tian1 jiu4 qu4 di4 li3 gong1 zuo4 le5
sentences.english: "Two days after I gave birth, I was back working in the fields."

sentences.hanzi: “没有人让我休息。我的腿现在还疼。”
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 ren2 rang4 wo3 xiu1 xi5 wo3 de5 tui3 xian4 zai4 hai2 teng2
sentences.english: "Nobody let me rest. My legs still hurt."

sentences.hanzi: “所以，我不想让你也这样。”
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 bu4 xiang3 rang4 ni3 ye3 zhe4 yang4
sentences.english: "So I don't want you to go through that."

sentences.hanzi: 安娜不说话了。
sentences.pinyin: an1 na4 bu4 shuo1 hua4 le5
sentences.english: Anna fell silent.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，孩子动了。婆婆刚要起来，安娜说：“妈，您也休息吧。今天晚上，孩子我来。”
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 hai2 zi5 dong4 le5 po2 po5 gang1 yao4 qi3 lai5 an1 na4 shuo1 ma1 nin2 ye3 xiu1 xi5 ba5 jin1 tian1 wan3 shang5 hai2 zi5 wo3 lai2
sentences.english: That night the baby stirred. Her mother-in-law was just getting up when Anna said: "Mum, you rest too. Tonight, I'll see to the baby."

title: 住在对面的药
titlePinyin: zhu4 zai4 dui4 mian4 de5 yao4

sentences.hanzi: 二一八零年，很多人不去医院了。
sentences.pinyin: er4 yi1 ba1 ling2 nian2 hen3 duo1 ren2 bu4 qu4 yi1 yuan4 le5
sentences.english: By the year 2180, many people no longer went to hospital.

sentences.hanzi: 每个家都有一个机器医生。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 ge5 jia1 dou1 you3 yi1 ge5 ji1 qi4 yi1 sheng1
sentences.english: Every home had a robot doctor.

sentences.hanzi: 老李家的机器医生叫小白。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 li3 jia1 de5 ji1 qi4 yi1 sheng1 jiao4 xiao3 bai2
sentences.english: Old Li's robot doctor was called Xiaobai.

sentences.hanzi: 小白看一下你的眼睛，听一下你的呼吸，就知道你的身体好不好。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 bai2 kan4 yi1 xia4 ni3 de5 yan3 jing5 ting1 yi1 xia4 ni3 de5 hu1 xi1 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 ni3 de5 shen1 ti3 hao3 bu4 hao3
sentences.english: Xiaobai only had to look at your eyes and listen to your breathing to know how healthy you were.

sentences.hanzi: 老李已经八十了，一个人住。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 li3 yi3 jing1 ba1 shi2 le5 yi1 ge5 ren2 zhu4
sentences.english: Old Li was already eighty and lived alone.

sentences.hanzi: 这一天，她说：“小白，我头疼。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 tian1 ta1 shuo1 xiao3 bai2 wo3 tou2 teng2
sentences.english: One day she said: "Xiaobai, my head hurts."

sentences.hanzi: “您的头没有问题。”
sentences.pinyin: nin2 de5 tou2 mei2 you3 wen4 ti2
sentences.english: "There's nothing wrong with your head."

sentences.hanzi: 第二天：“小白，我的腿疼。”
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 xiao3 bai2 wo3 de5 tui3 teng2
sentences.english: Next day: "Xiaobai, my leg hurts."

sentences.hanzi: “您的腿没有问题。”
sentences.pinyin: nin2 de5 tui3 mei2 you3 wen4 ti2
sentences.english: "There's nothing wrong with your leg."

sentences.hanzi: 第三天：“小白，我的心脏好像有问题。”
sentences.pinyin: di4 san1 tian1 xiao3 bai2 wo3 de5 xin1 zang4 hao3 xiang4 you3 wen4 ti2
sentences.english: The day after: "Xiaobai, I think there's something wrong with my heart."

sentences.hanzi: “您的心脏很健康。”
sentences.pinyin: nin2 de5 xin1 zang4 hen3 jian4 kang1
sentences.english: "Your heart is very healthy."

sentences.hanzi: 一个月过去了。小白什么病也没有发现。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 yue4 guo4 qu4 le5 xiao3 bai2 shen2 me5 bing4 ye3 mei2 you3 fa1 xian4
sentences.english: A month went by. Xiaobai found no illness at all.

sentences.hanzi: 可是它发现了一件奇怪的事。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 fa1 xian4 le5 yi1 jian4 qi2 guai4 de5 shi4
sentences.english: But it did notice something strange.

sentences.hanzi: 老李说完疼，从来不走。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 li3 shuo1 wan2 teng2 cong2 lai2 bu4 zou3
sentences.english: After she had said what hurt, old Li never left.

sentences.hanzi: 她总是继续说，说她的孩子，说她以前的工作，说今天下雨了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zong3 shi4 ji4 xu4 shuo1 shuo1 ta1 de5 hai2 zi5 shuo1 ta1 yi3 qian2 de5 gong1 zuo4 shuo1 jin1 tian1 xia4 yu3 le5
sentences.english: She always kept talking, about her children, her old job, and how it was raining today.

sentences.hanzi: 小白算了一下：老李已经一年没有和别人说过话了。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 bai2 suan4 le5 yi1 xia4 lao3 li3 yi3 jing1 yi1 nian2 mei2 you3 he2 bie2 ren5 shuo1 guo5 hua4 le5
sentences.english: Xiaobai did some calculating: old Li hadn't spoken to anyone else for a year.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，小白说：“您病了。”
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 xiao3 bai2 shuo1 nin2 bing4 le5
sentences.english: Next day, Xiaobai said: "You are ill."

sentences.hanzi: 老李看着它：“什么病？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 li3 kan4 zhe5 ta1 shen2 me5 bing4
sentences.english: Old Li looked at it: "What illness?"

sentences.hanzi: “这个病很多人都有。您的药住在对面，他叫老张。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bing4 hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 you3 nin2 de5 yao4 zhu4 zai4 dui4 mian4 ta1 jiao4 lao3 zhang1
sentences.english: "Many people have it. Your medicine lives across the hall. His name is old Zhang."

sentences.hanzi: 老李不相信，可是她还是去了。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 li3 bu4 xiang1 xin4 ke3 shi4 ta1 hai2 shi5 qu4 le5
sentences.english: Old Li didn't believe it, but she went anyway.

sentences.hanzi: 老张开了门，说：“你是老李吧？我的机器医生说，我的药住在对面。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhang1 kai1 le5 men2 shuo1 ni3 shi4 lao3 li3 ba5 wo3 de5 ji1 qi4 yi1 sheng1 shuo1 wo3 de5 yao4 zhu4 zai4 dui4 mian4
sentences.english: Old Zhang opened the door and said: "You must be old Li. My robot doctor says my medicine lives across the hall."

sentences.hanzi: 一个月以后，小白问：“您的头还疼吗？”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 yue4 yi3 hou4 xiao3 bai2 wen4 nin2 de5 tou2 hai2 teng2 ma5
sentences.english: A month later, Xiaobai asked: "Does your head still hurt?"

sentences.hanzi: “什么头？”老李说，“别问了，我要走了，我的药在等我。”
sentences.pinyin: shen2 me5 tou2 lao3 li3 shuo1 bie2 wen4 le5 wo3 yao4 zou3 le5 wo3 de5 yao4 zai4 deng3 wo3
sentences.english: "What head?" said old Li. "Stop asking. I have to go. My medicine is waiting for me."

title: 哈尔滨的口罩
titlePinyin: ha1 er3 bin1 de5 kou3 zhao4

sentences.hanzi: 一九一零年的冬天，中国的哈尔滨出现了一种会死人的病。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 jiu3 yi1 ling2 nian2 de5 dong1 tian1 zhong1 guo2 de5 ha1 er3 bin1 chu1 xian4 le5 yi1 zhong3 hui4 si3 ren2 de5 bing4
sentences.english: In the winter of 1910, a deadly disease appeared in Harbin, China.

sentences.hanzi: 病人胸疼，呼吸很难，嘴上有血，几天就死了。
sentences.pinyin: bing4 ren2 xiong1 teng2 hu1 xi1 hen3 nan2 zui3 shang4 you3 xue4 ji3 tian1 jiu4 si3 le5
sentences.english: Patients had chest pain, struggled to breathe, had blood on their lips, and died within days.

sentences.hanzi: 死的人一天比一天多。
sentences.pinyin: si3 de5 ren2 yi1 tian1 bi3 yi1 tian1 duo1
sentences.english: More people died every day.

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，一个年轻的医生到了哈尔滨。他叫伍连德，在英国学过。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 yi1 ge5 nian2 qing1 de5 yi1 sheng1 dao4 le5 ha1 er3 bin1 ta1 jiao4 wu3 lian2 de2 zai4 ying1 guo2 xue2 guo5
sentences.english: Then a young doctor arrived in Harbin. His name was Wu Lien-teh, and he had studied in England.

sentences.hanzi: 有一个病人死了，他看了这个人的身体，说：“人呼吸的时候，这种病就从一个人到了另一个人的身上。”
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 ge5 bing4 ren2 si3 le5 ta1 kan4 le5 zhe4 ge5 ren2 de5 shen1 ti3 shuo1 ren2 hu1 xi1 de5 shi2 hou5 zhe4 zhong3 bing4 jiu4 cong2 yi1 ge5 ren2 dao4 le5 ling4 yi1 ge5 ren2 de5 shen1 shang5
sentences.english: One patient died. He examined the body and said: "The disease passes from one person to another when they breathe."

sentences.hanzi: 很多医生不相信他。一位法国医生也不相信。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 yi1 sheng1 bu4 xiang1 xin4 ta1 yi1 wei4 fa3 guo2 yi1 sheng1 ye3 bu4 xiang1 xin4
sentences.english: Many doctors didn't believe him. Nor did a French doctor who had come to help.

sentences.hanzi: 伍连德想到一个简单的办法。
sentences.pinyin: wu3 lian2 de2 xiang3 dao4 yi1 ge5 jian3 dan1 de5 ban4 fa3
sentences.english: Wu Lien-teh thought of a simple solution.

sentences.hanzi: 他做了一种口罩，让医生、护士和病人都戴上。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 le5 yi1 zhong3 kou3 zhao4 rang4 yi1 sheng1 hu4 shi5 he2 bing4 ren2 dou1 dai4 shang4
sentences.english: He made a kind of mask and had doctors, nurses and patients all wear it.

sentences.hanzi: 法国医生不戴。他去医院看病人，和病人说话。
sentences.pinyin: fa3 guo2 yi1 sheng1 bu4 dai4 ta1 qu4 yi1 yuan4 kan4 bing4 ren2 he2 bing4 ren2 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: The French doctor wouldn't wear one. He went to the hospital to see patients and talk to them.

sentences.hanzi: 几天以后，他感染了这种病，很快就死了。
sentences.pinyin: ji3 tian1 yi3 hou4 ta1 gan3 ran3 le5 zhe4 zhong3 bing4 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 si3 le5
sentences.english: A few days later he caught the disease and soon died.

sentences.hanzi: 所有的人都看到了。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 ren2 dou1 kan4 dao4 le5
sentences.english: Everyone saw what had happened.

sentences.hanzi: 这以后，再也没有人说不。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi3 hou4 zai4 ye3 mei2 you3 ren2 shuo1 bu4
sentences.english: After that, nobody said no again.

sentences.hanzi: 哈尔滨的人都戴上了口罩。
sentences.pinyin: ha1 er3 bin1 de5 ren2 dou1 dai4 shang4 le5 kou3 zhao4
sentences.english: The people of Harbin all put on masks.

sentences.hanzi: 到了春天，这种病结束了。
sentences.pinyin: dao4 le5 chun1 tian1 zhe4 zhong3 bing4 jie2 shu4 le5
sentences.english: By spring, the disease was over.

sentences.hanzi: 这一次，死了六万人。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ci4 si3 le5 liu4 wan4 ren2
sentences.english: About sixty thousand people died that time.

sentences.hanzi: 可是如果没有那个简单的东西，还会死更多的人。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ru2 guo3 mei2 you3 na4 ge5 jian3 dan1 de5 dong1 xi5 hai2 hui4 si3 geng4 duo1 de5 ren2
sentences.english: But without that simple thing, far more would have died.

sentences.hanzi: 今天，手术的时候，医生都戴着口罩。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 shou3 shu4 de5 shi2 hou5 yi1 sheng1 dou1 dai4 zhe5 kou3 zhao4
sentences.english: Today, doctors all wear masks during surgery.

sentences.hanzi: 你戴上口罩的时候，可以想一想一九一零年的那个冬天。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 dai4 shang4 kou3 zhao4 de5 shi2 hou5 ke3 yi3 xiang3 yi1 xiang3 yi1 jiu3 yi1 ling2 nian2 de5 na4 ge5 dong1 tian1
sentences.english: When you put on a mask, you might think about that winter of 1910.

glossed.meaning: Harbin, a city in northeast China

sentences.hanzi: 今天，从西安坐飞机去印度，一天就到了。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 cong2 xi1 an1 zuo4 fei1 ji1 qu4 yin4 du4 yi1 tian1 jiu4 dao4 le5
sentences.english: Today, flying from Xi'an to India takes a day at most.

sentences.hanzi: 一千四百年前，有一个人走路去。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 qian1 si4 bai3 nian2 qian2 you3 yi1 ge5 ren2 zou3 lu4 qu4
sentences.english: One thousand four hundred years ago, a man went on foot.

sentences.hanzi: 他叫玄奘，是唐朝的和尚。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 jiao4 xuan2 zang4 shi4 tang2 chao2 de5 he2 shang5
sentences.english: His name was Xuanzang, and he was a monk of the Tang dynasty.

sentences.hanzi: 他看了很多佛经，可是有很多地方不明白。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 hen3 duo1 fo2 jing1 ke3 shi4 you3 hen3 duo1 di4 fang5 bu4 ming2 bai5
sentences.english: He had read many Buddhist scriptures, but there was a lot he didn't understand.

sentences.hanzi: 他想，印度的人一定知道。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 yin4 du4 de5 ren2 yi1 ding4 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: He thought: the people of India must know.

sentences.hanzi: 可是那时候，国家不让人们离开。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 na4 shi2 hou5 guo2 jia1 bu4 rang4 ren2 men5 li2 kai1
sentences.english: But at that time, the country didn't let people leave.

sentences.hanzi: 玄奘还是决定出发。
sentences.pinyin: xuan2 zang4 hai2 shi5 jue2 ding4 chu1 fa1
sentences.english: Xuanzang decided to set out anyway.

sentences.hanzi: 一天晚上，他走了，没有地图，也没有朋友。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 tian1 wan3 shang5 ta1 zou3 le5 mei2 you3 di4 tu2 ye3 mei2 you3 peng2 you5
sentences.english: One night he slipped away, with no map and no friends.

sentences.hanzi: 他的旅行非常难。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 lu:3 xing2 fei1 chang2 nan2
sentences.english: His journey was terribly hard.

sentences.hanzi: 前面是沙漠，一个人也没有。
sentences.pinyin: qian2 mian4 shi4 sha1 mo4 yi1 ge5 ren2 ye3 mei2 you3
sentences.english: Ahead lay the desert, without a single person.

sentences.hanzi: 有一次，他几天没有东西喝，人已经快死了。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 ci4 ta1 ji3 tian1 mei2 you3 dong1 xi5 he1 ren2 yi3 jing1 kuai4 si3 le5
sentences.english: Once he had nothing to drink for days and was close to death.

sentences.hanzi: 后面是大山，很多人死在那里。
sentences.pinyin: hou4 mian5 shi4 da4 shan1 hen3 duo1 ren2 si3 zai4 na4 li5
sentences.english: After that came great mountains, where many people died.

sentences.hanzi: 他走了很久，才到达印度。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 le5 hen3 jiu3 cai2 dao4 da2 yin4 du4
sentences.english: It took him a long time to reach India.

sentences.hanzi: 他在那里住了很久，成了一个很有名的人。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 na4 li5 zhu4 le5 hen3 jiu3 cheng2 le5 yi1 ge5 hen3 you3 ming2 de5 ren2
sentences.english: He stayed there a long time and became a famous man.

sentences.hanzi: 最后，他带着很多佛经回来了。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ta1 dai4 zhe5 hen3 duo1 fo2 jing1 hui2 lai5 le5
sentences.english: In the end he came back with a great many scriptures.

sentences.hanzi: 他走的时候，国家不让他走。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 de5 shi2 hou5 guo2 jia1 bu4 rang4 ta1 zou3
sentences.english: When he left, the country wouldn't let him go.

sentences.hanzi: 他回来的时候，大街上全是人，大家都来看他。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hui2 lai5 de5 shi2 hou5 da4 jie1 shang4 quan2 shi4 ren2 da4 jia1 dou1 lai2 kan4 ta1
sentences.english: When he came back, the streets were full of people, all come to see him.

sentences.hanzi: 今天，我们坐飞机去，一天就到了。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 zuo4 fei1 ji1 qu4 yi1 tian1 jiu4 dao4 le5
sentences.english: Today we fly there and arrive within a day.

sentences.hanzi: 可是玄奘走上这条路的时候，才二十多岁。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 xuan2 zang4 zou3 shang4 zhe4 tiao2 lu4 de5 shi2 hou5 cai2 er4 shi2 duo1 sui4
sentences.english: But when Xuanzang set out on this road, he was in his twenties.

sentences.hanzi: 他回来的时候，已经四十多了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hui2 lai5 de5 shi2 hou5 yi3 jing1 si4 shi2 duo1 le5
sentences.english: When he came back, he was past forty.

sentences.hanzi: 小林第一次来重庆旅行。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 di4 yi1 ci4 lai2 chong2 qing4 lu:3 xing2
sentences.english: Xiaolin was visiting Chongqing for the first time.

sentences.hanzi: 下了火车，他拿出手机，看了看地图。
sentences.pinyin: xia4 le5 huo3 che1 ta1 na2 chu1 shou3 ji1 kan4 le5 kan4 di4 tu2
sentences.english: Getting off the train, he took out his phone and looked at the map.

sentences.hanzi: 地图上说：酒店很近，走路只要几分钟。
sentences.pinyin: di4 tu2 shang4 shuo1 jiu3 dian4 hen3 jin4 zou3 lu4 zhi3 yao4 ji3 fen1 zhong1
sentences.english: The map said the hotel was very close, only a few minutes' walk.

sentences.hanzi: “太好了！”他拿着箱子走了。
sentences.pinyin: tai4 hao3 le5 ta1 na2 zhe5 xiang1 zi5 zou3 le5
sentences.english: "Great!" He set off with his suitcase.

sentences.hanzi: 几分钟以后，地图上说：已经到达。
sentences.pinyin: ji3 fen1 zhong1 yi3 hou4 di4 tu2 shang4 shuo1 yi3 jing1 dao4 da2
sentences.english: A few minutes later, the map said: Arrived.

sentences.hanzi: 小林看看左边，看看右边，看看前面，都没有酒店。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 kan4 kan5 zuo3 bian5 kan4 kan5 you4 bian5 kan4 kan5 qian2 mian4 dou1 mei2 you3 jiu3 dian4
sentences.english: Xiaolin looked left, right and straight ahead. No hotel.

sentences.hanzi: 最后他向上看。酒店在他的头上！
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ta1 xiang4 shang4 kan4 jiu3 dian4 zai4 ta1 de5 tou2 shang4
sentences.english: Finally he looked up. The hotel was over his head!

sentences.hanzi: 他没有办法，叫了出租车。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 jiao4 le5 chu1 zu1 che1
sentences.english: There was nothing for it. He called a taxi.

sentences.hanzi: 司机听了地址，说：“第一次来重庆吧？”
sentences.pinyin: si1 ji1 ting1 le5 di4 zhi3 shuo1 di4 yi1 ci4 lai2 chong2 qing4 ba5
sentences.english: The driver heard the address and said: "First time in Chongqing?"

sentences.hanzi: “这个城市都在山上。地图上很近，走起来很远。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 cheng2 shi4 dou1 zai4 shan1 shang4 di4 tu2 shang4 hen3 jin4 zou3 qi3 lai5 hen3 yuan3
sentences.english: "This whole city is on mountains. Close on the map, far on foot."

sentences.hanzi: 车开了很久，过了河，上了山，才到了酒店门前。
sentences.pinyin: che1 kai1 le5 hen3 jiu3 guo4 le5 he2 shang4 le5 shan1 cai2 dao4 le5 jiu3 dian4 men2 qian2
sentences.english: The car drove a long way, crossed the river and climbed the hill before it reached the hotel door.

sentences.hanzi: 小林走进大门，看到门旁边写着：二十二楼。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 zou3 jin4 da4 men2 kan4 dao4 men2 pang2 bian1 xie3 zhe5 er4 shi2 er4 lou2
sentences.english: Xiaolin walked through the main door and saw a sign beside it: twenty-second floor.

sentences.hanzi: 他问：“这里是二十二楼？可是门前就是大街！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 wen4 zhe4 li3 shi4 er4 shi2 er4 lou2 ke3 shi4 men2 qian2 jiu4 shi4 da4 jie1
sentences.english: He asked: "This is the twenty-second floor? But there's a street right outside the door!"

sentences.hanzi: 司机在后面说：“这算什么？”
sentences.pinyin: si1 ji1 zai4 hou4 mian5 shuo1 zhe4 suan4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: The driver said behind him: "That's nothing."

sentences.hanzi: “明天你去看看，有一种车从楼里开过去。”
sentences.pinyin: ming2 tian1 ni3 qu4 kan4 kan5 you3 yi1 zhong3 che1 cong2 lou2 li3 kai1 guo4 qu4
sentences.english: "Go and look tomorrow. There's a train that runs right through a building."

sentences.hanzi: 小林不相信。第二天他去了，这种车真从楼里开了过去。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 bu4 xiang1 xin4 di4 er4 tian1 ta1 qu4 le5 zhe4 zhong3 che1 zhen1 cong2 lou2 li3 kai1 le5 guo4 qu4
sentences.english: Xiaolin didn't believe it. He went the next day, and the train really did run through the building.

sentences.hanzi: 他把手机放回箱子里，对自己说：“在重庆，还是问司机吧。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ba3 shou3 ji1 fang4 hui2 xiang1 zi5 li3 dui4 zi4 ji3 shuo1 zai4 chong2 qing4 hai2 shi5 wen4 si1 ji1 ba5
sentences.english: He put his phone back in his case and said to himself: "In Chongqing, better ask a driver."

glossed.meaning: Chongqing, a city in southwest China

title: 海上来的麒麟
titlePinyin: hai3 shang4 lai2 de5 qi2 lin2
titleEnglish: The Qilin from Over the Sea

sentences.hanzi: 六百年前，明朝有一个人叫郑和。
sentences.pinyin: liu4 bai3 nian2 qian2 ming2 chao2 you3 yi1 ge5 ren2 jiao4 zheng4 he2
sentences.english: Six hundred years ago, in the Ming dynasty, there was a man called Zheng He.

sentences.hanzi: 他带着很多大船出发，在海上走了很远，到过很多国家。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dai4 zhe5 hen3 duo1 da4 chuan2 chu1 fa1 zai4 hai3 shang4 zou3 le5 hen3 yuan3 dao4 guo5 hen3 duo1 guo2 jia1
sentences.english: He set out with many great ships, sailed far across the sea and reached many countries.

sentences.hanzi: 船回来的时候，也带回来别的国家的人和东西。
sentences.pinyin: chuan2 hui2 lai5 de5 shi2 hou5 ye3 dai4 hui2 lai2 bie2 de5 guo2 jia1 de5 ren2 he2 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: When the ships came back, they brought people and things from other countries.

sentences.hanzi: 一四一四年，一个国家给皇帝送来一个东西。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 si4 yi1 si4 nian2 yi1 ge5 guo2 jia1 gei3 huang2 di4 song4 lai2 yi1 ge5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: In 1414, a country sent the emperor a gift.

sentences.hanzi: 这个东西是活的。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 dong1 xi5 shi4 huo2 de5
sentences.english: This gift was alive.

sentences.hanzi: 这次旅行很长。它坐了很久的船，才到达明朝的城市。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 lu:3 xing2 hen3 chang2 ta1 zuo4 le5 hen3 jiu3 de5 chuan2 cai2 dao4 da2 ming2 chao2 de5 cheng2 shi4
sentences.english: It was a long journey. It spent many days on a ship before it reached the Ming city.

sentences.hanzi: 它非常高，脖子特别长，头比门还高。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 fei1 chang2 gao1 bo2 zi5 te4 bie2 chang2 tou2 bi3 men2 hai2 gao1
sentences.english: It was very tall, with an especially long neck and a head higher than a door.

sentences.hanzi: 谁也没有见过这样的东西。
sentences.pinyin: shei2 ye3 mei2 you3 jian4 guo5 zhe4 yang4 de5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: Nobody had ever seen such a thing.

sentences.hanzi: 人们都跑到大街上看。它走过来，大家就跑。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 dou1 pao3 dao4 da4 jie1 shang4 kan4 ta1 zou3 guo4 lai2 da4 jia1 jiu4 pao3
sentences.english: People all ran into the street to look. When it walked towards them, they ran away.

sentences.hanzi: 这是什么？大家都不知道。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 shen2 me5 da4 jia1 dou1 bu4 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: What was it? Nobody knew.

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，送它来的人说：“是麒麟！”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 song4 ta1 lai2 de5 ren2 shuo1 shi4 qi2 lin2
sentences.english: Then the people who brought it said: "It's a qilin!"

sentences.hanzi: 老人们说，世界上有一种东西叫麒麟。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 men5 shuo1 shi4 jie4 shang4 you3 yi1 zhong3 dong1 xi5 jiao4 qi2 lin2
sentences.english: The old people said there was a thing called a qilin.

sentences.hanzi: 谁也没有见过它。可是人们相信，国家很好的时候，它才会出现。
sentences.pinyin: shei2 ye3 mei2 you3 jian4 guo5 ta1 ke3 shi4 ren2 men5 xiang1 xin4 guo2 jia1 hen3 hao3 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 cai2 hui4 chu1 xian4
sentences.english: Nobody had ever seen one. But people believed it only appeared when the country was doing well.

sentences.hanzi: 大家看着它，都说：“这就是麒麟！”
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 kan4 zhe5 ta1 dou1 shuo1 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 qi2 lin2
sentences.english: Everyone looked at it and said: "This is the qilin!"

sentences.hanzi: 大家又说：“麒麟来了，皇帝当然是好皇帝！”
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 you4 shuo1 qi2 lin2 lai2 le5 huang2 di4 dang1 ran2 shi4 hao3 huang2 di4
sentences.english: They added: "The qilin has come, so of course he's a good emperor!"

sentences.hanzi: 可是皇帝说：“只要国家好，没有麒麟也没有关系。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 huang2 di4 shuo1 zhi3 yao4 guo2 jia1 hao3 mei2 you3 qi2 lin2 ye3 mei2 you3 guan1 xi5
sentences.english: But the emperor said: "As long as the country is doing well, it doesn't matter if there's no qilin."

sentences.hanzi: 今天，我们知道它不是麒麟，是长颈鹿。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 ta1 bu4 shi4 qi2 lin2 shi4 chang2 jing3 lu4
sentences.english: Today we know it wasn't a qilin. It was a giraffe.

sentences.hanzi: 可是这个名字没有死。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 ming2 zi5 mei2 you3 si3
sentences.english: But the name didn't die.

sentences.hanzi: 在日本和韩国，人们现在还叫长颈鹿“麒麟”。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 ri4 ben3 he2 han2 guo2 ren2 men5 xian4 zai4 hai2 jiao4 chang2 jing3 lu4 qi2 lin2
sentences.english: In Japan and Korea, people still call the giraffe "qilin" today.
