sentences.hanzi: 在河北，有一座很老的桥，叫赵州桥。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 he2 bei3 you3 yi1 zuo4 hen3 lao3 de5 qiao2 jiao4 zhao4 zhou1 qiao2
sentences.english: In Hebei there is a very old bridge called Zhaozhou Bridge.

sentences.hanzi: 这座桥是石头做的，已经一千四百岁了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 zuo4 qiao2 shi4 shi2 tou5 zuo4 de5 yi3 jing1 yi1 qian1 si4 bai3 sui4 le5
sentences.english: The bridge is made of stone and is fourteen hundred years old.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，爸爸开车带小山去旅行，来看这座桥。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 ba4 ba5 kai1 che1 dai4 xiao3 shan1 qu4 lu:3 xing2 lai2 kan4 zhe4 zuo4 qiao2
sentences.english: One day a father took his son Xiaoshan on a drive to see the bridge.

sentences.hanzi: 他们把车停在停车场，走路过去，到了河旁边。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 ba3 che1 ting2 zai4 ting2 che1 chang3 zou3 lu4 guo4 qu4 dao4 le5 he2 pang2 bian1
sentences.english: They left the car in the car park, walked over, and reached the riverbank.

sentences.hanzi: 小山看了很久，说：“爸爸，这座桥坏了。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 shan1 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 shuo1 ba4 ba5 zhe4 zuo4 qiao2 huai4 le5
sentences.english: Xiaoshan looked for a long time and said: "Dad, this bridge is broken."

sentences.hanzi: “坏了？没有啊。”
sentences.pinyin: huai4 le5 mei2 you3 a5
sentences.english: "Broken? No it isn't."

sentences.hanzi: “你看，桥上有洞。左边两个，右边两个。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 kan4 qiao2 shang4 you3 dong4 zuo3 bian5 liang3 ge4 you4 bian5 liang3 ge4
sentences.english: "Look, the bridge has holes. Two on the left and two on the right."

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“那不是坏了。那是以前的人留的。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 shuo1 na4 bu4 shi4 huai4 le5 na4 shi4 yi3 qian2 de5 ren2 liu2 de5
sentences.english: His father said: "That's not damage. The people who built it long ago left them there."

sentences.hanzi: “为什么要留洞？”
sentences.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 liu2 dong4
sentences.english: "Why leave holes?"

sentences.hanzi: “河里的水多的时候，水会打到桥上。”
sentences.pinyin: he2 li3 de5 shui3 duo1 de5 shi2 hou5 shui3 hui4 da3 dao4 qiao2 shang4
sentences.english: "When the river is high, the water hits the bridge."

sentences.hanzi: “如果没有这些洞，水走不过去，桥就可能倒了。”
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 mei2 you3 zhe4 xie1 dong4 shui3 zou3 bu4 guo4 qu4 qiao2 jiu4 ke3 neng2 dao3 le5
sentences.english: "If these holes weren't there, the water couldn't get through, and the bridge might fall."

sentences.hanzi: “有了洞，水就从洞里走了。”
sentences.pinyin: you3 le5 dong4 shui3 jiu4 cong2 dong4 li3 zou3 le5
sentences.english: "With the holes, the water just goes through them."

sentences.hanzi: “这么多年，这里的水大过很多次。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 me5 duo1 nian2 zhe4 li3 de5 shui3 da4 guo5 hen3 duo1 ci4
sentences.english: "Over all these years, the water here has risen many times."

sentences.hanzi: “很多新桥都没有了，这座老桥还在。”
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 xin1 qiao2 dou1 mei2 you3 le5 zhe4 zuo4 lao3 qiao2 hai2 zai4
sentences.english: "Many newer bridges are gone, and this old one is still here."

sentences.hanzi: 小山想了想，看了看自己的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 shan1 xiang3 le5 xiang3 kan4 le5 kan4 zi4 ji3 de5 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: Xiaoshan thought about it and looked down at his clothes.

sentences.hanzi: 他的衣服上也有一个洞。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 yi1 fu5 shang4 ye3 you3 yi1 ge5 dong4
sentences.english: There was a hole in his clothes too.

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“我回家要告诉妈妈，这不是坏了。这是为了安全。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 hui2 jia1 yao4 gao4 su5 ma1 ma5 zhe4 bu4 shi4 huai4 le5 zhe4 shi4 wei4 le5 an1 quan2
sentences.english: He said: "When I get home I'm going to tell Mum this isn't damage. It's for safety."

title: 它怎么不说话
titlePinyin: ta1 zen3 me5 bu4 shuo1 hua4

sentences.hanzi: 二一三零年，已经没有人开车了。
sentences.pinyin: er4 yi1 san1 ling2 nian2 yi3 jing1 mei2 you3 ren2 kai1 che1 le5
sentences.english: By the year 2130, nobody drove any more.

sentences.hanzi: 汽车自己开，卡车自己开，出租车也自己开。
sentences.pinyin: qi4 che1 zi4 ji3 kai1 ka3 che1 zi4 ji3 kai1 chu1 zu1 che1 ye3 zi4 ji3 kai1
sentences.english: Cars drove themselves, trucks drove themselves, and so did taxis.

sentences.hanzi: 你坐进车里，说一个地址，就可以睡了。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 zuo4 jin4 che1 li3 shuo1 yi1 ge5 di4 zhi3 jiu4 ke3 yi3 shui4 le5
sentences.english: You got in, said an address, and could go to sleep.

sentences.hanzi: 人们不需要看地图，也不知道东南西北。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 bu4 xu1 yao4 kan4 di4 tu2 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 dong1 nan2 xi1 bei3
sentences.english: People didn't need to read maps, and didn't know north from south.

sentences.hanzi: 老陈已经八十了。他以前是卡车司机。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 chen2 yi3 jing1 ba1 shi2 le5 ta1 yi3 qian2 shi4 ka3 che1 si1 ji1
sentences.english: Old Chen was already eighty. He used to be a truck driver.

sentences.hanzi: 他的箱子里，还有一张很老的地图。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 xiang1 zi5 li3 hai2 you3 yi1 zhang1 hen3 lao3 de5 di4 tu2
sentences.english: In his case there was still a very old map.

sentences.hanzi: 这一天，老陈坐车去城市。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 tian1 lao3 chen2 zuo4 che1 qu4 cheng2 shi4
sentences.english: That day, old Chen was riding into the city.

sentences.hanzi: 车上了公路，很快就停了下来。
sentences.pinyin: che1 shang4 le5 gong1 lu4 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 ting2 le5 xia4 lai5
sentences.english: The car got onto the highway and soon stopped.

sentences.hanzi: 前面的车停了，后面的车也停了。整个国家的车都停了。
sentences.pinyin: qian2 mian4 de5 che1 ting2 le5 hou4 mian5 de5 che1 ye3 ting2 le5 zheng3 ge4 guo2 jia1 de5 che1 dou1 ting2 le5
sentences.english: The cars in front stopped, and so did the cars behind. Every car in the country had stopped.

sentences.hanzi: 电话也没有用了。
sentences.pinyin: dian4 hua4 ye3 mei2 you3 yong4 le5
sentences.english: Phones didn't work either.

sentences.hanzi: 人们下了车，站在公路旁边，不知道回家的方向。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 xia4 le5 che1 zhan4 zai4 gong1 lu4 pang2 bian1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 hui2 jia1 de5 fang1 xiang4
sentences.english: People got out and stood beside the highway, not knowing which way home was.

sentences.hanzi: 老陈从箱子里拿出了地图。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 chen2 cong2 xiang1 zi5 li3 na2 chu1 le5 di4 tu2
sentences.english: Old Chen took the map out of his case.

sentences.hanzi: 一个女孩问：“这是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 nu:3 hai2 wen4 zhe4 shi4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: A girl asked: "What's that?"

sentences.hanzi: “地图。”
sentences.pinyin: di4 tu2
sentences.english: "A map."

sentences.hanzi: 她看了很久，问：“它怎么不说话？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 wen4 ta1 zen3 me5 bu4 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: She looked at it for a long time and asked: "Why doesn't it talk?"

sentences.hanzi: 老陈说：“它不说话。你要自己看。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 chen2 shuo1 ta1 bu4 shuo1 hua4 ni3 yao4 zi4 ji3 kan4
sentences.english: Old Chen said: "It doesn't talk. You have to read it yourself."

sentences.hanzi: “这是北。我们向东走，过了桥，右边就是城市。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 bei3 wo3 men5 xiang4 dong1 zou3 guo4 le5 qiao2 you4 bian5 jiu4 shi4 cheng2 shi4
sentences.english: "This is north. We walk east, cross the bridge, and the city is on the right."

sentences.hanzi: 几百个人和他一起，走了四个小时，都到了。
sentences.pinyin: ji3 bai3 ge4 ren2 he2 ta1 yi1 qi3 zou3 le5 si4 ge4 xiao3 shi2 dou1 dao4 le5
sentences.english: Hundreds of people went with him, walked for four hours, and all arrived.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，车又开始走了，大家很快就忘了这件事。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 che1 you4 kai1 shi3 zou3 le5 da4 jia1 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 wang4 le5 zhe4 jian4 shi4
sentences.english: The next day the cars started moving again, and everyone soon forgot about it.

sentences.hanzi: 可是那个女孩没有忘。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 na4 ge5 nu:3 hai2 mei2 you3 wang4
sentences.english: But that girl didn't forget.

sentences.hanzi: 几天以后，她到了老陈家，手上拿着一张纸。
sentences.pinyin: ji3 tian1 yi3 hou4 ta1 dao4 le5 lao3 chen2 jia1 shou3 shang4 na2 zhe5 yi1 zhang1 zhi3
sentences.english: A few days later she arrived at old Chen's home, holding a piece of paper.

sentences.hanzi: 纸上有两个点，之间有一条路。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 shang4 you3 liang3 ge4 dian3 zhi1 jian1 you3 yi1 tiao2 lu4
sentences.english: On the paper were two dots, with a road between them.

sentences.hanzi: “这是我家，这是您家。这是我做的地图。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wo3 jia1 zhe4 shi4 nin2 jia1 zhe4 shi4 wo3 zuo4 de5 di4 tu2
sentences.english: "This is my home, and this is yours. It's a map I made."
